row.name: Shenaniganza
row.detailed_description: What is Shenaniganza? Shenaniganza is a videogame interpretation and remake of the real world game 'manhunt'. Manhunt is alike hide-and-seek, but with a thrilling twist. The Hiders become seekers! In the game you will find wacky powerups and silly skins that let you express your inner silly Billy! Abilities In Shenaniganza, there are several abilities, deploy a heat seeking monkey to find the seekers or weaponize the local banana supply and stun the seekers! Map Features Across the map you will find portals and other interactable mobility objects such as cannons. Use these to escape sticky situations and throw the seekers off course! Matchmaking Shenaniganza features a lobby based matchmaking system, you can either join private games through codes supplied by the game upon lobby creation, or you can choose to quick join a game / choose a public lobby from the lobby selection screen.
row.short_description: Outsmart friends in goofy hide-and-seek with crazy power-ups, vibrant cartoon aesthetics, and endless laughter. Form alliances, betray buddies, and experience multiplayer mayhem in this unpredictable, entertaining game. Get ready for a bonanza of fun – where laughs never stop!

row.name: One Night in Kawami
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the City of Rivers! In One Night in Kawami , you play Max, who is about to meet an online acquaintance for the first time: Tanya. She will be your friendly guide in this metropolis where tradition and technology converge - but other than checking the sights, are there other reasons for this meetup? Only one way to find out... It's Your First Time In the Big City; Make It Count You will get a first look at a longer story in this short visual novel penned by Jigu ( Cobra Kai 2: Dojos Rising , Town of Zoz ). This fifteen-minute tale offers slightly different outcomes on the final stretch. (Feel free to save and load it before pressing the button. Once you get there, you will know.) Original Visuals by Brazilian Artists Featuring character art by SlowPumpkins and backgrounds by Nanda Doti , get ready to meet Kawami's coolest citizens... Dunking on Annoying Wannabes ... and some other guy, apparently? No one knows who he is or cares. Every city has one of those, I guess. Distorted Guitars! If you are as into indie & alternative rock as we are, put on your phones for this. One Night in Kawami features a curated soundtrack to explore the City of Rivers' nightlife. (Creative Commons, full credits in the game) Kawamian Voices Will Not Be Silenced The game features voice reactions by Jonna-Lynn Alonso, Dashawn Ricks, Vanessa Benoit, and casting director Aaron Moy - respectively, Tanya, Gilbert, Inga, and Mohawkadour. About One Night in Kawami This is Brand New Whatever 's first foray into in-house development and self-publishing. It is an expanded and improved remake of Out of Phase Synchronicity , an interactive fiction text adventure Jigu submitted to IntroComp 2020 .
row.short_description: Meet a new friend in the dreamlike City of Rivers. One Night in Kawami is a short visual novel about meeting new friends in an unknown city and possibly reshaping reality as you thought you knew it.
row.notes: During the last stretch of the game, you will make a choice with deadly implications to a faraway location of your choosing. Most of the aftermath of your interaction will be delivered by text alone.

row.name: The Great Exhibition of 1851 in VR
row.detailed_description: The Great Exhibition ran from May to October 1851 in London's Hyde Park, in a temporary building known as the Crystal Palace. Six million visitors passed through the turnstiles, to view over 100,000 individual exhibits. Now, over 170 years later, we are recreating the exhibition as an immersive VR experience. The simulation includes a narrator to describe each of the exhibits and the Crystal Palace building. Fire up your SteamVR system and explore the Great Exhibition... If no VR headset present will run in fallback mode (monitor / keyboard / mouse). Note: this is a large application and can take some time to start up.
row.short_description: Use your SteamVR system to visit the 1851 Great Exhibition in London's Hyde Park
row.notes: The "mature content description" / age restrictions on this simulation are based on: (1) nudity in models of paintings and sculptures which is similar to what would typically be seen in a museum or art gallery; (2) one of the exhibits at the exhibition was a wax model of a dissected head which invokes a rating due to violence (corpses).

row.name: Mossy Pixels

row.name: Familiars.io
row.detailed_description: what is this game? it's a compact monster-catching fest in an online multiplayer world. It also has some optional hard stuff for people who like a challenge. what's it like to play? 1 battle = 1 levelup, and the max level is 15. I don't want to waste your time with rpg grinding with only 20 Familiars in the game, you can max-out and understand all the familiars in the game within a few hours ... and then you're ready for the hard stuff find hidden portals to other dimensions, where you must manage your familiars' HP and your potion supply in a slew of battles against fairly smart CPU opponents or, if you want, fight other players you meet in the world to test your mettle what else is there to like? it's extremely easy to pick up, play a bit, and put down the only way to communicate with other players is by pressing the 'howdy' button repeatedly, or running around in circles I think the soundtrack is pretty nice it's free btw it's free? row.name: Stamped: an anti-travel game
row.detailed_description: STAMPED: AN ANTI-TRAVEL GAME follows the journeys of six young, queer and racialized travelers whose paths intersect across Asian urban landscapes. Bound by pleasure-fueled self-destruction, the group flounders from one metropolis to another, confronting the mixture of grief, betrayal, and discrimination that caused them to travel in the first place. STAMPED features 3-4 hours of playtime through three game modes: poetic interactive fiction, visual novel banter, and point-and-click travel stories. The art style is a mixture of hand-drawn images, real oil paintings, digitally illustrated backgrounds, and of course, incredibly cute manga-style sprites. STAMPED is an adaptation of the novel of (nearly) the same name, Stamped: an anti-travel novel , which won the 2020 Creative Prose Book Award at the Association of Asian American Studies. Like the book, the game's six travelers are faced with ethical decisions concerning the shifts in power that can come with international travel and dwelling within histories of war, genocide, and colonial occupation. STAMPED asks how the excursions of young adulthood can shape our queer, messy and imperfect selves. Made with support from Analgesic Productions and the University of British Columbia.
row.short_description: Stamped follows the journeys of six young travelers whose paths intersect across Asian urban landscapes. Bound by pleasure-fueled self-destruction, the group flounders from city to city, confronting the grief and discrimination that caused them to travel in the first place.
row.notes: STAMPED has references to abortion, sex, self-hate, and illegal drugs. This all happens through story, not images. Well, there is a cartoon image of a nude man. There is also some cursing, and the "F bomb" is dropped once.

row.name: Bounty City: 3-Way Battle
row.detailed_description: Bounty City is a multiplayer VR FPS game where three teams engage in simultaneous battles. With a distinctive bounty system, experience the immersive combat of the first three-way war in VR. Game Highlights 1. Strategic Three-Faction Battle System Most FPS games have two teams, but Bounty City introduces a thrilling three-way battle. Teams alternate between offense and defense, creating unpredictable and tense gameplay for a more engaging experience. 2. Fast-paced Battles on Diverse Battlefields Teams of two to three players experience fast-paced battles on medium and small-sized three-dimensional battlefields. The intricately designed landscapes encourage strategic and deep gameplay. Game Story The discovery of Trillium, a new substance, has transformed the world. Outlaws roam the streets, putting bounties on vital resources. Factions form, and virtual gunfights become a sport as players compete for rewards and bounties. Battlefields Experience dynamic battles in Bounty City's expanded arenas—residential neighborhoods and a former trillium trading organization's headquarters. Town: Navigate through residential battlegrounds with centralized defenses and strategic elevation changes. Office: Engage in intense battles within the corporate remnants, featuring duplex interiors and narrow corridors. Port: Prepare to face the hidden threats in the dark and intricate alley. Outpost: Prepare for close combat in a small battlefield with high obstacles. Trillium as a Paid Good Paid goods called Trillium offer character and weapon customization. Purchase with real money for a personalized battlefield experience. Achievement and Reward System Unlock characters, earn items, and experience a sense of accomplishment through various in-game challenges. Bounty City promises an exhilarating three-way battle experience with strategic depth, engaging storylines, and diverse characters. Join the virtual warfare today!
row.short_description: Bounty City is a multiplayer VR FPS game developed with a unique core concept of a three-way battle. It features diverse scenarios that require intense strategic gameplay.
row.notes: In Bounty City, players engage in thrilling shootouts using various weapons. We understand the importance of responsible gaming, and we want to assure you that while the game does involve shooting, the graphic content is designed to be more on the arcade side rather than gory or overly realistic. Our focus is on providing an exciting and immersive gaming experience without crossing into overly mature or graphic territory. We believe in striking a balance between engaging gameplay and respectful content, ensuring players can enjoy the game without encountering excessively mature themes. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out. We're here to make sure all our players have an enjoyable and comfortable gaming experience.

row.name: Energy Tanks
row.detailed_description: Energy Tanks is a 2 player top-down action tank game that requires the players to think on their toes about what they need to do and where they need to shoot. With fully interactable menus, players will easily understand the base controls of Energy Tanks. After selecting a map to battle each other in, the battle will start! Surrounding the maps are shield generators that help keep players’ shields active. Players will have to take out all the enemy shield generators to be able to destroy the opposing tank. Also on the maps are power ups to aid in achieving victory, each one giving different powers to change your battle plans. However, be careful about where you fire, you never know if your bullets are going to hit your own shield generator, or worse… 2 Player Local PvP 4 selectable maps 6 different power ups to give you an edge against the other player Bullets will ricochet off walls Friendly-fire is always active This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Fight for glory and bragging rights as you and another player face off to destroy shield generators and tanks in top-down battle arenas! Will you come out as the better tank?

row.name: Reaplaced
row.detailed_description: Featured DLC Featured DLC About the Game The creators of mystery games Detective Butler , Methods , SoulSet , and Game of Fourtune have teamed up to create a short and spooky Halloween mystery for you to solve! Reaplaced is a linear murder mystery visual novel with only one ending. There are choices, but they only affect the order in which you experience the story -- nothing else. Your goal is to solve the mystery before the truth is revealed at the end of the game. As you play, clues will be added to your inventory to help you piece together the answer yourself. 25,000 words (2-3 hours of gameplay) A locked-room murder mystery to challenge your wits A CLUES system to help you uncover the truth Immersive sprite animations, backgrounds, and sound effects Accessibility options to customize your experience Award-winning original soundtrack Grea Perrim is a reaper of souls, and it's her duty to bring the deceased to the other side. But in the world of reapers, death isn't any kind of equalizer. The value of a soul is directly tied to the peculiarity of its death. Grea's supernatural senses bring her to a Halloween house party with three costumed guests. She soon finds the most valuable kind of soul: the victim of a locked-room murder. To reap the soul, Grea must unravel the identity of its killer and explain its death in full. Is this the work of a human? A witch? Or something else entirely...?
row.short_description: A supernatural Halloween whodunnit. Solve a chilling locked-room mystery before the grim reaper reveals the answer!
row.notes: This game contains strong language, text depictions of blood, gore, death, and visual depictions of blood. Some legal alcohol consumption is implied. Player discretion is advised.

Astral Party
row.detailed_description: FOLLOW US Follow us for the latest info: Twitter: Neverland Entertainment, AstralParty_official YouTube: Neverland_Entmt, AstralParty_official Discord: Astral Party Presskit: Astral Party About the Game Astral Party is a board party game that supports online multiplayer with up to 4 players. This is a free to play game, with in-app purchases like skins, dress-ups that do not affect the gameplay balance. Board Party Game with Suspenses A board game like no other! 15 different panel effects, random effects and events make every game full of suspense and unpredictability. With the roll of dice, you always have chances to turn the tables at the last minute. Over 10 Cute Anime Girls This is an exciting dicing battle with vivid Characters, each with unique skills and beautiful illustration. 10 characters are available as the game launches, and will have more as updates add. 4-Person Online Matches or Single Play with AI Play how you want. Astral Party allows 1 to 4 players to compete online, or single-person play with AI. It's all the same friendship ruining fun. Dices & Cards & Battles & More The crux of Astral Party lies in its one-on-one dice-based combat system, with a myriad of cards, effects, skill, events, and more. Card plays can augment your attack, and the dice decides if it is dodged. Every attack is like a small gamble, and nothing is more chilling than the moment you presume victory is within your grasp. Monsters Spice Up the Game More As the game advances, monsters will surface on the board, some attacking players and others merely stealing coins. In the end, a formidable Boss will appear and relentlessly target the richest player. If it is you, be wary of other players’ 'backstabs'. (PS: Try beat the Boss to find out if there is reward dropping) Victory Condition Players rake in some coins to level up, and the first player hitting level 3 becomes the victor. Be quick to turn those shiny coins into levels, cause you never know if you are still rich in the next turn.
row.short_description: Astral Party is a multiplayer party game populated by cute anime girls! Choose your favorite character, strategize skills & cards, and roll the dice to destroy friendships in this unique board game.
row.notes: This game contains some revealing clothing and is not suitable for all ages: General Mature Content.

row.name: Until the Last Plane 1942
row.detailed_description: Control both airplanes Experience the thrill of handling two aircraft simultaneously. Whether you prefer the precision of a keyboard or the intuitive feel of a gamepad, you'll be able to master the skies. Local Co-op and Steam Remote Play Team up with a friend and enjoy the excitement of local co-op gameplay, or take advantage of Steam's Remote Play to connect with friends from around the world. Coordinate your strategies, support each other in battle, and dominate the enemy forces together. Multiple Altitudes of Combat Engage in dynamic dogfights across various altitudes. Bomb factories from low-altitude or zoom into high-altitude duels, adapting your tactics to the changing battlefield and proving your supremacy in the air.
row.short_description: In Until the Last Plane 1942 you control two airplanes simultaneously. A short game that delivers a relaxed alternative to the usual shoot'em ups. Singleplayer or local co-op.

row.name: Lost Chronicles
row.detailed_description: Investigate the disappearance of a child and unravel the secrets of a deceptively quiet town called Forest Hill. “Lost Chronicles” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Object, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and challenging quests. Leonor arrives at Forest Hill to become the apprentice of the local elder, healer, and alchemist, Magnus. Not only will she have to befriend the locals and prove herself a worthy student, but she also has to dive into the secrets of a small town. Because shortly before her arrival, a series of mysterious crimes begins that will stand in her way to a brighter future. She bravely copes with one trouble after another, but their number is growing. Can she handle all the challenges that the adult world has prepared for her? - Investigate the mysterious disappearance of a child - Settle in a cozy little town and befriend its inhabitants - Get help from new friends in difficult quests - Solve lots of incredible puzzles and explore dozens of hidden object scenes - Gather amazing collections during your adventure - Enjoy stunning locations, magnificent graphics and exciting story
row.short_description: Investigate the disappearance of a child and unravel the secrets of a deceptively quiet town called Forest Hill. “Lost Chronicles” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Object, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and challenging quests.

row.name: Nonograms
row.detailed_description: Nonograms is a relaxing puzzle game where you use logic and creativity. Your goal is to reveal hidden pictures by filling in specific grid cells, based on numerical clues provided for each row and column. The games in this genre are also known as Picross, Griddlers, Pic-a-Pix, Hanjie, etc. 20 free + 1000 DLC puzzles Gargantuan puzzle grids up to 35x35 All puzzles are 100% logically solvable. NO guessing is required! Leaderboards. Compete with other players from all over the world! Autofill of blank cells Smooth cells animation Colored/Monochrome cells representation Save&Exit function to pause/continue any puzzle anytime Stylish steampunk FullHD graphics and sound effects Handy game controls Multilingual support Changeable music themes (Steampunk/Spooky/Winter/Egyptian/8-bit) In-game switching of background images and music tracks Easy-to-understand tutorial Relaxed game mode - no mistakes Useful tips for beginners Shiny achievements for experienced players
row.short_description: Nonograms is a relaxing puzzle game where you use logic and creativity. Your goal is to reveal hidden pictures by filling in specific grid cells, based on numerical clues provided for each row and column. The games in this genre are also known as Picross, Griddlers, Pic-a-Pix, Hanjie, etc.

row.name: Vivaldia 2
row.detailed_description: With the first iteration of Vivaldia, we gave our users the most powerful in-browser game available. We are about productivity and flexibility, but we are also all about fun. Vivaldia added a lot of fun! Vivaldia 2 is the much-awaited continuation of the Vivaldia game series. In this new chapter, the game is bigger, and the bosses are stronger. Nevertheless, our heroine is more determined than ever to take down the evil forces and save the world once again. Sometimes you just need a quick break, and to play a game. Falling out of the skies, ready to take on a new adventure, Vivaldia is back. After entering a portal and being teleported away, Vivaldia is transported to a Lost Valley, where she must continue her fight against evil. Embarking on a thrilling adventure, facing robots and prehistoric dinosaurs, Vivaldia must save a new world, this time from the clutches of the malevolent Robot Overlord. Pitted against relentless robotic foes and navigating through dense and perilous jungles, scorching lava fields, and treacherous swamps, Vivaldia once again seems faced with an impossible challenge. With the fate of the land in her hands – will Vivaldia rise to the occasion? How to play? Use keyboard controls: Arrows right and left to move. Arrow up to climb and trigger teleporters. Arrow down to crawl and climb down N-key or Spacebar to jump M-key to shoot Vivaldia 2 can also be played with a game controller.
row.short_description: Pitted against relentless robotic foes and navigating through dense and perilous jungles, scorching lava fields, and treacherous swamps, Vivaldia once again seems faced with an impossible challenge. With the fate of the land in her hands – will Vivaldia rise to the occasion?

row.name: Halloween Games for Toddlers and Kids Playtest
Dracoslayer
row.detailed_description: Dracoslayer is a thrilling fighting game that combines intense high-paced action with the strategic use of elemental abilities. Dive into an immersive combat experience where every skill and elemental property can shape the battle to your advantage. Master the Elements: Unleash a wide variety of unique skills and craft powerful strategies to outsmart your enemies and secure victory. High-Energy gameplay: Short, snappy combos and fast movement make every match a rhapsody of skill and tactics. Game Modes Story Mode: Embark on an epic adventure through the world of Dracoslayer. Face relentless waves of enemies, and battle formidable bosses. Versus Mode: Test your skills in 1v1 battles! Challenge a friend in local multiplayer or face off against AI opponents in adrenaline-pumping duels. Unleash your inner warrior and dominate the battlefield in Dracoslayer !
row.short_description: Clash in a 2D arena fighter of high-speed duels where elemental projectiles redefine ranged combat!

row.name: The Leak
row.detailed_description: Wake up, watch tv, make a cup of cofffee and try to bear your own meaningless existence. Feaures: - Minimalist, grayscale graphics. - No challenges, puzzles. Just click here there. - Short gameplay. (20-30 minutes-maybe?) - Two endings - Depressive rhetoric on life and death - English voice acting - A dark main theme to accompany you
row.short_description: Wake up, watch tv, make a cup of cofffee and try to bear your own meaningless existence.
row.notes: This game contains scenes and language that may be depressing and upsetting.

row.name: Do I Know You?
row.detailed_description: Do I Know You? is a very short visual novel about a man visiting his mother with dementia.
row.short_description: Do I Know You? is a very short visual novel about a man visiting his mother with dementia.
row.notes: It depicts a debilitating disease and the eventual death it causes.

row.name: Welcome to the Karoshi Club
row.detailed_description: Karoshi Club About the Game 'Welcome to the Karoshi Club' is a free visual novel set in the Japanese horror business punk in black and white manga style. The story follows Kenji Haishima, a former game developer, as he tries to find a new job and land an interview for the sales specialist position at a new company. As the player, you will face the consequences of your choices. Explore the 'Karoshi Club' world and uncover the terrifying truth. Enjoy a thrilling experience and immerse yourself in this unique visual novel. It is a fact that we are keen on expanding the universe of 'Karoshi Club' in collaboration with the gaming community. Therefore, 'Welcome to the Karoshi Club' is a free showcase of our primary product. We are looking to get feedback on the game to determine whether we are heading in the right direction and identify what we did well and what needs improvement. Job Interview Horror Simulator: Experience the fear of job searching in a new reality Art: This game's visual style is reminiscent of other famous horror manga artists Setting: The crisis in Japan during the 90s is relevant to modern times Our multinational indie team is a group of game developers impacted by layoffs in the gaming industry in 2023. However, we refused to give up and used this to create something of our own. We are determined to develop games and create specific worlds we are passionate about, and we hope you will love them just as much as we do. Listen to the stories from Kamishibai while you sit back.
row.short_description: If you're nervous about job searching and interviews, face your fears head-on in 'Welcome to the Karoshi Club' a Japanese horror business punk visual novel.
row.reviews: “But what would you rather do? Rest on your morals and hope for the best? Lie and be someone you aren’t, only to revel in the consequences in the future? Or flirt with both sides and ride a morally gray line to greener pastures?” PixelDie “자신들의 경험을 재치 있는 공포로 풀어낸 카미시바이 인터랙티브와 게임 웰컴 투 더 카로시 클럽의 다음 이야기가 기대된다.” 70 – GameMeca
row.notes: The game is an experience that combines a job interview with horror elements. The job interview is okay and not as horrible as you may think! Almost...

row.name: Know Your Limits
row.detailed_description: What if you got 300km/h maximum speed but cannot fully use it to clear the stage? There are lots of speed limits on your way of adventure. Know your limits or else you'll fall! Experience this unique speed game for FREE Features Play time less than 30 mins Composed of one Tutorial Stage and one Main Stage Relaxing beautiful sky and ambient
row.short_description: Know Your Limits is a speed run game with speed limits. You can increase your speed by collecting coins, but it wouldn't be always the best choice. Go through all the obstacles and get your highest score!

row.name: Return to Northbury Grove
row.detailed_description: Liam Murphy is an aspiring actor looking to land the role of a lifetime at the infamous Rock the Warehouse music festival. Upon arriving at the desolate RTW concert grounds, Liam faces death itself after being kidnapped and thrown into the basement of the Spector Forest Slasher’s labyrinthian kill-house. Now, Liam must use his wits and bravery to survive the traps, trials, and tribulations that lay before him. Will he become the Slasher’s latest victim or will he escape to the fresh air of freedom? Find out by confronting death and your own fears in…Return to Northbury Grove! This immersive VR experience is a love letter to the slasher genre that elevates the terror and ratchets up the tension of the Northbury Grove franchise – so don’t make a sound, stay out of sight, and whatever you do, do not cross the Slasher. Let the blood curdling cries commence! Next-Level Immersion: Experience every pulse-pounding moment in full 360-degree VR. Physics First: The game is 100% physically simulated, from the player itself to almost every object and item found in all levels. Haunting Atmosphere: The unsettling ambiance of Specter Forest and other mysterious places come to life like never before as you live the experience with the maximum immersion Chilling Audio: Spatial Sound effects make you feel as if you're truly part of this living nightmare. Unpredictable Gameplay: Your choices matter. Make decisions that impact your survival in real-time. Adaptive AI: No two playthroughs are the same. The lurking terror adapts to your actions in real-time. Do you have what it takes to actually survive a horror movie? Modifier Mania: Total Darkness? Guns Everywhere? Happy the Humble Heifer? Play with modifiers, the real game starts once you beat it the first time!
row.short_description: Return to Northbury Grove is a thrilling VR experience and love letter to the slasher horror genre. Centered around immersive escape room gameplay, players are tasked with evading the terrifying Slasher of Specter Forest. Can you survive a horror movie?
row.notes: Contains intense violence, gore, and psychological terror.

row.name: PC Jumps
row.detailed_description: Complete Epic Jumps across and maneuver your way across increasingly difficult levels. To beat this game, you will have to execute precise control of your vehicle by controlling your speed and rotation. Each level presents new challenges with different vehicles obstacles and Jumps. Each Vehicle has different grip on land, Weight, Power and Size.
row.short_description: Jump across ramps and dodge obstacles to conquer increasing difficult Levels.

row.name: Sins OV Cigar
row.detailed_description: Extreme melee/gun combat with a focus on player aggressiveness and risk/reward mechanics. Features agile movement and brutal melee combat Richad Cigar, quadrillionaire and head of the Cigar corporation, has been dealt a military invasion by a rival splinter company organized by a former friend, Tony Robusto. Cigar seeks to capture Robusto himself. In thousands of years, not one normal or healthy person has set foot in this continent dominated by corrupt business. Also known as Sins Of Cigar.
row.short_description: Brutal Slice-Em-Up Gun and Scythe combat set in a deranged world. Playtime is an hour long, the game is a college project. Also known as Sins Of Cigar.
row.notes: Cartoonish gore and ridiculous fighting.

row.name: Real Cricket Mod Creator
row.detailed_description: Real Cricket Mod Creator is an app created by Nautilus Mobile - the creators of the hit mobile-cricket franchise Real Cricket. This app lets you create and customise in-game assets of Real Cricket and publish it straight to the Real Cricket servers. These assets will then be available for download on your favourite game on mobile – Real Cricket Tournaments: Edit and customise more than 50 Tournaments of Real Cricket such that the user can change the name of the tournament and its logo by simply uploading an image. Teams: With more than 450 cricket teams on offer, users can customise his favourite team starting with renaming the team to uploading a new logo and some advanced customisation features to edit and customise the team jerseys to your liking. Player: Customise your favourite cricketers in the game by simply filtering out the tournaments and teams which they represent and unlocking a host of customisation options starting with changing their name, jersey number, jersey name and advanced customisation options for editing their faces, hand color, shape, hair and size of their head and body. This app lets you create your own tournaments, teams and players and download it directly to your favourite mobile game – Real Cricket making it one of the few games on mobile which lets you customise everything to your liking and never know boredom ever again!
row.short_description: Customize tournaments, jerseys, player faces etc. and publish the assets to our servers to get it on our mobile game - Real Cricket

row.name: Kottabos VR
row.detailed_description: This is a VR trip into the ancient world – playing Kottabos, the all-time favorite Greek party game. All the items you see around you are 3D reconstructions of actual ancient furniture, pottery, and Kottabos targets from museums. This historical game is harder than it looks! In ancient Greece Kottabos was a popular party game in which players threw the dregs from the bottom of their cup at targets. These included a disk on the top of a pole and cups floating in a bowl of water. They competed for adoration, praise, and respect of the other party-goers. Prove your skill by throwing the dregs of wine from your cup at the metal disk on the pole in front of you, or fling your drops at the little cups floating in a bowl. If the disk or the cups go down, your luck goes up! A round of applause, an extra dessert, or the favor of Aphrodite herself will come to the winners. Game Features: Physics-driven gameplay in VR. Controller momentum and trigger button throws the dregs. Aim at the different targets, and get higher scores based on strength of hit and placement on the target. Three different levels of gameplay. Tutorial level. Track your high scores. Educational! Learn about Kottabos, the real Greek party game. Free! Use for classes. Project Team: Aiden Gohlke – Lead Game Design and Programmer, Kennesaw State University Donovan Lott – Lead Game Design and Programmer, Kennesaw State University Jake Lewis – Student Game Design and Programmer, Kennesaw State University (2022) Dr. Sandra Blakely – Project Director, Emory University, Department of Classics Dr. Joanna C. Mundy – Project Manager, Digital Projects Specialist, Emory Center for Digital Scholarship Dr. Joy Li – Game Development Collaborator, Kennesaw State University, Assistant Professor of Computer Game Design and Development Craig Brasco – Visual Interface Collaborator and Illustrator, Kennesaw State University, Assistant Professor of Art | Graphic Communications Hakeem Thomas – Student Game Design and Programmer, Kennesaw State University (2021)
row.short_description: This is a VR trip into the ancient world – playing Kottabos, the all-time favorite Greek party game. Prove your skill by throwing the dregs of wine from your cup at the metal disk on the pole in front of you, or fling your drops at the little cups floating in a bowl.
publishers: Emory Center for Digital Scholarship at Emory University

row.name: Aviators
row.detailed_description: DISCOVER THE HISTORY OF THE POLISH AIR FORCE DURING WORLD WAR II Take the role of a Polish aviation ace from World War II and engage in aerial battles with the Luftwaffe! Learn the story of the legendary Polish 1586 Special Destiny Squadron and join them on incredible missions. Repel the attacks of the German air force, operate devices on board the Halifax MK, communicate with the local partisan unit “Armia Krajowa”, and assist the Warsaw Uprising! Break through the German A2 fortifications, destroy 88 mm artillery positions, and complete the mission with a car escape Key Features: A story based on real events and characters from the Polish Air Force during World War II. A blend of exploration, aerial combat, and logical puzzles. A journal module containing a comprehensive compendium of historical knowledge referenced in 'Aviators.' An immersive soundtrack, 'The Aviators' Suite,' featuring compositions by Przemysław Treszczotka inspired by the music of Karol Szymanowski and Mieczysław Karłowicz.
row.short_description: An educational adventure game about Polish air personnel during World War II. Meet the pilots of the 1586 Special Destiny Squadron and join them on incredible assignments. Explore and solve puzzles to learn more about the history of Polish aviation.

row.name: Life Makeover
row.detailed_description: Life Makeover is a liberating fashion game where you have the freedom to express your unique style. Customize your virtual persona, experiment with various fashion choices, and dive into the joy of unlimited dress-up possibilities with fashion dye and do-it-yourself (DIY) options. It's your chance to create your own fashion show! Plus, you can even design and build your dream home for free. [Unleash Your Unique Persona] - Customize Every Detail Take command of your virtual character and let your style shine. Customize facial features, body shape, and skin tone to break free from conventions and express yourself in your own extraordinary way. [Elevate Designs with Limitless Wardrobe] - Powered by UE4 Engine Experience an extensive wardrobe for every occasion, each design flawlessly detailed. Fueled by the cutting-edge UE4 engine and a range of 3D materials, your creations will be impeccably crafted, down to the smallest stitch and embroidery. [Express with Color, Lead with Style] - The Power of Fashion Dye Unleash your creativity through the fashion dye feature. Color different parts of your outfits with hundreds of combinations, from dazzling iridescence to perfectly coordinated hues. Be a trailblazer in setting new trends and embody the essence of beauty. [Your Designs, Your Brand] - DIY Garment Studio Step into the shoes of a fashion designer. From fabric selection to pattern making, cutting, and printing, oversee every aspect of the creative process. Your designs, your choices, your brand. [Beyond Fashion, Craft Your Ideal Home] - Unleash a Dream Lifestyle Personalize your living space with a diverse selection of furniture. Embrace a lifestyle of reading, dancing, working out, hosting parties, raising pets, and much more in your ideal home. [Uncover Mysteries and Memories] - Immersive Stories with Live2D Cards Delve into captivating stories and memories brought to life with Live2D cards. Concealed beneath exquisite costumes lie mysteries and clues waiting to be unraveled. Are you prepared to uncover the truth? [Connect, Create, and Celebrate] - Thrive in a Community of Designers Join a dynamic community of designers in a boundless universe. Share makeup and outfit ideas, visit friends' homes, host afternoon tea gatherings, and enhance house decor for stunning photos. Forge new friendships and connect with others in the world of Life Makeover. [Your Journey to Infinite Possibilities] - Beauty, and Freedom In Life Makeover, you're not just a player; you're a creator. Come and infuse your life with inspiration and imagination. Embrace a world where diversity and freedom reign supreme! FAQ:
row.short_description: Explore Life Makeover: Unleash your style, dye outfits, and design freely. Dive into unlimited dress-up, build your dream home - all for free.

row.name: My Horse: Bonded Spirits - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Prologue of My Horse: Bonded Spirits! The prologue is only part of the full game and is completely free. Every player will be able to play it and see what awaits them in the full version of the game. Your story Begin your adventure as the reluctant future heir of a stud farm. Prove that you are more than just a spoiled brat. Start from scratch and learn how to keep and manage a stud farm; it will be a challenge that will prove incredibly rewarding – return the stud farm to its former glory! Along your journey, discover that nothing is as lasting as the bond with your horses! Manage your stud farm and return it to its former glory! Your stud farm is not in a good shape – your job is to rebuild it, which will require quite a bit of skill and knowledge about keeping a stud farm. Develop your skills and gain knowledge to bring the farm up to scratch and learn how to maintain it. Manage your employees and other horses. Watch the stud farm transform from a ruin into a home for you and your horses. Your horse isn’t the only friend you can make! Saddle up and explore the idyllic open world of Chestnut Glen and its surrounding landscape. Help rebuild the run-down stud farm by trotting around and meeting the village’s residents – hang out with them and complete tasks for them to improve your and the stud farm’s reputation. Remember, not everybody you meet will want to be friends with you. Some people don’t even like horses! Your dream horse In My Horse: Bonded Spirits - Prologue, you can change not only your appearance but also your horse’s and the stud farm’s. Choose various accessories, hairstyles, and saddles for your horse, so that you can gallop through the world in style. Place decorations and renovate the stud farm to beautify not only the stables but also the whole surrounding area! Prove yourself in various competitions Do you think the bond with your horse is strong enough to win competitions? The more trust there is between the two of you, the more easily your horse will learn new skills and the less afraid they will be of new challenges.
row.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version. Build a bond with your horse and gain its trust. Develop yours and the horse’s skills. Discover the surrounding open world. Complete tasks and take part in competitions. Rebuild a run-down stud farm!

row.name: Love Alone Death
row.detailed_description: Embark on a hand-drawn, story-driven, point-and-click game. Unravel the story, discover items, and get to know characters whose endings depend on your choices. Humans have suddenly disappeared from the world, and those who remain are sticking together. You, who always struggled to be with others, now face the choice of whom to spend your final moments with. Game Features: - Various Ways to Solve Problems: Your choices affect character relationships. - Multiple Endings: Choose one person to spend your final moments with, play the romance route, go for the all-inclusive ending, or even confront the end alone. Collect all endings and complete the challenges. - Warning: Occasional disturbing elements such as corpses, mice, blood, vomit, and severed heads may appear without warning.
row.short_description: Build relationship with the characters. Your choices might earn you favor from one character, but disdain from another. Use items to solve problems. Confront various endings. Choose one person and face the end with them.
row.notes: The characters are depicted killing or harming each other. Characters abuse drugs and dead bodies appear in the background.

row.name: Ultraleap Gemini
row.detailed_description: Users of the Leap Motion Controller 2 should download Ultraleap Hyperion, our sixth generation tracking platform which provides improved accuracy and new computer vision functionality. Ultraleap Gemini is the fifth generation hand tracking platform from Ultraleap. It is the most robust and flexible hand tracking ever, and matches the position of your virtual hands to your real ones more closely than ever before. Ultraleap Gemini highlights include: Improved initialization. Hands are tracked as soon as they enter the field of view Improved performance across a wide range of hand sizes Robust interaction with both hands together Works in challenging environments Flexible integration options Superior pose accuracy NOTE: Please uninstall any existing Ultraleap tracking software before using Gemini via Steam.
row.short_description: Ultraleap's fifth generation hand tracking software for the Leap Motion Controller

row.name: Corked
row.detailed_description: A ski and snowboard game for skiers and snowboarders. inspired by multiple generations of actions sports games such as Amped2 and the THPS series, corked is half arcade, half ski simulator blending a realistic physics based trick system with fun and easy to play challenges and terrain. Explore the mountain, find creative lines through a rail run or get first tracks through some pow, interacting with other riders, tourists and ski patrol along the way.
row.short_description: A Ski and Snowboard game for skiers and snowboarders. Get Corked.

row.name: HenapoLand
row.detailed_description: Players are born in 'Henapoland' as pioneer lords. The objective is to find the golden land of 'Jipongu'. Although it is an idol game, all the various contents do not end with idols alone. It is a free game! On the left side of the screen, members continue to collect the chosen materials they have already found. Use these to break through the obstacles and problems that stand in your way! Other side contents are also abundant. Petit Combat Harvesting in the field Harvesting in the sea There are also hard areas that are difficult to clear. This game is Idle Game, making it ideal for those with time to spare or in-between activities!
row.short_description: The player is born in 'Henapoland' as a pioneer lord. The objective is to find the golden land of 'Jipongu'. It is a free idle game!

row.name: Tulip
row.detailed_description: You are a very sad bunny. You cannot stop crying. You might have to drink something gross. You are Tulip. Wander through a storybook countryside, gather ingredients for a strange brew, and get to know your adorable animal neighbors in an odd quest to alleviate your incurable sadness. . TAKE WEIRD ADVICE FROM A MAGAZINE Guide Tulip on their quest to heal their heartbreak using Miss Kitty's advice column -- and it's odd (and unsubstantiated) tea recipe. EXPLORE THE COUNTRYSIDE Six beautifully illustrated levels for Tulip to hop through while completing their ingredients list, with adorable (and sometimes helpful) neighbors to interact with. PLAY MINIGAMES Put together bouquets, harvest herbs from Tulip's garden, and solve short music puzzles to help Tulip find what they need. DRINK SOMETHING GROSS Once every item is found, put together the final concoction in a tea brewing minigame.
row.short_description: You are a very sad bunny. You cannot stop crying. You might have to drink something gross. You are Tulip. Wander through a storybook countryside, gather ingredients for a strange brew, and get to know your adorable animal neighbors in an odd quest to alleviate your incurable sadness.

row.name: The Consumist Journey
row.detailed_description: The Consumist Journey is a surreal exploration game where you play as a torso-headed character on a quest to explore the capitalist and consumerist paradigms of modern society. Navigate through bizarre and nonsensical environments, solve puzzles, and interact with eccentric characters to learn more about the world and your place in it. Along the way, you'll confront challenging questions about the nature of consumerism, capitalism, and the human condition. Key Features: Explore a surreal and nonsensical world: The Consumist Journey features a unique and imaginative art style that creates a surreal and thought-provoking world to explore. Play as a torso-headed character: Your character is a torso with a head, but don't let that stop you from exploring and solving puzzles. Unravel the mysteries of capitalism and consumerism: Through your interactions with the world and its inhabitants, you'll learn more about the capitalist and consumerist paradigms of modern society. Confront challenging questions: The Consumist Journey is a game that asks difficult questions about the nature of our world. What is the true cost of our consumerism? What is our place in a capitalist society? If you're a fan of surreal exploration games, thought-provoking narratives, and challenging questions, then this is the game for you.
row.short_description: The Consumist Journey is a surreal exploration game where you play as a strange character on a quest to explore the capitalist and consumerist paradigms of modern society. Navigate through bizarre and nonsensical environments, solve puzzles, and interact with eccentric characters.

row.name: Swords of Blood
row.detailed_description: In the once-peaceful realm of men, darkness descends. Heroes have fallen, yet the battle rages on. You are the Sword Master, the final hope of a vanquished order. Resurrected by the Sentinel, a mighty goddess, you are destined to restore peace in a world consumed by war. Arm yourself for an epic journey to reclaim the glory of your fallen brethren. Traverse through dense forests, icy caverns, forgotten mines, and ancient ruins. Each environment is teeming with secrets and dangers. Challenge a myriad of enemies - beasts, demons, goblins, and more. Utilize powerful spells and skills to conquer formidable bosses like The Brutal Impaler and The King of Blizzard. Loot, craft, and upgrade diverse weapons and armor. Fuse equipment with mystical ingredients to create artifacts like The Sword of Eternal Flames. Rise through the ranks in the champions' contest. Show your might in the PVP Arena and claim your place among the elite. Join daily and weekly events for unique rewards. Test your skills in Monster Hunts and other thrilling challenges. Select your emblem and wield the forces of nature. Harness fire, water, and more to unleash deadly skills. Embark on an action-packed journey. Enjoy the rush of combat, the joy of crafting, and the thrill of victory in this RPG legend. Dive into a riveting story. Align with your Sentinel, challenge various difficulty levels, and immerse yourself in classic isometric gameplay. Ongoing Adventures Await Engage in six captivating chapters, with the seventh on the horizon. New challenges, stories, and battles continue to unfold. 💎 Stay Connected & Join the Order 💎 Visit our website and dive into the world of Swords of Blood- a free-to-play, legendary RPG experience. Your legacy begins now.
row.short_description: Embark on an epic quest in Swords of Blood, a free-to-play RPG. Master elemental powers, craft legendary gear, and battle formidable foes in the realm of Ezura. Join the adventure today!

row.name: A Night In Omar's Burger Playtest
Sorrows End
row.detailed_description: When the King of Dicleus is assassinated, the Diclean army razes their neighboring kingdom of Jesagris in retaliation for actions Jesagris never committed, creating many orphans. Sorrows End follows the story of one said orphan and her quest to find a way to prevent such tragedies from occurring again. Will she make friends? Will she save others? Will there be a talking cat? Yes to all! Expect 8-12 hours of gameplay. Contains fantasy violence, frightening themes and themes of anguish. Features include character customization, choices that matter, three endings, and partial controller support.
row.short_description: A fantasy turn-based RPG, Made with RPG Maker MV. It utilizes a side view battle system, contains scenes that may be frightening and scenes of anguish. Sorrows End is a heart-wrenching tale of loss.
row.notes: Contains fantasy violence, frightening scenes and scenes of anguish

row.name: Ultimate pirates
row.detailed_description: About this game: A city building / strategy MMO game. Start from a small island, build a small town first and develop it to a big city. Build pirate ships, starting from small shallops and ending huge Ships of the line, Galleons and fast Frigates, manage multiple fleets performing tasks such as killing monsters and plundering other cities. Hunt other pirates by intercepting their fleets on their way. Steal their gold, weapons and other resources. This is an MMO game, which means you can play with your friends, or find new ones in the game. Form alliances, chat with your teammates, organize raids to kill huge monsters together, join with your friends to perform more powerful attacks. This is a RPG as well: you can play an evil pirate, who attacks everyone, steals from everyone or you can be a honest pirate, who helps their friends, revenge their enemies or, you can even choose to never participate in battles and be a peaceful pirate, who grows carrots, it's up to you! DISCLAIMER: (PLEASE read it BEFORE YOU PLAY ) My name is Artem, and I am the game designer and lead developer of this game. This game is a gift to all players who want to try something new absolutely for FREE. There are no purchase fees, no in-app purchases (IAPs), and no ads. We do not accept any donations or payments from players. There is no way for any player to pay us money. We earn nothing from this game. Moreover, this is an online game, and we, as developers, pay for the servers. Keeping this game online and operational without any form of monetization costs us money. In the end, this game is not just unprofitable; it results in a net loss for us. You might be wondering why anyone in their right mind would release a game without any monetization and continue to pay for servers. Due to a non-disclosure agreement (NDA), I cannot reveal all the details of the unfortunate story of how this game was launched and why it was shut down. However, I can tell you that we spent almost 4 years developing this game, and players who liked it could only enjoy it for a couple of months. These events and their aftermath had a devastating impact on my mental health. I am in much better shape now, but I am still dealing with the consequences to this day. Spending 4 years of my life working hard on this game and then keeping it hidden from players was one of the many reasons that led to this situation. We cannot launch this game with a profit, but we can launch it without one. So, here we are. Because the game is unprofitable, consider it official ABANDONWARE and don't say I didn't warn you! Do not expect any updates or support, and do not expect this game to stay online forever. Accept the game AS IS, with all its flaws, bugs, and imperfections. It has some :) However, this game has many similarities with our other games, so, in case you need an advice, we have an amazing community of players who could probably help you on our forums and Discord. From our end we will try to guarantee the servers of the game will be up and running as long as our company exists and could handle the costs. I hope you will find the game enjoyable at least for some time and its unique mechanics will provide you with either adrenaline in PvP or a chill in PvE (whatever you choose to take). Stay healthy and happy, Sincerely yours, Artem Shpytiak
row.short_description: Abandoned MMO set in Pirates world. Absolutely FREE! NO in-app purchases, you can find gems by killing monsters. NO premium content. Official ABANDONWARE: no updates, no bug fixes, no improvements, no support, no empty promises. The game provided AS IS.

row.name: 疑案追了声
row.detailed_description: 疑案追声粉丝自制，为爱发电，一样的声音推理游戏 欢迎来到《疑案追了声》的世界，这是一款结合了声音探案和解谜元素，让你体验前所未有的侦探冒险之旅的单机游戏。戴上耳机，倾听案件现场的回声，运用你的智慧和推理能力，揭开一桩桩扣人心弦的悬案。 游戏的音频设计独具匠心，声音将成为探索的重要线索。每个场景的音效、对话和背景音乐都被精心设计，营造出真实的沉浸式体验。你可以通过进度条控制音频的播放、暂停、快进和快退，自由地探索声音的世界。 《疑案追了声》采用独特的多线叙事手法，同一时间不同地点可能会同时发生多场对话。你可以选择一直监听一个角色，或者在房间中游走，监听不同场景的人物对话。游戏还支持发送弹幕功能，你可以与其他玩家一起标记剧情，分享你的推理和发现。 《疑案追了声》将带给你身临其境的侦探体验，让你通过声音这一新颖的视角去揭开悬案的真相。在这个充满谜团的世界里，你将挑战自己的观察力和推理能力，与犯罪嫌疑人斗智斗勇，解开一桩桩扣人心弦的案件。 沉浸在《疑案追了声》的世界中，你将体验到前所未有的侦探冒险之旅。现在，就让我们一起戴上耳机，倾听案件现场的回声，揭开真相的面纱！
row.short_description: 疑案追声粉丝自制，为爱发电，一样的声音推理游戏 在《疑案追了声》中，你将扮演一名拥有特殊能力的侦探，通过收集、分析和解读案发现场的回声，还原案件的真相。每个案件都有其独特的故事背景和情节，你需要仔细聆听角色的对话，观察现场的细节，寻找线索，逐步揭示案件的真相。

row.name: Grill on Wheels
row.detailed_description: JOIN US ON DISCORD About the Game The Ultimate VR Food Truck Odyssey Awaits! Step into the bustling world of 'Grill on Wheels'. Navigate through vibrant cityscapes and immerse yourself in a culinary journey where every decision counts. Dive deep into this VR adventure and rise from a humble food truck chef to a culinary legend. Key Features Immersive VR Gameplay: Experience every slice, grill sizzle, and customer interaction in vivid VR. Deep Customization: Tailor every inch of your truck. From equipment upgrades to aesthetic designs, make the truck truly yours. Strategic Planning: Master the art of strategy. Plan your ingredient purchases, set your menu, and decide on pricing to maximize profits. Dynamic 3D World: Engage with lifelike environments, from the bustling marketplaces to the demanding streets filled with hungry patrons. Progressive Challenges: As you advance, the streets get more demanding, offering richer rewards for those who strategize effectively. Your Kitchen, Your Rules From the confines of your garage to the heart of the city, every decision you make impacts your journey. Strategize your daily tasks, from ingredient sourcing to kitchen layout, and feel the weight of every choice as the day unfolds. A Journey Of One This solo odyssey challenges your managerial acumen and culinary skills. As orders pour in and the clock ticks away, will your strategies set you apart or will you crumble under pressure? Evolving Streets Adapt to the ever-changing demands of the city. From unpredictable weather to rare ingredients, the scale of the challenges with your growing reputation. 'Grill on Wheels' isn't just a cooking game; it's a tale of ambition, choices, and the aroma of freshly grilled burgers. Embrace the grind, make strategic choices, and carve out your legacy in the food truck world!
row.short_description: Dive into the immersive world of VR food truck mastery! Prep, grill, and serve delicious burgers. Manage your dynamic mobile kitchen, customize it to your heart's content, strategize ingredient use, and become the ultimate street chef in this captivating VR culinary adventure!

row.name: Impossible Bunny Challenge
row.detailed_description: Impossible Bunny Challenge is a fun and free game that lets you surf the wind as a Bunny and race against three other Bunnies to collect checkpoint balls. The game features a tough racing AI that learned how to win by itself using machine learning. It is intentionally harder to control your Bunny, so you’ll have to learn quickly to beat the competition at their own game. You can also customize the Bunnies trail effects for extra fun. Choose from different range of effects to make your Bunny stand out from the crowd. Or just sit back and watch the action in spectator mode from a total of 3 levels including the Moon. Best played with your own music playing in the background! Can you master your Bunny's controls to beat the Impossible Bunny Challenge? Download the game for free today and see if you can outrace the smartest, fastest, & cutest wind surfing Bunnies in the world!
row.short_description: Surf the wind as a Bunny and race against three other Bunnies to collect checkpoint balls. The game features a robust racing AI that is very challenging to beat. You’ll have to learn quickly if you want to beat the Impossible Bunny Challenge!

row.name: Bistro Blitz
row.detailed_description: Bistro Blitz Step into the chaotic and hilarious world of 'Bistro Blitz,' where you and a partner embark on a culinary adventure like no other. Team up to run a bustling restaurant, with one player assuming the role of the visionary chef and the other as the mischievous waiter. Here's the twist: the waiter holds the secret desires of each customer close to their apron, while the chef wields the power to turn those cravings into delectable dishes. Coordination and communication are the keys to success, but who says you can't spice things up a bit? Delight in the pandemonium of intentionally mixing up orders and serving up culinary chaos, all while trying to keep the restaurant's reputation intact. 'Bistro Blitz' is not just a game – it's a recipe for laughter, collaboration, and maybe a dash of delightful mayhem. This is a multiplayer only game. Gameplay Overview You and a friend are running a restaurant together. One player will be the chef and the other will be the waiter. The waiter is the only one that can take and see customer's orders, and the chef is the only one that can make the dishes. You need to work together and communicate in order to make the meals that the customers want. Key Features Create your own custom meals Take orders from customers Earn money by fulfilling orders Credits Programming, Testing, & World Design - Ethan Barlevy Music - Levy Barlevy This is a student project. Because of this, there is no guarantee of updates after release. Also, the core of this project was made in 8 weeks so there are likely multiple bugs. FAQ Why are the minimum requirements so high? I am only able to test on my computer so I only checked on that system. The game will probably run with lower specs but I can not confirm that it will work. What do I do if the interactions break? This can usually be fixed if you walk away then back towards whatever you were trying to interact with. If that still doesn't work, you need to throw away whatever you are holding and try again.
row.short_description: Work with a friend to feed the hungry customers at your bistro, but be mindful of keeping them happy.

row.name: Pellet Packer: Micro Munch
row.detailed_description: Chomp your way up the ranks in 'Pellet Packer: Micro Munch'! 'Pellet Packer: Micro Munch' is a chaotic strategy survival game where everything- including your own control method- is your enemy. Only true survivors can take on this challenge and get all the crowns, trophies and milestones! Plant your defenses, collect micros and be the first to win three rounds! Play fast-paced match based gameplay with a large focus realtime strategy. Explore the 5 different game modes including Match Mode, Endurance Mode, Gluttony Mode, VS Mode and Blockbuster Mode. Completionists will especially enjoy all of the unlockable content in this game. As you rank up, you can unlock achievements, such as trophies, milestones and gold crowns! You can also unlock new ways to customize your game, as well as ranking up your Gold Mode! Originally released February 1st, 2021 Special thanks to SheepTester for code/exporting help
row.short_description: Chomp your way up the ranks in 'Pellet Packer: Micro Munch'! A chaotic strategy survival game where everything- including your own control method- is your enemy.

row.name: Pellet Packer: Cookie Crunch
row.detailed_description: Platforming with a mouse has never been so fun! Chomper and Chaser are back like you've never seen them before! This time, they explore delicious new worlds in Pellet Packer: Cookie Crunch! Play through all-new platforming levels that cleverly remix the same movement mechanics and controls from the original Pellet Packer: Micro Munch! Use the cookies scattered around the stage to traverse, show off your quick wits and reflexes to pass tricky obstacles, explore the stage to find all 6 Chaser defences in each one and advance to the next level-- but watch out!! Every 5 levels, there's a boss battle- utilizing the same physics as the original Pellet Packer: Micro Munch!! Can you complete this crunchy quest? With a substantial main quest and a large amount of post-game content, this extremely replayable game feels like biting into a warm, freshly baked cookie- and once you get a taste of this treat, you'll be eating it up for a while!! Originally released February 1st, 2022 Special thanks to SheepTester for code/exporting help
row.short_description: Crunch your way around fun, colourful worlds in 'Pellet Packer: Cookie Crunch'!

row.name: One Way Road: Firehunt
row.detailed_description: The player will take control of a spaceship as the captain of Space Fleet Command, James Dekker. Together with a team of recruits, on a battle-worn ship, you will look into the most remote corners of the galaxy, engage in fierce space combat, fight with entire fleets, and protect not only the Earth but all of humanity. A captivating storyline. Experience a world where moral dilemmas can turn friends and allies into enemies, and utterly devastate worlds. Discover what it means to be in charge of your team from the perspective of a hardened and sometimes cynical war veteran. Build a branching narrative that will determine not only the fate of the main characters, but the survival of the entire universe as well. Cinematic experience. Almost seamlessly blending interactive cutscenes with gameplay One Way Road delivers one of the most cinematic, expansive and life-like journeys through the Galaxy war. The game’s on-screen direction will keep you engaged till the end credits roll. Progression system. As you travel, you will earn Experience points that can be used to upgrade your ship's systems and install new equipment. It is up to you to adjust your ship to suit your style of play or to adapt yourself and master your chosen battle tactics. Explore the galaxy's far reaches. Engage in space combat and battle on planet surfaces. Drive a spaceship through dense asteroid fields, chase down a hurling comet, or explore a gigantic space station that's full of dark labyrinths. Gameplay mechanics intertwined. The game is blending several action mechanics in order to create an action packed space story. - The Scroll Shooter mode allows you to control a Starfleet heavy cruiser that is powerful enough to take out entire fleets. - The Top-down Shooter mode puts you in control of a small, nimble space-fighter jet. - The Tube Shooter mode enables you to chase the enemy, destroying everything that stands in your way.
row.short_description: Firehunt is a prologue for the main story One Way Road. Take part in space battles as you travel across the galaxy and fight to save humanity. This cinematic narrative driven action-focused space shooter, will take you on a journey into the near future, and put the destiny of mankind in your hands.

row.name: Definya 2D MMORPG
row.detailed_description: Definya: Dive into the Ultimate MMORPG Experience with Deep Customization and Dynamic Gameplay! Embark on an unforgettable adventure in Definya, where immersive MMORPG elements meet the freedom of an open-world RPG. Forge your path with robust features that offer endless possibilities for every player. 🛡️ Dynamic Guild System: Join or create powerful guilds to collaborate with friends and players worldwide. Engage in guild quests, participate in large-scale battles, and build a community that thrives together. 💎 Gem Customization: Personalize your gear like never before! Enhance your weapons and armor with unique gems, each providing distinct abilities and boosts. Tailor your equipment to match your playstyle and dominate the battlefield. 🌐 Sandbox Economy: Experience a living, breathing economy driven by player interactions. Trade, craft, and build your wealth in a system where your actions directly impact the game world. Whether you’re a trader, crafter, or entrepreneur, Definya offers opportunities for everyone. 🌾 Farming & Resource Management: Cultivate your land, harvest resources, and manage your farms to support your adventures. Engage in agriculture, animal husbandry, and resource gathering to sustain yourself and contribute to the economy. 🌍 Expansive Open World & Dungeon Exploration: Traverse diverse landscapes, discover hidden treasures, and conquer challenging dungeons. Each area is meticulously crafted to provide unique experiences and formidable foes. ⚔️ Rich MMO RPG Depth: Immerse yourself in a world filled with intricate quests, engaging storylines, and dynamic events. Definya ensures a smooth and consistent experience, allowing you to adventure anytime, anywhere. ⭐ Community-Driven Development: Your voice matters! Whether you're customizing your gear, building your empire, or exploring vast new territories, Definya offers endless adventures waiting for you!
row.short_description: Fantasy 2D Retro Pixel Anime MMORPG — Crafting, Open-World, Sandbox — PVP & PvE

row.name: Touhou Meijinka ~ Song of Divine Tempest
row.detailed_description: It is raining and pouring. It's not your average thunderstorm, but a primordial one. This storm doesn't seem to stop. At the same time, the storm is also producing gospel chanting, leading to people being attracted to the concert. The Land of Illusions ends up becoming empty, giving the local bands no opportunity to perform for their people. Based on an original screenplay by Emiko Hosokawa, you take control of one of four humanoids to set out and find the source of the concert. Originally based on a fangame album featuring an original score by Chuhou Joutai creator Susumu Takajima, you must traverse six stages of varying terrain to find the concert's mastermind. Whether you're alone or with a friend*, your own danmaku is imperative. This will not be an easy journey - you must dodge your enemies' danmaku and overcome their spell cards. *Additional accessories may be required for local multiplayer modes. Features Four playable characters spanning different backgrounds Four difficulty modes with different spell cards A six-stage main game plus a post-game extra stage A series of original characters created by Susumu Takajima and Emiko Hosokawa to fight against 1990s-style musical score by Susumu Takajima Controller support Co-op mode
row.short_description: A thunderous concert appears...

row.name: Cave Heroes
row.detailed_description: Cave Heroes Cave Heroes is a challenging idle game where you explore dungeons, fight demons and face powerfull bosses. Descending into the depths of the caves, you will find forgotten knowledge, learn to use Dark Mana, collect powerful loot and absorb the power of the Archdemons. Improve You Village Unlock new buildings, hire workers, veterans and archmages and watch your heroes' stats grow. Perform Dark Rituals, idle to accumulate resources, build more buildings and watch as previously invincible enemies are defeated in one blow. Collect Loot Fight in quests to collect artifacts, capture Dark Equipment from bosses, complete tasks to achieve Rewards to improve your heroes further. Tame Pets and Unlock Skins Play mini games to rescue pets, tame them to get help on your journey. Unlock 20+ powerful and cute skins. Beat Dark Lord Reach the Dark Fortress and defeat the Dark Lord, ending his ruthless raids forever.
row.short_description: Lead a party of Cave Heroes to explore dungeons, battle monsters and defeat tough archdemons. Build your village, collect loot, rescue pets and much more in this idle RPG.

row.name: Grog
row.detailed_description: Grog is a First-Person online party game where 2-8 players compete in many Australian-dad-inspired minigames to see who is truly the greatest Aussie dad. Minigames Compete in various minigames against your friends to earn points. Whoever has the most points after all minigames are complete, wins! Here are some of the challenges you will compete in: BBQ off Cook as much meat as possible within the time limit. Make sure you don't burn the meat though! Lawnmowing Mow a lawn... More than the others Beer Collecting You are in desperate need of some beer. Run around and collect any beer you can find before the other Dads find it! Camping Collect important materials located around the map and improve your campsite before it's too dark! Surfing Look back to your glory days and bring back your exceptional surfing skills. Use these old-school skills to stay in the water and avoid waves for as long as possible! Line Waiting You've been dragged to go shopping with your wife, and now you're waiting in line at the checkout. However, there are still so many cool dad things located around the store, so you'll have to sneak out of line and collect them without your wife knowing! Home Improvements Your home is in desperate need of some new improvements, so you're going to build a deck. Scavage through the hardware store and find the items you need to craft the perfect deck for your house. Parkour You've just finished camping out in the middle of nowhere, but now you need to make it back home. Parkour your way through the wilderness, hopping over rivers, and weaving through trees to make it back to your beloved home! Powerups You need some essential upgrades to help you compete against the other dads, so you go shopping. Use your time and points wisely to select the powerups that will give you the greatest advantage in your next minigames. Character Customisation Make your dad look stylish! Create your unique look by customising the colours of your shirt, shoes, skin, shorts, or beard! Also earn shoes, hats, and body accessories while playing Grog to improve your style. If you're lucky, you may even get items that are painted, glowing, or have a special effect! Secrets... Keep a lookout for the legendary Aussie beer bottles. Can you find them all? Why? Well, you see, Darren here is sick and tired of the lack of Australian-dad representation in video games! So, he assigned me the task of creating the greatest Aussie video game, one where he can finally prove that he, and maybe you, are the greatest dads of all time. - School photo of Darren from 1975
row.short_description: Grog is a First-Person, 2-8 player online multiplayer party game where you compete against your friends in various Australian-inspired minigames to see who the greatest Aussie dad is.

row.name: Humpi and Hemicube
row.detailed_description: Step into a mind-bending world where gravity dances to your tune! In this 3d puzzle adventure, you'll navigate through a mesmerizing realm where every object possesses its own gravitational pull. Twist, teleport and turn your way through gravity-defying challenges that'll test your wits and spatial reasoning. It's like sokoban met a zero-g playground, offering a fresh twist as you walk on walls, manipulate gravity and teleport your way to triumph. Get ready to shift your perspective and embrace a gravity all your own! it's monument valley meets sokoban If you like any of this game, you will definitely like this one. Features: ⩥ Wall walking ⩥ Teleports ⩥ Elevators ⩥ NPC's (it moves when you move) Push boxes and make your way through these mind-bending levels . But be careful where you push those box, sometime there will be no way to push them again. So think like a mastermind and find the solution. Portals are great; we all love them, but what will happen if you're stuck in an endless loop? Play and find out for yourself. Just remember to think outside the box, and solutions will come to you.
row.short_description: A sokoban-style puzzle game where everything has its own gravity. Because of this, you can walk on the wall and other things can stay on the wall. You can teleport in this game. Other characters will move when you move, so make a strategy and use this to your advantage to solve puzzles.

row.name: Royale King
row.detailed_description: Enjoy a lot of fun in this popular game where you have to face the traps and time your jump correctly. It's never been more fun to jump and run ahead of your opponents and leave them behind. Be the royal king and enjoy your victory. Avoid the chasm and water or lava. Prove that you can time your jump correctly. You don't have to be the first at the finish line, but above all to survive, and still, it's about first place. Each map is different and has a challenge for you. Are you ready to conquer the unexpected? Prove that you can handle every challenge the game has to offer. The game includes multiple maps and the option to create your own server. Invite your whole family or friends and challenge them to a duel. Be a royal king. There is only one!
row.short_description: Win and be the royal king only you! Think right and jump at the right time.. Only one can win! Be it you!

row.name: Cat Search In The Wild West
row.detailed_description: Yee ha! The cats are hiding all over this western town! Can you find the all? Some cats are more hidden than others. Some rest on the rooftops, others inside buildings, while others in plain view. Keep an eye out for the hidden wanted posters, maybe the cat outlaws are lurking nearby!
