row.short_description: 105 Cats are hiding in this old western town! Can you find them all? Sit back, relax, and explore this hand-drawn western town.

row.name: Escape The Glubinka
row.detailed_description: December 6, 1994. the village of Glubnkovo. You were driving home after a very difficult day along an abandoned village and did not notice a tree peeking out ahead. In an instant, complete darkness overtook you and you passed out. Everything you do next is a continuation of this backstory. To survive the Russian glubinka you need - Fight the habitants of Russian glubinka - Find ammo for your best friend Makarov - Your chances to stay alive will increase by eating bread and drinking high quality ☭hardkvass☭ - Stay out of radiation ejections Additionally - Complete all tasks to get rewards - Collect hidden treasures - Complete all 15 unique achievements - Vasya recommends this game!
row.short_description: December 6, 1994. the village of Glubnkovo. You were driving home after a very difficult day along an abandoned village and did not notice a tree peeking out ahead. In an instant, complete darkness overtook you and you passed out...

row.name: Dumball Rush
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the crazy world of Dumball Rush! Get ready to hit the icy slopes in this online multiplayer party game with your friends (and even your enemies, if they dare). Join a crazy competition of 2 to 8 players , where your Dumballs, live snowballs with hilarious faces and wacky voices, are ready to fight! Take control of your Dumball and roll towards victory by avoiding obstacles and activating powers that will upset the race. It’s snow madness, and no one is immune to the craziest twists and turns! Discover thousands of completely crazy combinations by customizing your Dumball. For this you can change: Its color Its eyes Its mouth And even its voice! Make your friends jealous with the unique look of your Dumball and make sure she is the star of the tracks. Dive into frantic races, explore the Balltown Village for wild snow football matches, or get into completely frosty ice sumo fights! So, ready to hit the slopes with your friends and live Dumball's adventures? Join us in the shattered universe of Dumball Rush and we’ll be on the starting line!
row.short_description: Dumball Rush is an online racing party game from 2 to 8 players with a 3D third person view. The player controls a snowball that is racing against other players. Roll in the snow to be bigger and faster! Avoid obstacles and activate gifts to take advantage and win the race!

row.name: Concentration
row.detailed_description: Play the classic card game of concentration! This is a 2-player game. First, P1 picks two cards, then P2 picks two cards, then P1 again, then P2... this repeats until all cards have been paired off. As for controls, you only need to move the cursor and left-click things. Oh right, you can also use ESC on your keyboard to pause the match, or to skip the card-shuffling intro that plays at the beginning of each match.
row.short_description: Enjoy the classic card game of concentration!

row.name: Beer Strip
row.detailed_description: 👉 The Visual Novels 👄 About the Game If you're a bit older, you know what's this about, if not, then give it a try. It's FREE! It's a game you can beat by improving your skills. Choose one of the four Milfvania girls Catch all the beer bottles while she strips If you drop more than 3 bottles it's GAME OVER. Fully animated poses and actions Bonus image gallery for each girl More girls will be gradually added in future updates.
row.short_description: A tribute to the original, using Milfvania characters!
row.notes: This game contains striptease, provocative dances, sexual innuendo, lewd imagery, and naked depictions of female characters, crude language, intercourse scenes.

row.name: Alone in Space (by RetroVem)
row.detailed_description: INTRO Explore this short sci-fi adventure game with lots of interactivity, interesting plot, a score system and (at least) two endings ;) STORY You are Alexander, the captain of the ship Santa Maria being sent out on a mission to explore the Proxima Centaury planetary system, specifically the Proxima Centauri b exoplanet. But before you would reach your destination, something goes wrong and you have to gather information about what happened while discovering more about yourself, your crew and your ship. SENSE POINTS (SP) Try to keep your mind calm and healthy: the more sense points you have, the better, if it reaches zero, you lose your sanity and the game is over. SCORE For certain actions, you gain scores and in the end, you will see how many more you could have got. Aim for the highest and check everything! CONTROLS AND OPTIONS Arrow keys or left click to move, space bar or left click to interact. Press Esc for the inventory and character screen and to save your game! To always run, press Esc and enable Always Dash in the Options! You can also set volume for sound effects, music etc. under Options. Controllers should be OK but I could only do limited testing, therefore the partial support only. MESSAGE FROM THE CREATOR This is an old project of mine, created entirely by me and now released it here. I wish I had more resources and money to make it better and prettier - please accept the game as is, expect no further updates. Originally planned to make a much larger game but quickly realized I would never finish it. So let me offer you this short but complete game, I hope despite its shortcomings, you will enjoy playing it.
row.short_description: Explore this short 2D sci-fi adventure game with an interactive game environment, interesting plot, a score system and (at least) two endings!

row.name: Groove that Goob
row.detailed_description: Not so long ago… The party-loving Globulons threw a rave so wild that it shattered their cherished Oracle Jukebox––the sole source of music in the Mixolydian Galaxy. To restore cosmic harmony, a lone Globulon named Goob emerges, setting its sights on abducting the Milky Way's source of sound. To do this, Goob must sneak to the top of Astral Ace’s penthouse party in a towering spacescraper. In this top-down, rhythm-stealth game, players groove their way across vibrant dance floors, evade wild partygoers, and absorb dancers to inherit their unique rhythms. Dance like Everyone's Watching Engage in rhythm-stealth gameplay, where each level unfolds a rhythmic adventure. Move consistently to the beat, and elevate your dance style by switching up rhythms through the absorption of fellow dancers. The cosmic party comes alive with Dynamic Dance-Offs, triggered when Goob slips up in front of other dancers. Prove your party prowess in these encounters by matching button inputs with precision and hopefully evading detection. An Absorbent Alien Attacks Unleash Goob's shapeshifting power by absorbing unsuspecting dancers strategically. Goob will not only copy their appearance but also their unique rhythms; use this power wisely to navigate across dangerous dance tiles with cunning and creativity. Groove that Goob invites you to a galaxy where rhythm meets stealth. Dance your way through the vibrant disco, face off in deadly dances, and absorb the essence of the party to orchestrate a cosmic comeback!
row.short_description: Abduct the Milky Way’s Oracle Jukebox located at the top floor of a penthouse party as the shapeshifting, absorbent Goob, fully equipped with a ravenous appetite for melodies, mankind, and mosh pits.

Card Battles • Encounter a variety of different enemies and friends • Draft unique cards, minions, and artifacts to aid you in your fight •SO MANY WAYS TO PLAY •Discard cards for Spirit and summon minions •Sacrifice minions for board space, spirit, and effects •Draft minions that synergize well with one another to build the best team. row.short_description: A 100% FREE unique roguelike deckbuilding experience! Collect cards, relics and monsters, but be careful not to lose your loot. Can you survive the challenge?

row.name: T.I.M.E
row.detailed_description: T.I.M.E is a First-Person, Arena, Boomer Shooter that pits players against each other in a one-on-one contest. Players compete in a round-based first to 3 wins system that is balanced through time rewinding set by the round loser to balance the scales of skill against strategy. Disclaimer This game was a short-term project built over 4 months from scratch (Design, systems, art etc.) by 6 students learning their craft. We are proud of the experience created, and as is the nature of game development, we wish some things could be done differently, but that is life. You may find minor bugs, issues, complaints and wish some things were done differently. But we respectfully ask you to try enjoy the unique experience crafted and take it for what it is. Thank you taking the time ( heh heh heh ) to play our game and even read this. Gameplay The gameplay consists of Online/Networked 1v1 lobbies. In a best-of-five format with one life per round, eliminate your opponent 3 times, you win! However, once an opponent is beaten and the round ends, the loser gets to rewind to any point in time that has previously occurred, this is where the next round will start. Enemy flanked you last round? Rewind so it doesn't happen next time. Enemy picked up the weapon you were after? Rewind and set a trap for them. Not everything is sided for the losing player though, if you win a round, you're one step closer to victory and you also get to choose what Power Weapon is in play. The ultimate way to test pure skill, the removal of 'I would have' or 'I should have'. Now you can, no more excuses! Story T.I.M.E is set in an oppressive alternate reality of a centralized totalitarian government that has failed to succeed in its Utopian plan. Their failure has fractured their diesel-guzzling and highly industrialized society. With no way back on track to their Utopian plan and infighting set in, the top brass have decided to buy themselves some time to make amends. Their solution clouded by idealism, smog, and desperation is to rewind time to a point where they can find out where it all went wrong. With the singular goal of trying to steer the future by correcting this point of divergence. Unfortunately, no one can agree on where things went wrong and who is responsible. This results in conflict among factions of the regime, causing deeper paradoxes, alternate timelines, and crippling confusion. Thrust into the shoes of the upper echelons of the military superpower in their final days the player must deal with their opposition & their time loop. Rewind to alter the outcomes of the future and correct the past, learn from mistakes, and speculate on where this new altered future leads. Rewind until there is peace, rewind to save their Utopia! Combat Wield Diesel-fueled armaments against your former comrades to secure a future for your faction of the regime. Find and use powerups strategically, or brute force a win with a golden power weapon. Rewind Manipulate time at the end of each round, moving yourself into a better position for the next round. Create a paradox that generates new weapons and/or powerups in the combat that tip the scales to your advantage.
row.short_description: T.I.M.E is a First-Person, Arena, Boomer Shooter that pits players against each other in a one-on-one contest. Players compete in a round-based first to 3 wins system that is balanced through time rewinding set by the round loser to balance the scales of skill against strategy.
row.notes: Mature Content - Gun Violence / Blood

row.name: Catch Them Sweetie
row.short_description: Welcome to the card fishing simulator! Time to clear the pond of monsters. Pick a target, build the Deck, and try your Luck! Oh, and don't touch the duck, okay?

row.name: 拯救公主:勇者之约
row.detailed_description: 游戏将完全免费 剧情简介 50年前妖界的一条黑龙进入了人界并撕开了空间裂缝，导致大量魔物入侵人界，人们便称这条龙为恶龙。后来被勇者一行人等封印，还了世界和平。 50年后，恶龙再次苏醒，于是空间裂缝再次打开。国王让当年勇者的孙子赛斯再次踏上封印恶龙的旅程，但不久勇者赛斯便死去，而后主角雷克斯因为长得跟勇者赛斯一模一样，于是阴差阳错的被人误认为是勇者，于是踏上了勇者之路。但雷克斯力量平平，好在邂逅了战斗力异常强大的火魔法师熠熠，开始雷克斯是想拿了国王的赏赐便一走了之，但熠熠却始终限制着雷克斯。而后来雷克斯便喜欢上了熠熠，而熠熠身世并不简单。所以本故事主要还是阐述了一段凄美的爱情故事。 作者寄语 游戏将完全免费，重剧情轻战斗，游戏很简单，用不着练级，不想踩地雷就直接开启”匿踪“，游戏时长大概1-2个小时，但剧情绝对赞就是了。
row.short_description: 勇者斗恶龙世界观的短篇冒险故事

row.name: The Good Plague
row.detailed_description: The Good Plague is a party game to have fun with friends and family, taking place in an imaginary medieval kingdom contaminated by the plague. Play as one of four characters desperately trying to flee the country : The Bard The Thief The Plague Doctor The Warrior Everyone has his own backstory, perks and disadvantages to aid during the game. In order to win, you will have to triumph over the challenges that await during this hazardous journey. The Board: The game board consists of different Points of Interest where you will have to choose where to go in order to earn some money or heal yourself. Mini-games: After each board phase, challenge your opponents in an array of minigames which defines who will play first during the next board phase. Objets: Between each board and minigames phase, you have the possibility to spend your money and buy items. These will aid in your journey or allow you to hinder your opponents.
row.short_description: Uncover a goofy medieval world and its offbeat humor. Choose your hero and challenge your friends and family through a diverse range of minigames in order to escape a plagued kingdom to safety. Playable in local multiplayer from 2 to 4 players.

row.name: VARDIA
row.detailed_description: In a neighborhood plagued by news of kidnappings and murders, a woman who must care for her elderly grandmother takes a job at a roadside motel to work as night manager. While serving the motel's customers, she also witnesses their stories. At the end of these events, reality and delusions intermingle. Are you ready to be alone with the silence and solitude of the night? Go back to the past with vhs aesthetics and reach 3 different endings with the choices you make.
row.short_description: After a series of mysterious events, the only question that will remain in your mind is, were they real? Witness the story of a lonely woman trying to overcome her grandmother's wishes and her new job as a night manager in a motel.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages: Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

row.name: 100 lil jumps
row.detailed_description: Nara the frog has been cursed. Help her complete the challenge in only 100 jumps A simple 2D pixelart platformer Complete all the levels with only 100 jumps Great soundtrack Extra challenges Be a frog Be chill Break the curse
row.short_description: Nara the frog has been cursed and can only make 100 jumps. Complete the challenge and break the curse

row.name: Super RPS
row.detailed_description: Super RPS is a tactical strategy game in which two players have a series of Rock, Paper, Scissors matches on 5 fields concurrently. Each player has a secondary deck of 'Field Cards' that have special abilities that can turn the match in your favor. Join the official BlueExabyte Discord and YouTube, linked both in game, as well as in the links to the right! Online Multiplayer (1v1) play against your friends on Steam or against random players online! Offline VS Bot - sharpen your skills against the bot with the scariest Artificial Intelligence: randomization Strategize to beat players, select the best combo to outsmart your opponents and win Customization colors to change the mood of the game In game chat to talk to your friends while you play Rock++ - Rock beats Paper and Scissors Paper++ - Paper beats Rock and Scissors Scissors++ - Scissors beats Rock and Paper Rock-- - Rock loses to Paper and Scissors Paper-- - Paper loses to Rock and Scissors Scissors-- - Scissors loses to Rock and Paper Reverse - Cards have reverse win conditions (i.e. Paper beats Scissors) Equal Balance - The match on this field results in an automatic draw Ultimate Draw - If there is a draw in this match, the Player who owns the field wins (CPU results in normal draw), other conditions are normal Scapegoat - Auto draw, but points will randomly be assigned to a match on the field Shuffle - The enemy's RPS card will be switched with another of theirs Dud - No field effect
row.short_description: Super RPS is a tactical strategy game in which two players have a series of Rock, Paper, Scissors matches on 5 fields concurrently. Each player has a secondary deck of 'Field Cards' that have special abilities that can turn the match in your favor.

row.name: United Penguin Kingdom: Huddle up
row.detailed_description: Build your settlement and satisfy the needs of your penguins with better food, elegant decorations, entertainment venues, high-tech coolers, and luxury houses while dealing with killer whales and thief seals. Design your penguin settlement Shape a settlement worthy of your penguins. Set up new energy generators to activate more houses, workplaces, and coolers. Build workplaces to produce materials, food, and medicine. Protect your settlement Build defense towers against killer whales and thief seals. Killer whales attack your buildings and try to destroy them. Seals come to the food storages to steal food. Happy and educated penguins Build some entertainment venues and let your penguins enjoy skating in the ice rinks, watching films at cinemas, playing video games in the game centers, racing in the karting tracks, exercising at gyms and in the fight clubs, visiting the museums, doing yoga, etc. Don't forget to focus on the spirituality of your penguins and increase their happiness with shrines and wishing wells. Focus on education and provide enough seats for your penguins at schools, high schools, and libraries. Make a huddle-up call to gather all your penguins and celebrate together. Focus on economy Please be careful with spending your gold and focus on finding ways to earn more. Purchase or make barter to reach rare resources, sell your products to increase wealth, and grow your settlement. If you become the king, you can use continuous trades with the help of your bazaars. Become the King Reputation score is the overall evaluation of your settlement in the kingdom. Meet the requirements, improve your reputation, and cheer up your penguins to level up from a village to a king. Become the king to explore new lands, find new settlements, and decide their joining approval to the kingdom.
row.short_description: This free version of the United Penguin Kingdom covers the content from one year of in-game time. A city-building game where you build a penguin settlement and satisfy the various needs of your penguins while dealing with seals and killer whales.

row.name: Raiders of Valhalla - Prologue
row.detailed_description: ' Raiders of Valhalla: Prologue ' is a free demo for ' Raiders of Valhalla '. In this sneak peek, take charge of a fearless horde of Viking dwarves as they fight valiantly for Valhalla. Fulfill the divine mission bestowed upon you and gear up for epic battles, all while relishing the chance to immerse yourself in the action and strategy that awaits you! Unlock an extensive and diverse selection of equipment, ranging from humble to legendary , and enhance each piece to its utmost potential to harness unmatched power and capabilities Build an army of dwarves with a diverse array of warrior classes , where warriors of the same class can provide group buffs, and each class possesses unique and distinct abilities that set them apart from one another!' Challenge and conquer mighty bosses of immense power ! Defeating these formidable adversaries demands not only sheer strength but also fearless warriors and strategic mastery. Conquer multiple villages nestled in incredibly wild locales! These villages come in different tiers , each offering varying challenges such as the number of enemies, formidable bosses, and unique regions to explore. MAIN FEATURES IN THIS DEMO: • Explore villages of varying levels and challenges. • Build an army of dwarves with unique abilities. • Upgrade equipment to strengthen your troops. • Confront powerful bosses to earn rewards. • Collect coins as loot after raids. • Utilize synergy among warriors of the same class. SEE WHAT AWAITS YOU IN THE FULL GAME: Core Gameplay Elements: • Dwarf Clan Management • City Invasions • Character Classes and Progression • Tactical Challenges Mechanics and Strategy: • Special Abilities and Blessings • Boss Battles • Reinforcements and Battle Strategy • Viking Ship Progression and Narrative: • Resource Gathering • Progression Manager • Story Integration Progression and Customization: • Equipment Enhancement • Legendary Weapons • Forge System • Pet Companions • Skill Tree Development And much more in the full game! Check the Raiders of Valhalla page on Steam!
row.short_description: Lead a fearless horde of Viking dwarves, strengthen them with legendary equipment, conquer unknown lands, and witness the colossal destruction they leave behind. How far will you be able to take your warriors? The journey to glory begins now!

row.name: Cycle Idle RPG
row.detailed_description: An RPG where your character fights automatically, even when you're offline! Gain levels, craft equipment, and optimize your build to face stronger enemies who'll challenge your character's power in different ways! As you advance, you'll unlock new ways to help you strengthen your character - you can focus on growing your garden of beneficial plants, growing your knowledge of monsters in the Bestiary, or creating a powerful deck in the card-based minigame! There are a dozen different subsystems you'll unlock as you advance that'll keep shaking up how you play!
row.short_description: An RPG where your character is constantly grinding - even when you're offline!

row.name: Memoria VR
row.detailed_description: Experience what it means to have dementia and immerse yourself in a reality full of unknown events. A life that is shaped by everyday life and becomes an ever greater obstacle due to the illness. Hand-tracking technology blurs the line between reality and play. Feel the loss of memories and the emotional challenge of the unstoppable disease. In Memoria, you will experience an empathetic journey that raises awareness, awakens compassion and creates understanding for those that are affected. The game requires Handtracking to be enabled on your VR Headset
row.short_description: Memoria utilizes virtual reality to immerse healthy individuals in the experience of dementia symptoms, aiming to foster empathy and awareness regarding the challenges faced by people living with dementia.
row.notes: This game deals with the sickness Dementia. This sensible topic should be enjoyed with caution.

row.name: I commissioned some cats 0
row.detailed_description: Recommended for you About the Game A hidden object game where you must find all the cats and wool to complete each level. Key features: 🖼️ 15 Unique artworks ❓ 1500+ Hidden objects total 🐈 750+ Cats 🧶 750+ Wool 💡 ∞ Unlimited hints if you get stuck ♻️ Restore a small number of hidden objects to a painting so you can find them again! 🎵 Music for each artwork ⌨️ Use your keyboard to move/zoom in if you have no scroll wheel 💾 3x save slots 🗑️ Reset progress entirely and play again 🕒 Timer included to show how long you took to complete each level Context: The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many cats and wool as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, you will have a lot of searching to do. Controls: Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a cat or wool, click it and it will disappear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom. Difficulty: A full range of difficulty is included, but all levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck. Get immersed: Each painting has its own music to help you connect with the world, as you search for everything. Replayable You can restore a small number of hidden objects back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few hidden objects left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 3 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.
row.short_description: Play for free! I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

row.name: Bring Me that Shawarma
row.detailed_description: In this visual novel you’ll find out: how dangerous white sauce can be, what humanization of shawarma looks like, whose yelling is heard on the streets of Samara at night, and what secrets hide within the kitchens of elite shawarma shops. WHERE THE STORY BEGINS... Episode 2: Fear and Loathing in Samara Gray days, work, depression... Sometimes it feels like there's nothing that can make you happy. Only shawarma can help chase away the sorrow and bring back the colors of the world. But what to do if you suddenly find out that your favorite shawarma shop is open for one final day? Episode 3: Bring Me that Shawarma Roman is an ordinary courier from not the most prestigious food delivery company. Lately, strange things have been happening in the city: animals have begun to behave differently and the people around them seem to be in a sinister conspiracy. Will our protagonist be able to deliver the shawarma and still stay alive? You can find a full description of each episode in the game. 6 MAIN AND 2 BONUS EPISODES ARE AVAILABLE NOW FEATURES An episodic visual novel within the same universe consisting of these genres: thrash, comedy, aliens, horror, thriller and some food horror/body horror High-quality anime-style graphics combined with real-life photos and environments An anxious dark atmosphere, which will be conveyed to the player through unusual sounds and visual effects Screen resolution 1440x1080 px (4:3 aspect ratio)
row.short_description: A visual novel about shawarma, consisting of multiple episodes.

row.name: EX-XDRiVER
row.detailed_description: In the distant future, the CYBERACE cybernetic research enterprise is holding their very first 'EX-XDRiVER Championship,' a racing championship with a priceless reward—any cybernetic enhancement that the winner desires. With such an enticing reward, contestants have traveled from around the world to compete in a high stakes, winner-take-all tournament in hopes to make their deepest desires come true. RIDE THE NEON CIRCUIT Immerse yourself in a futuristic landscape of neon, sleek raceways and an addicting high-energy soundtrack. Enjoy a track list with over 15 artists providing a wide variety of original music & licensed songs! PUSH THE LIMITS OF RACING Traditional rhythm game gameplay will be easy to learn but require mastery and practice as you tackle technical high-level tracks. Obtain 'LIMITs' from hitting notes and drifts as accurately as you can—go for perfect scores, faster finish times, and world records! HONE YOUR SKILLS, COMPETE FOR GLORY Play solo in an arcade-style credits mode to unlock songs for Free Play—or if you're feeling competitive, connect online and race against others to see who deserves the title of XDRV Champion!
row.short_description: EX-XDRiVER is a futuristic arcade-style rhythm game with racing game elements. Master precise gameplay over tracks from a growing list of artists, and use drifting to your advantage to sweep the competition!

row.name: FireChess
row.detailed_description: FireChess is a chess-like game that includes elements of economy and spell casting. Join the discord here: Players earn a base gold each turn. They earn additional gold when occupying gold spaces. Gold can be used to purchase pieces from the shop and place them on the board. Special mage pieces can move and use abilities but cannot capture. Double-clicking on a mage allows a player to use their special ability. Fire Mage - Creates a fire in an unoccupied space. Pieces that move through fire are removed. Frost Mage - Freezes a unit. Frozen pieces cannot move or use abilities during this time. Fog Mage - Creates a 3x3 fog area. Pieces inside a fog space are invisible to opponents. Kinetic - Force a piece to move over 1 space to any unoccupied square. Waymaker - Spawns a portal tunnel. Pieces can move through the portals covering large distances. Pawns can even be promoted after moving through a portal to the last rank! Swapper - Swaps 2 pieces. These can be ally or enemy pieces. Scout - Can't capture but can't be taken either, except by kings. Scouts can clear fog and fire. This game is in active development. We are a small team and any ideas or feedback are much appreciated! You can provide feedback via email: firechessgaming@gmail.com or through our discord channel. More pieces to come!
row.short_description: Unleash a new level of chess tactics with mages that can create fires, freeze opponents, introduce fog of war and more. Capture gold spaces to earn income which can be used to strengthen your army!

row.name: Methods: The Illusion Murders
row.detailed_description: Now available for free, discover a mystery story set in the world of Methods: The Detective Competition . Red July, an up-and-coming celebrity detective, is challenged by The Illusion Killer — a serial killer who patterns his murders after optical illusions. However, in the course of solving the murder, Red July's famous method — which lets her instantly solve any crime — stops working. Now the race is on to stop the killer before it's too late! The game is a mystery visual novel that lets you examine evidence with a short interactive puzzle mini-game. Featuring Interactive game Original soundtrack Dynamic Storytelling Distinctive Artwork Immersive Game World Unique DLC to Methods: The Detective Competition (100 detectives VS 100 Criminals) Playing Methods: The Detective Competition first is highly recommended, but not required to understand the story.
row.short_description: Detective Red July must stop a serial killer who patterns his murders after optical illusions in this mystery visual novel set in the world of Methods.

row.name: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant Playtest
Crush Link TD
row.detailed_description: DON'T WASTE YOUR CHANCE! Your task is to protect your base preventing spam from getting into your inbox. Build towers in marked places to stop spam. Crush Link TD is an unusual Tower Defense strategy game where you will meet unexpected mobs, defeat various bosses, upgrade virtual towers, earn in-game achievements and arrange a date with your crush. STORY You have a popular profile in the Crush Link dating app and receive hundreds of messages every day. On the eve of St. Valentine's Day you find your crush. After a short chat you decide to meet tomorrow evening and agree on everything in the morning. The next morning you discover that the chat with your crush is lost among other messages. It's time to clean up all this spam. MESSAGE FROM THE DEVELOPMENT TEAM We are an international indie team with different experience, background, beliefs, and characters. The game was inspired by classics of the tower defense genre. The concept was created within a local game jam with the topic of St. Valentine’s Day. During the development process, we moved away from romance as the main theme, maintaining references to this topic, but giving preference to the interests of a wider audience, such as virtual networks and online dating. The initial idea was to give up the typical fantasy setting of the genre and bring a new twist to gameplay. That’s how mechanics of path changing and moving towers with losing one level appeared. Another feature of the game is the developing storyline. The Player is to discover a chat of two individuals who met on the dating app, liked each other, and are trying to set up a romantic date. In the texts and naming of game objects we tried to implement references to famous game titles, sitcoms, and media classics. Intentionally we filled the game with self-irony and humor but it’s up to you to judge if it worked. The title itself refers to the main objective of the game – to build a link with the Crush by deleting spam and finding their message. Finally we are proud of our visual and sound. Everything in the game is handmade by 4TEAMGB members except for avatars that were made with a third-party avatar creator engine and later edited by our artist. Neon lights are the visual core, and you can hear motives of the 80’s and notes of lo-fi and synthwave in our electronic soundtracks. We put all our love and passion into Crush Link TD and hope that you will enjoy it. Your feedback is very appreciated. Thank you! 4TEAMGB

row.name: FairiTeller
row.detailed_description: A story-based retro RPG: built upon impactful decisions, intense battles and challenging puzzles. Every life form that dwells within this world is comprised of two halves: Yang - One's physical body, and Yin - One's life force. Over time, creatures learned to harness this life force, and developed the Five Manifests of Yin : Shroud - To envelop one's body in Yin; boosting attributes like strength, immunity, speed, etc. Create - To form a worldly item from Yin. Summon - To conjure a creature from Yin. Orient - To control the position of objects through Yin. Mutate - To change the form of one's Yin into one of the four elements. However, playing as a Fairi, you are unable to use Yin whatsoever. Instead you must overcome fights, puzzles and decisions all whilst searching for your place in this world. The road will not be easy, as the majority of the population capable of using Yin frowns upon the Fairi kind. Thankfully, a partner will soon join you, one capable of gifting the basics of Yin unto you. Both your decisions will shape the personality of the other...
row.short_description: A story-based retro RPG: built upon impactful decisions, intense battles and challenging puzzles.

Solve puzzles by activating platforms and deactivating lasers to ultimately escape the facility and save Nasu. Master the movement - Learn to propel yourself in all directions while simultaneously avoiding dangers. 15 unique levels - Play through 15 fun and challenging levels to test your skills. [*[b]]Completionism [/b]- Can you collect all the coins? Maybe you'll even be rewarded. row.name: EOS RAGNAROK
row.detailed_description: The Twisted Dimensions lurk beyond mortal perception and defy common comprehension. Multi realms exist atop one another, bleeding energies across shared boundaries, and threatening to tear each other apart. Only the Gods can even comprehend the nature of this threat, and only the Soulkeepers, those chosen by the Goddess Frigg, can stand against it. The Frigga Union of Soulkeepers, hitherto tasked with persuit of the vile Naez, now work to research and unravel the paradox of the Twisted Dimensions before this mass of shattered realms consumes itself. They discovered that Naez originates from the Soul of Agony. The original task of the Soulkeepers was to seek out the taint of the corrupted blood of the Primal Giants, enemies of the Gods, and return the Giants to the Soul Stream. Thus would the world remain in balance. Naez used the power of Soul of Agony to direct the extracted souls into herself instead of the Soul Stream. Thus, the flow of souls was disrupted, and the boundaries between the worlds weakened. To counter the damage inflicted by Naez, Souls of Chaos must be gathered and delivered to the Soul Stream. The Frigga Union is focused on this task, holding the doom of the world at bay, until the time comes to attack the threat at its source…
row.short_description: Echo of Soul is a free-to-play Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game with a fast-paced action combat, various character customizations and no subscription fee required. Travel the vast open world, compete in PvP modes, and explore EoS.

row.name: Pestilence
row.detailed_description: Pestilence is a first-person stealth game in which you play as the Lord of the Pestilence, a betrayed God who seeks revenge against his brothers. To accomplish this, you will need to kill your brothers' Judges , the ruling caste of the city of Trumana. You will traverse the town's shadows as a malevolent force, using your uncanny ability to possess and sow chaos between its people. FEATURES Find your next host Take advantage of your possession powers to infiltrate Trumana's souls, becoming the puppeteer of their destiny. Each citizen has access to certain locations depending on their archetype. Infiltrate and reclaim what is yours Experience heart-pounding stealth gameplay where you use a diverse set of abilities to outsmart your siblings' relentless followers. Create distractions with the infection, scan your surroundings with the pulse, get into hard-to-reach areas by teleporting. Combine these skills to find new ways to overcome each situation. Find how your legacy has changed Play as the villain and delve into the depths of Trumana's dark past, where ancient conflicts and sibling rivalries shape the present. This game is a university project by videogame students at U-tad.
row.short_description: Pestilence is a first-person stealth game in which you play as the Lord of the Pestilence, a betrayed God who seeks revenge against his brothers. Make use of your uncanny abilities to infiltrate this Spanish inspired city and infect their leaders.

row.name: Fairytale Fables

Earn gold to buy characters and items, cast spells and find treasures in the Shop Phase, then watch your choices come to life in automatic fights. row.name: Prophan Escape
row.detailed_description: INFORMATION ABOUT THE GAME: DESCRIPTION: 'Prophan Escape' is a game that combines horror with an absurd sense of humor. Imagine the typical game about 'The Backrooms', and now imagine that, with the same horror aura, but full of shitpost... That is Prophan Escape. GAMEPLAY: In 'Prophan Escape,' your objective is to collect five copper statues scattered throughout a labyrinth to complete each level. It's that simple... Well, there are also two anthropomorphic, peculiar cubes with realistic limbs that are out to get you. So, you'll need to avoid these strange characters. After completing each level, you will receive a 'tartortilla,' a peculiar food item that reveals a piece of the game's lore. PLOT: 'You have just awoken in a strange place that looks like a labyrinth but you have no idea of how you got there. The only thing you know is that you must find your way out, and quickly.' FEATURES -Immersive 90s VHS atmosphere. -Simple mechanics. -Approximately 2 hours of gameplay. -A thrilling lore behind the game. -5 levels (including a tutorial). -Tense horror gameplay. -Challenging labyrinths. -Silly comedy and humor. -And also sexy legs.

row.name: Rumble Club
row.detailed_description: Don’t Fall. Don’t Stumble. RUMBLE! Enter the Rumble Club arena, a hilarious physics-based multiplayer Battle Royale. Grab your squad, or charge into the slapstick arena solo against 19 other players. Punch, push, throw, and bait your opponents—and maybe your friends, too… Fly in on Captain Punch’s Sky Yacht, get bopped into the arena, and find powerful and ridiculous Gadgets to battle with. With constantly changing game modes, get ready to mix it up with your friends, from eating cupcakes to being the last Punchie standing. But not everything is winning. You’ll also want to look good while doing it. PHYSICS FUN FOR EVERYONE! Send foes flying with a well-timed haymaker. Got them down for the count? Throw them into the goop to finish them off. Just watch out for that massive wrecking ball swinging right towards you! BRING A GADGET TO A FISTFIGHT! Not all battles are won with your fists. Find silly gadgets on the battlefield for an advantage. Boombox? Punch Tank? A Giant Menacing Magic Donut? Try them all! LOOK GOOD, PUNCH GOOD! Collect and choose between tons of cosmetics. Fancy a Tuxedo? Wizard Hat? Mankini? Or maybe that hat with the safari flaps—I’m sure you can pull it off. GAME MODES GALORE! New game modes and arenas are added each season and mixed up daily! Dive into each one solo or with friends and battle to be the true champion of the arena! RUMBLE WITH YOUR FRIENDS! Message your friends and meet them on the battleground. Work together to complete fun Quests to earn rewards and unlock exclusive cosmetics!

row.name: Wonder Ball
row.detailed_description: Main features Explore Cyberland : Discover five worlds packed with platforming levels, combat arenas, and secrets. Collectibles & Upgrades : Gather coins, gems, and microchips to upgrade Wonder Ball's abilities. Customizable Gameplay : Adjust settings, including compass markers, camera, and controls. Time Attack & Survival Mode : Unlock arcade modes with online leaderboards. Achievements & Stats : Earn achievements that add extra challenges and goals. Optimized for Handheld : Play on devices like the Steam Deck with full controller support. Enhanced Visuals : Features FSR, DLSS, and DLAA support for improved performance and graphics. Story Peaceful worlds of Cyberland are under attack by the malicious Virus and its army of bots! Now it’s up to you to take control of Wonder Ball and save Cyberland before it’s too late! Core Gameplay Many of the greatest classics of the platforming genre are filled with crates or some other blocks to destroy. Wonder Ball stays true to this beloved mechanic and gives players multiple options on how to deal with crates. You can dash, slam, or use Wonder Ball’s attack ability to destroy them! Explore Cyberland Wonder Ball is an action-packed 3D platformer where you explore five worlds of Cyberland. Every world is essentially a massive hub, full of platforming levels, combat arenas, many collectibles, and secrets. Choose your level of exploring at the start of the game or change it anytime during gameplay by customizing markers shown on the compass. Or turn the compass off completely and become a true explorer! Every hub is filled with numerous collectibles of different kinds. Collecting coins will help you get extra repair kits and gems will grant you extra shields which will become vital while fighting in combat arenas. Collected microchips can be used to upgrade Wonder Ball’s abilities and become a real threat to the Virus and its bots. Combat Arenas Battle against an army of bots spawned by the Virus in combat arenas of increasing difficulty and earn all the medals! Platforming Levels Challenges built to test your platforming skills with an optional reward for destroying all crates. Time Attack & Survival Mode As you progress through the game's main story mode, you will unlock two arcade modes featuring online leaderboards. Challenge yourself to achieve the best time on all platforming levels in Time Attack mode, or battle through waves of bots in Survival mode to get the highest score across all combat tiers. Customize your game experience Wonder Ball offers a variety of gameplay settings. You can customize the compass, camera, key bindings, and all sorts of graphics settings as well. My game also comes equipped with support for FSR, DLSS, and DLAA. Note: The performance improvement gained from upscaling technology may vary depending on the hardware used.
row.short_description: An action 3D platformer with fast-paced gameplay and low-poly style graphics, inspired by the greatest classics of the genre. Full of platforming levels, combat arenas, many collectibles and secrets. Explore five worlds of Cyberland and save them from the malicious Virus and its army of bots!

row.name: Mazes and Labyrinths
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Mazes and Labyrinths, a deceptively difficult single screen puzzle game set in the fantasy world of Antinomia. Play as Will and Ari as you battle the prophet Sybilla and the invading Omniety, an alien being reshaping the planet to its whims. Use your wits, powers, and even the enemies themselves to find an exit to every maze and save Antinomia and its people from certain destruction. Created by OnlineVideoSurfer, Mazes and Labyrinths features over 70 puzzles in the main campaign plus a robust level editor to make and play your own levels. For more dedicated players, most levels also feature a bonus medal to truly test your ability to break the game. The goal is an almost arcade-puzzle experience, with short, bite-sized levels and simple graphics that nevertheless disguise deeply complex, rule-based design. Learning the intricacies of the powerups, the enemies, and the full implications of your abilities is essential to both mastering the campaign and making your own mazes for others. There are no pay to win mechanics, no in-game currencies, nor any other monetization features to diminish the game. This is a free game made by one person for anyone that wants challenging yet thoughtful puzzles or desires to make their own levels. Persevere and overcome the challenges and you will hopefully find a rewarding puzzle game that, by the endgame, will push your reasoning to its limits. For everyone that tries, I wish you luck.

row.name: Nonogram Nights
row.detailed_description: NONOGRAM NIGHTS is a spooky puzzler where you use logic to uncover a mysterious picture. The numbers along the side indicate how many consecutively shaded squares appear in each row or column. Solving the puzzle slowly unveils a mysterious image, but watch out—the pictures are spooky! Every NONOGRAM NIGHTS puzzle is uniquely solvable, so you never have to guess for a solution. Explore a haunted mansion in adventure mode . Solve 20+ spooky puzzles to defeat the monsters that lurk around every corner. In random mode , you can play an infinite number of (solvable!) puzzles that are different each time. The game also features a quick tutorial, an options menu, and some secrets! This game is completely free. It has no ads.

row.name: Party PooperZ
row.detailed_description: About this game Party Pooperz is an awesome chaotic party game, where you compete against your friends. The fate of tonight’s party theme rests on your shoulders, steal guests and use items to make your party the most popular. Let the battle for the most legendary party begin! Donna, Matt, John and Molly live together and have decided to throw an epic party, one that their friends will remember forever. However, there’s a slight problem - they can’t settle on the music genre for the party. They have a really big fight about what’s the coolest choice. Is Donna correct with her preference for disco, or perhaps Molly, who’s a big fan of DnB, is onto something? Or could John be right, and jazz is the way to go? In this game, you and your friends get to decide the best music genre together! Settle the battle by hosting competing parties in the same room at the same time. Use a pizza item to lure party guests to your party, or throw a bottle to make your friend a little dizzy ;). Or… you can simply throw the party guests to your party and just force them into liking your party! Can you ‘throw’ the biggest party? Pick Up and Play This game is designed for everyone to enjoy. You only need to use two buttons: a button to move and a button to throw party people, pick up, and use items! This way, even people who don't often play games can join in. Choose Your Music Genre Party Pooperz is a game that explores the question of the best music genre. What music genres do your friends like? Disco, hip hop, jazz, or something wilder? Choose your favorite and throw the best party! Throw a party by throwing people! In this game, you can throw people to your party and let others see which party they would enjoy the most. Whack-a-Friend In Party Pooperz, it's not just about partying – it's about a good-natured brawl! Got a buddy you're dying to give a playful wallop? Wield a guitar or a candy stick and spread some party cheer right across their noggin. Use Items Sabotage other players using various items. Use a matras to defend yourself from other players. Be strategic to make the most of this item! What's a party without pizza? Use the pizza item to attract people to your party. Make other players too dizzy to control their movements with the bottle item. Throw it at other players to use it. Use the water pistol to shoot away other players from your party or to bring party people to your party. Put on some good shoes and dance all night long. These shoes make you move a lot quicker!
row.short_description: Party Pooperz is an awesome chaotic partygame, where you compete against your friends. The fate of tonight's party theme rests on your shoulders, steal guests and use items to make your party the most popular. Let the battle for the most legendary party begin!
