row.detailed_description: Welcome to the intergalactic battleground! Immerse yourself in a sci-fi setting where waves of relentless robots, known as Xul'Gorgs, threaten the galaxy. As a member of the Intergalactic Peacemaker, your mission is clear: survive endless waves, defeat mini-bosses, confront the ultimate end boss, and emerge victorious. Arena Shooter Dynamics: Engage in fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled combat as you navigate through different arenas, facing the hordes of Xul'Gorgs. The gameplay is centered around defeating enemies with epic guns and helpful abilities. Gain strength through failure and return stronger on your next run to defeat the endboss. Protagonist - Cy: Take control of Cy, a skilled operative from the Intergalactic Peacemaker. Customize Cy's loadout by choosing from a wide array of weapons and abilities, each offering unique advantages to suit your preferred playstyle. Randomized Items: Keep each playthrough fresh and unpredictable with a pool of 60 different items. Adapt your strategy on the fly by randomly acquiring items during your journey, enhancing your arsenal and augmenting Cy's capabilities. Boss Battles: Confront powerful mini-bosses and a formidable end boss, each presenting unique challenges. Your skills will be put to the test as you progress through increasingly difficult encounters. Difficulty Settings: Tailor the experience to your skill level with 6 difficulty tiers. Whether you're a seasoned veteran or a newcomer looking for a challenge, find the right balance to keep the gameplay exciting and rewarding. Furthermore you can in- or decrease specific parts of the game with modificators to gain more or less EXP and Money. Early Access Focus: In Early Access, we aim to refine and expand upon these core mechanics based on player feedback. Your insights will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of this rogue-lite arena shooter, ensuring an engaging and ever-evolving experience for all players. Join us in the battle against the Xul'Gorgs and help us make this intergalactic adventure truly unforgettable!
row.short_description: CyVenge is a fast paced and action packed rougelite arena shooter. Choose from many upgradable weapons and abilities and help Cy fight against numerous waves of enemies!

row.name: Niwa - Japanese Garden Simulator
row.detailed_description: Niwa - Japanese Garden Simulator is a gardening simulator set in Kyoto, Japan, the birthplace of zen gardens. By playing Niwa - Japanese Garden Simulator you will learn authentic Japanese gardening techniques and how to apply them to realistic reproductions of historical locations in the city. You will learn the basic elements of traditional garden composition: stones, plants and water. Then use these techniques to create your own gardens. Learn from a master As a new apprentice to a famous gardening company, you will be tasked with creating, repairing and updating public and private gardens. Each level has a number of tasks for you to complete where you will gain unique skills and insightful knowledge about these special locations. Experience various kinds of gardens There are a large variety of Japanese garden types, and your work will bring you to each of them: dry gardens, temple gardens, tsubo-niwas, tea gardens and moss gardens. Feast your eyes The Visual aspect is important to enjoying Japanese gardens. The game also includes a photo mode, which allows you to take photographs of your garden creations and share them with friends. Niwa - Japanese Garden Simulator attempts to simulate as closely as possible the true look of plants, stones and the surroundings so that photos come out looking like the real thing. Relax amongst the soothing landscapes Escape from your urban life and find refuge amongst nature. Unwind and discover the calming ambiance of your garden.
row.short_description: Niwa - Japanese Garden Simulator is a gardening simulator that gives you the freedom to design your own zen gardens. Set in Kyoto, Japan, you are tasked with learning authentic Japanese gardening techniques and applying them to realistic reproductions of historical locations in the city.

row.name: ◒ Achievement Shades
row.detailed_description: Achievements are either locked or unlocked. When you have hundreds or even thousands of achievement icons to create, it can be a hassle to create all the ‘locked’ versions of each one as well. How can we solve this? Achievement Shades instantly exports locked versions of any achievement icons dropped over the window, with custom settings applied. Customisation - Darkness (0-100%) - Saturation (0-100%) Your choice is preserved between sessions, and the exact specifications are shown in the top of the window while you adjust them for later reference. These can also be accessed from the save file in your app data. License ✔ Personal use ✔ Commercial use Using this software does not strip an image of its copyright or license, nor does it impose any further restrictions. Images exported by Achievement Shades are bound by the same license they held prior to being exported. Limitations - Images must be PNG / JPG - Images cannot be larger than 4096x4096
row.short_description: Instantly generate locked versions of your achievement icons, in bulk (and for free)!

row.name: Betrayal Beach
row.detailed_description: Betrayal Beach is an online social deduction survival game for 4-8 players. Crash landed on a strange island, a group of survivors must work together to survive long enough for rescue to come. However, 1-2 players are working as saboteurs. Blending in with the survivors of the crash, their goal is to make sure none leave the island alive. Collect resource cards to contribute to objectives or keep yourself alive. Craft useful gear, such as spears to fend off animal attacks or a basket to carry more resources. Manage your health, hunger, and limited inventory space. Deliberate with fellow survivors and vote to exile the saboteur from camp. Play as 3 unique roles with extra abilities. Blend in with the survivors to gain their trust. Sabotage objectives to stall the survivors' progress and put them in danger. Unleash Suffering by activating strange totems and opening mysterious caches. Lie , deceive, betray, and sow chaos! Play as 2 unique roles with extra abilities. Each day is separated into timed phases. Forage during the day and deliberate exile at night. Vote to exile possible saboteurs and throw them into a volcano. Built-in voice and text chat to communicate with fellow survivors or saboteurs. Choose your character's look from a variety of styles. Unlock seat cosmetics through achievements. More to come!
row.short_description: Crashed on a strange island, survivors must forage, craft, and complete objectives to stay alive. But ferocious beasts, harsh weather, and secret saboteurs seek to make sure they never escape. Betray your friends or survive the island in Betrayal Beach, a 4-8 player social deduction survival game.

row.name: The Final Countdown
row.detailed_description: The Final Countdown은 FPS와 타워 디펜스를 결합한 게임으로, 적의 약점을 공략하고 타워마다 다른 강화를 적용하여 자신만의 전략으로 웨이브에 대응할 나만의 전략을 만들 수 있습니다. 약점을 공략하세요 적들은 각각의 고유한 약점을 가지고 있고, 이를 플레이어의 사격으로 공략하여 적들을 무력화할 수 있습니다. 날아다니는 적을 격추하거나 기절시키는 등 핵심 기능을 저지할 수 있는 것은 플레이어의 무기가 가진 고유한 역할입니다. 타워를 강화하세요 타워는 화력을 강화할 수도 있지만, 타워마다 2개씩 적용 가능한 모듈을 가지고 있습니다. 타워 종류마다 다른 효과의 모듈을 가지고 있어 타워마다 다른 역할을 부여할 수 있습니다. 자신을 영구적으로 강화하세요 스테이지를 클리어하면 얻을 수 있는 배터리는 영구적인 강화에 사용할 수 있습니다. 갈수록 강해지는 적들의 공세에 맞게 유연한 업그레이드로 대처하세요. 과연 당신은 모든 위협을 이겨내고 탈출선 출발 직전의 '마지막 카운트다운'까지 버틸 수 있을까요?
row.short_description: The Final Countdown은 FPS와 타워 디펜스를 결합한 전략 게임입니다. 적들의 약점을 공략하고 업그레이드를 통해 타워마다 다른 역할을 부여하며 적들의 공세에 맞서 마지막 카운트다운이 끝나는 순간까지 살아남으세요!

row.name: Archery Showdown
row.detailed_description: Who Will Be the Archer Master? Archery Showdown is a classic 2D pixel art platformer where you can challange with your friends in an archery-balistic 2D fighting! * GAMEPAD IS REQUIRED FOR LOCAL PVP! The Game Archery Showdown tests your aim in an epic duel to the last arrow! Grab your bow, tighten the string and get ready to fire! In this exciting 1vs1 game, you will be thrown into a breathtaking arena, where you and your opponent will compete in thrilling archery duels. Challenge yourself in breathtaking environments, from mysterious forests to medieval dungeons and much more. Test your archery skills as you aim and shoot arrows with precision. The target is your opponent, and the objective is only one: to hit him before he does the same! It will be a test of skill, reactivity and cold blood. Archery Showdown is a challenging experience suitable for players of all ages, with pixelart graphics, intuitive controls and ever-changing challenges. Whether you're a newbie or an arc veteran, this game will captivate you from start to finish. Features Play online with Steam Remote Play! 2D platformer in a cute pixel art world! Archery balistic shooting with arrows and powerups. Vast set of arenas to compete. Play with gamepad or keyboard.
row.short_description: Archery Showdown is a local PvP platformer where you can challange with your friends in an archery-balistic 2D fighting!

row.name: Delator
row.detailed_description: Delator is a cosmic horror puzzle-platformer inspired by the world of H.P. Lovecraft and by The Tell-Tale Heart of Edgar Allan Poe, where we play the role of a skittish doctor chosen by the cult of Delator to be the last sacrifice. Instead of running away, you must find the heart of Delator and end your nightmares before they end up consuming you. Explore and unravel the secrets of this town through puzzles and don't let the enemies get to you with the help of your lamp. *Hide from the gaze of Delator Hide from the cosmic entity making use of stealth to keep moving forward with your sanity intact. *Hallucinations Enter a different plane of reality to engage in intricate puzzles and where everything is how it used to be.
row.short_description: Overcome your deepest nightmares and face your unavoidable fate. `Delator´ is a cosmic horror puzzle-platformer where you will play the role of a skittish doctor chosen by the cult of Delator to be the last sacrifice.

row.name: Kerker
row.detailed_description: As a power hungry adventurer you set out to the forgotten dungeons to test both your might and your luck. Treacherous enemies, dangerous traps and ever changing dungeon floors are all out to stop you in your tracks. Do you have what it takes to make it out alive again and again? The dungeons are full of loot, enemies and greedy shopkeepers. Gather enough wealth to acquire stronger weapons and abilities to take on harder dungeons with even better loot. Key features: Dynamically generated dungeons Different objectives for dungeon floors Fight over 8 different enemies! Slay your foes with over 10 unique weapons! Mix and match special abilities! Secret rooms, if you have a keen eye Grow stronger by completing sequences of dungeon floors without dying Perish and lose everything you have gained, be careful!
row.short_description: Kerker is a procedurally generated dungeon crawler FPS roguelike that challenges the player with its varying cast of enemies, exclusive weapons and different dungeon types. Fight your way to riches by slaying foes, obtaining/combining unique abilities and finding forgotten treasures.

row.name: Agnostic Requiem
row.detailed_description: The text of the game is about 60,000 words, and it takes about two hours to play. This is a tale of celebrating and rebelling against this peculiar world, where all joys and sorrows originate from the end, reflecting the 'beginning.'  In 'Agnostic Requiem,' you will play as Shang Chenyue, a young girl who has lost her dear friend (probably this name...?), in order to investigate the truth behind her friend's death. You will delve into the mysterious religious conflicts with her, peeling away the layers of lies that shroud faith, and seeking the illusory truth of this world. Facing the worship that has taken root in this world for millions of years, the girl is not the first rebel, but she is the luckiest one. She has the fortune to encounter the heart of tragedy in the vortex called life, and with it, she uncovers the long-standing roots of conspiracy. In the face of the truth, should she remain in the peaceful illusion or unveil the curtain of this dream, revealing the world's grim nature to the world?  Perhaps, as she explores the truth, you will also catch glimpses of things that subvert cognition from this bottomless and vast vortex. Observe this story carefully, for all the answers have quietly emerged.
row.short_description: This is a cry of struggle amidst lies, a rebellious song composed by a girl with her life, a truth buried deep within falsehood. Making choices for girls who are sinking in helplessness and clicking the noble mouse to spread the gospel of redemption-seemingly the only hope for them in that world.

row.name: Pelagos: A Marine Adventure
row.detailed_description: Dive deep into the mesmerizing world of Pelagos! Crafted with Unity 3D, this marine photography game takes you on a tranquil journey through the enchanting California Kelp Forests. You'll be swimming through the debut level, surrounded by the unique flora and fauna of this vibrant biome. As you explore, you'll have the chance to photograph a myriad of marine creatures. And here's the cool part: every time you snap a photo, you'll learn the name of the organism and save it in your very own in-game gallery. Whether it's a playful sea otter or the towering kelp canopies, every shot you take adds to your collection. But 'Pelagos' isn't just about capturing the beauty of the marine world. As you navigate the kelp forests, you'll stumble upon discarded trash—a stark reminder of the pollution threatening these pristine waters. Your mission? Photograph all the hidden trash. It's not just about cleaning up; there's a special surprise waiting for you once you capture it all! And if you think you've seen it all, think again! Replay the levels to discover new angles, hidden species, and secret spots. And keep an eye out—the Great Barrier Reef level is coming soon! So, are you ready to dive in, learn, and make a difference? It's a 'gotta photograph 'em all' kind of adventure in Pelagos!
row.short_description: Dive into Pelagos: Snap, Learn & Explore Marine Ecosystems!

row.name: Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters
row.detailed_description: You are the captain Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters ® is a classic space game that captures the charm of retro science-fiction, space combat, and high adventure. Your story begins as the captain of the last human starship, with Earth trapped under a hostile forcefield. You are the last hope for humanity in a fight for control of the galaxy, as you explore thousands of unknown worlds and get dozens of quirky aliens to help. Meet fascinating alien characters ​The galaxy is thriving with alien species, each with unique mysteries and motives. Meet an eclectic cast of characters, brought to life with full English voiceover. Ask sharp questions, make new friends, and exchange colorful insults. Adventure through HyperSpace Discover a vibrant galaxy filled with wonder, terror, and absurdity. Explore thousands of uncharted worlds across hundreds of stars, and gather important resources and technology. Battle your rivals in starship combat Build your fleet and battle enemy starships, facing off against friends or the computer-controlled AI. Play action-packed Super Melee as its own mode, or as part of the single-player adventure – or choose automated combat to stay focused on the story. Experience a sci-fi classic – for free! As a celebrated piece of gaming history, Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters ® has also received wide acclaim for its story, characters, and setting. It was created as a love letter to classic science fiction like Douglas Adams, David Brin, and Jack Vance. In turn, its setting inspired a new wave of game creators, including the visionaries behind Mass Effect , No Man’s Sky , Subnautica , Starfield , Fallout , and Stellaris – to name just a few. In 2002, the game was released under an open source license thanks to the generosity of Paul Reiche and Fred Ford. It continues to be available to play as a free download, for game historians and fans to enjoy. Game features Experience an open-world adventure, venturing through space to defeat the invading Ur-Quan and its hierarchy of battle thralls. Travel through extra-dimensional HyperSpace and discover nearly 500 unknown star systems filled with alien worlds. Fight enemies in fast-paced space battles with 25 different starships, each with its own unique attacks and powers. Befriend, threaten, or fight a diverse cast of aliens with unique personalities, from scary, to funny, to just plain weird. Explore thousands of planets, collecting resources and technology to upgrade your flagship and grow your fleet. Play standalone Super Melee to practice space combat against AI opponents or to duel against a friend. Mod and tinker with freely available, open-source code and content.
row.short_description: Experience the award-winning space saga. Travel to hyperspace, discover alien worlds, and meet an eclectic cast of characters. Find out what happened after the Ur-Quan invasion. And if the war still rages, fight for Earth and the Alliance of Free Stars!
row.reviews: “... one of the greatest games of all time.” IGN “One of the finest space exploration games ever made.” Retro Gamer Cover Feature “... a hitchhiker's fight for the galaxy.” PCGamesN: Best Space Games
row.notes: Game contains some audio and text descriptions implying sexual conduct.

row.name: The Holyburn Witches
row.detailed_description: A pure survival-horror experience, featuring real panoramic photographs that capture the fear and solitude of being alone in a haunted forest. The thick atmosphere will crawl under your skin, and every nerve-wracking moment will leave you desperate for escape. In the once tranquil village of Holyburn, Maine, a series of horrific incidents left scars that still linger. Unexplained sounds and sightings haunt the desolate forests near this derelict town. Can you survive to unravel the mystery steeped in a history of ritualistic horrors?
row.short_description: Collect enough firewood during the day to build a bonfire at night. If it goes out, the witches come. Can you endure enough days and nights to survive the Holyburn Witches?

row.name: HeadLight
row.detailed_description: A stealth horror survival game, that takes place on the alien planet, Aviar. Use your 'eyes' to navigate your way through the dark forest, avoiding the other entities. Make your great escape, if you can...
row.short_description: A stealth horror survival game

row.name: World Leaders
row.detailed_description: Game Story The dawn of a new world is upon us, and a global battle for supremacy ensues. Will you rise as the supreme leader of the most formidable nation on Earth? Your quest for dominance begins, but thousands of contenders share the same ambition. To succeed, you must hone your leadership skills, construct a thriving nation, forge alliances with global comrades, and prove your mettle as the world's ultimate leader! Welcome to the ultimate turn-based strategy game for tacticians and conquerors! Forge a New World Order Following a massive uprising that toppled your nation's previous regime, you've been elected as the undisputed leader with the authority to rebuild. Your mission: transform this nation into an empire. A Pledge of Loyalty Your people look to you as their beacon of hope. Lead them to victory, and your name shall echo across the globe, a testament to your leadership and prowess. Build, develop, form alliances, and embrace your destiny as the Supreme Commander. World Leaders: A Turn-Based Masterpiece Embark on a journey from a humble nation's leader to the ruler of the entire world through diplomacy, strategy, and skill. Your objective: ascend above all and command thousands of global players. Utilize diplomacy, engage in warfare, and fortify your empire economically and militarily. Game Features * Resources, Factories, Stock Exchange, Weapons Markets, Diplomats, Alliances, United Nations, a Spy Center, a War Room, an Economic System, Technology, World Events, World News, and advanced Artificial Intelligence. * An array of weaponry, including Armoured Personnel Carriers (APCs), Tanks, Artillery, Anti-Air Missiles, Helicopters, Fighter Jets, Ships, Submarines, Fighting Robots, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), Aircraft Carriers, and Ballistic missiles. * Hundreds of espionage, war, diplomatic, and economic options to shape your empire. Worldwide Top Leaders - Hall Of Fame Leaders who maintain the top rank for over 7 days will be immortalized in the world leaders' hall of fame. Your status will be etched in history. iGindis Games Break language barriers and make global friends with iGindis Games. Our in-game translator ensures seamless communication among players worldwide. World Leaders supports thousands of players per world. Accessibility Mode For voice-over users, enable accessibility mode by tapping the screen three times with three fingers upon launching the game. Play the game using swipes and double-taps. (Please close TalkBack or any voice-over programs before opening the game.) You can also enable/disable accessibility mode by clicking F1 or A in keyboard in the main screen. Best of luck, Commander, in your quest for world domination!
row.short_description: Lead your nation to victory in this multiplayer turn-based war strategy game!

row.name: Aimcademy
row.detailed_description: Aimcademy is a science-based aim trainer which combines gaming with sport science! This leads to the most efficient way of training by embracing variation and personalization instead of repetition and cookie-cutter tasks. Train in the most efficient way by using the power of science! Use our innovative technique-training to improve your aiming skills. We introduce variety in the way you play in order to increase the learning speed. Always train in your personal sweet spot where the task is not too hard and not too easy. Make the most progress in the least amount of time with a training tailored to you. Monthly challenges let you compete and compare against your friends and the world. Show What You Are Made Of!
row.short_description: Aimcademy is a science-based aim trainer. The combination of sport science and gaming leads to the most efficient way of training in gaming. Unleash your true potential!

row.name: Killmaiden
row.detailed_description: Fight your way through 66 levels. Choose one of three goals in each level: Defend yourself until the entire map is purified Destroy all enemy portals Find the key and escape Kill all ten bosses on your way to meet the devil himself. Each boss has a more or less complex level. Find out how you can beat them. Choose from 39 skills, organized into three main groups and three additional weapon groups to upgrade them. Each difficulty has its own Steam leader board, see if you can break the high score and reach the top.
row.short_description: A fast paced singleplayer arena shooter. Choose one of three goals to win each stage, try different maidens and defeat 10 bosses on the way to meet the devil on stage 66. What's the highest score you can reach?
row.notes: Guns are fired, blood is spilled and one boss is very lightly clothed.

row.name: STEAMRUSH
row.detailed_description: Fast-Paced Melee Combat: Engage in intense melee combat that keeps your heart racing. Quick reflexes and expertly timed slashes, parries, jumps and dodges are essential as you face challenging foes. Strategic Parrying: Master the art of parrying to gain the upper hand in battles. Perfecting this skill is your ticket to success in STEAMRUSH's combat system. Diverse Boss Fights: Battle formidable bosses, each with their own unique combat mechanics. Adapt your approach and come up with winning strategies to defeat these challenging adversaries. Discover the Story: Explore the city and find collectibles that shed light on Haze's mysterious narrative. These hidden gems provide insight into the city's secrets and add depth to your gaming experience. STEAMRUSH promises an exciting blend of action, strategy, and storytelling, all within the intriguing backdrop of Haze. Will you complete your mission to uncover the city's mysteries and conquer its dangerous inhabitants? Steamrush is part of the Big Ones, an initiative of AIV - Accademia Italiana Videogiochi aimed at adding a production experience to the teaching carried out in the various courses, from the creation of the game concept to commercial publishing. The objective of the Big Ones is to give students the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues from other courses in the development of a video game project in which everyone can put the skills acquired during the lessons to the test and at the same time perfect their soft skills.
row.short_description: STEAMRUSH is a third-person Boss Rush game featuring fast-paced melee combat against unique bosses, punctuated by exploration segments that gradually unveil the captivating story of the isolated city-state of Haze.
row.notes: The game features depictions of blood and fantasy violence.

row.name: Meow Moments: Celebrating Together
row.detailed_description: Join the Celebration! Cats love getting together and partying, doing a variety of amusing things. And now, you can join them in their colorful celebrations. You'll experience Rio's Vibrant Beach: Explore the electrifying ambiance of Copacabana during Reveillon in captivating visuals. Enjoy visually stunning illustrations created by Katia Numakura capturing the essence of Rio's festive energy, with crowds of cats and friends. Features: Cats and Friends: Search for charming characters amidst the festive scene, where you find stories in every frame. Balloon-Popping Fun: While you look for the characters, relax popping the balloons throughout the beachscape. Relaxing and satisfying like popping bubble wrap! Rich Details: Delight in intricate scenes filled with colorful decorations and beach revelry. Festive Soundtrack: Groove to an exclusive bossa-nova soundtrack to immerse in the celebratory atmosphere. Family-Friendly Fun: Suitable for all ages, an entertaining experience for the whole family. Additional scenes are on the way But wait, the celebration doesn't end here! The free Réveillon in Rio experience is only the first one. There's more to come! With your support, expect new celebration scenes as DLCs released over time. Valentine’s Day Olympicats Comic Cat Con Welcome to Campus Music Festival Available on release: Join the creative community! Explore the Community & Creative Maker! Craft Personalized Scenes: Dive into a user-friendly editor to design scenes of your dreams! Populate them with an array of characters, objects, and lively balloons. Customize every detail, from festive decorations to playful interactions between characters. Your imagination sets the limits! Community Sharing & Exploration: Share Your Creations: Showcase your unique scenes with the wider Meow Moments community on the Steam Workshop. Let others experience your creative genius! Explore Player-Created Scenes: Immerse yourself in a treasure trove of player-crafted content. Dive into a myriad of personalized scenes and discover the creativity of fellow players. Play scenes with elements from the scenes you own. Seamless Integration: Integration with Your Collection: Access and freely use all DLC scenes you own across the scenarios you create. Mix and match elements to build a unique celebration! Available on release: New Year Activity Book DLC! Includes a printable Activity Book in PDF format, with activities to relax: Illustrations to colour Spot the differences Find the objects and characters in the crowd, and more! PLUS: a mini game to play in the main game. Enjoy a cozy memory game to sharpen your mind. Purchasing this will greatly support our studio to keep creating more content and more games!
row.short_description: Join the feline festivities in special moments! Find cats friends in vibrant celebrations where popping balloons is as relaxing and satisfying as popping bubble wrap! To get off to a good start, celebrate Copacabana beach in Rio de Janeiro during the New Year.
row.reviews: “If the new DLCs keep the quality of the main game, Meow Moments has the potential to become a go-to hub for hidden object/ kitten games. In any case, it’s a game that is more than worth it for fans of the genre.” 👍👍 – LadiesGamers “I wasn't expecting anything other than a typical cat-searching game that could be completed in 5-minutes or less...an hour later, I realized I had stumbled onto a hidden gem of a game that was quite challenging and tons of fun to play.” Recommended – Steam reviewer “An easy recommendation and free to play. A wholesome game that anyone can play.” Recommended – Steam reviewer

row.name: Downstairs
row.detailed_description: SUBJECT James, a former FBI agent, is on the hunt for his best friend Mary, during which some very bad things happen to him, he gets injured, his eyes go black, he loses consciousness. We don't know if our main character, who witnesses many different events like this, will be able to achieve his goal, find Mary or solve the events, it's up to you, good games in advance. CHARACTERS IN THE GAME -James -Marry -Unknown Mary is James's girlfriend, we can be sure that he will do whatever he can for Mary, but will you be able to do it? In our game, there are many puzzles such as opening locked doors, finding passwords, solving passwords, of course, of course, your flashlight turns on and off by itself from time to time because our flashlight is faulty.The most frightening thing in the game will be the ambient sounds, even if there is really no 'jumpscare' in any way, the environment you find will make you nervous enough.Dark corridors, hidden passwords, different symbols and so on. THIS GAME IS COMPLETELY CODED AND DESIGNED BY 1 PERSON PLEASE MAKE YOUR EVALUATIONS ACCORDINGLY !
row.short_description: Developed and published by Levienze Games, this game is a short story based horror and thriller game.

row.name: GrindFest
row.detailed_description: Code your way to glory Control your heroes using the C# programming language, and unleash them into a massive seamless world. Your bots will hack and slash their way through hordes of Orks, level up, craft weapons for the Dwarfs, disregard Elves, acquire gold, brew colorful mushrooms and gaze into the Abyss. All this while you can sit back, relax , fine-tune your code and admire your bots' progress. This game is made for you Be a Hero. Learn the ancient art of C#. Loot, loot, loot ! Play as any of the archetypical classes including healer, tank, and damage dealer. Let the game play itself. Explore Gothic Horror world inspired by the classics of High Fantasy. Kill everyone.
row.short_description: Don't you love it when numbers grow faster and faster? GrindFest is the pinnacle of idle programming action fanasy RPG genre. Learn how to use C# to make your own bots, make them kill, loot and cooperate with each other. Play as any role or automate everything so you don’t have to play at all.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

row.name: Bugs N' Guns
row.detailed_description: Bugs N' Guns is a cooperative third person shooter. Players take the role of Bugs and Guns two employees working as trash disposal for the crappiest company in the world. Tasked with finding and escorting a 'cargo' train named MARC - OS that was lost in an alien environment players will need to work together to survive the hostile flora and fauna that will impede their path. COOPERATIVE The most important feature in Bugs N´ Guns is that this game requires two people to play. Not only is it impossible to play without another player but within the game all the challenges players will face require cooperation otherwise, defeat is assured. ONLINE- LAN In order to play this game players require an internet connection. Once inside the game player may choose to play either on LAN or by choosing to play with random people on a public match or playing with friends through private matchmaking. SHOOT AND COMBINE The main way players interact with the world of Bugs N´ Guns is through shooting. Shoot to protect, kill, and cooperate. That is correct in this game players can generate elemental effects with their weapons and these elemental effects can combine with the weapons of the other player providing players with more fire power when they choose to work together. PROTECT THE TRAIN The main goal in this game is to escort the train M.A.R.C - OS. Through out the game the train will guide players through a series of crazy scenarios forcing the players to adapt or die. The most important thing to understand is that players can die all the times they want, but if the train dies, the game is over.
row.short_description: Bugs N' Guns is a cooperative third person shooter. Player will need to combine their weapons firepower to eliminate enemies and obstacles as players try to protect a train called MARC - OS from hostile flora and fauna.
row.notes: This game has exploding bodies of cartoon alien creatures. Players shoot weapon at exotic and hostile alien life forms and during death emit cartoon blood. Language may sometimes be crude or alude to crude language.

row.name: Before The Sun Rises
row.detailed_description: Before the Sun Rises is a 3D exploration and platform game about connection with nature and others. You play as a water drop, born from the misty dew of dawn. Can you restore the forest of your birth before the sun rises? In single player, explore the landscape to find and collect the water that you need to bloom trees and move onto the next area. In multiplayer, connect with friends or strangers online, help each other find water sources, and work together to restore the forest! NOTE: The current version of Before the Sun Rises is a demo and work in progress. While multiplayer is available, it is still being tested and is currently in beta.
row.short_description: Re-growing a dying land with kindred spirits of the forest.

row.name: Buried Shards
row.detailed_description: Burried shards is an intriguin story of adventure and psychological suspense that immerses the player in the mind of a man who wakes up with no memories. The protagonist, affected by traumatic amnesia, is forced to face his fears and secrets, gradually unveiling his past. Each night his sleepwalking alterego reveals new details of the house he had forgotten, unearthing the darkest parts of his memory. As he uncovers his past, the protagonist's intrigue and agony grow, leading him to confront traumas he had erased. Who is he really and what dark secrets does his past hide? Get ready for an immersive experience that defies reality and plunges you into the shadows of the memory of a man with no apparent past. Illusion? Reality? Nothing is what it seems.
row.short_description: Get Inmersed in the intriguing narrative adventure of BURIED SHARDS, progressing through the story chapters while alternating between day and night. Guide your sleepwalking self with house lights during the night and confront the traumas of your past in this unique blend of storytelling and puzzles.

row.name: Deepcut
row.detailed_description: Deepcut is a brand new multiplayer, king of the hill style game. GAMEPLAY: - Join other people on various servers and try to get to the top DJ decks. - Fight your way to the top and protect your king status. - Search every video on Youtube and choose one as king. The video plays for everyone. - Pick different avatars and expressions (more coming soon!). We are currently invite only through friends of friends. If you don't know anyone already on Deepcut, you can join our waitlist.
row.short_description: Become king and rule over the eyes and ears of your kingdom.

row.name: ProTubeVR Companion-App
row.detailed_description: Explore a new dimension of immersion in virtual reality with the incredible ProTubeVR Companion-App! ProTubeVR Companion-app connects OpenVR with the company’s haptic modules, Provolver and ForceTube. It's your ticket to an intense haptic adventure in the world of VR gaming. Whether you're a curious newcomer or a seasoned VR expert, ProTubeVR Companion-App is the essential tool to inject excitement into every one of your gaming sessions! Discover features that make all the difference: Advanced customization: Our app works whith any game running in OpenVR and with any headset in that mode. The ProTubeVR Companion-App allows you to customize every aspect of your haptics VR session. Create a unique experience that seamlessly aligns with your preferences for an unparalleled level of immersion. Multiple settings modes : Backward Compatibility You are able to tune every parameter related to the Haptic events coming from OpenVR, including the intensity of vibrations, the frequency, synchronization with in-game events, and much more. Native Customization : Intercept signals coming from the list of our natively supported games, and tweak them to your preferences. Valve Index Knuckles Fix : Install our driver located in the app folder to enable Knuckle fix support for Valve Index. You can then disable the panic mode of the controllers related to the kick of haptic modules Custom Profile Creation: Our application offers the ability to create tailored profiles for specific games. Fine-tune each setting to precisely match your gaming style, providing an unmatched experience. Real-time monitoring: The ProTubeVR Companion-App enables you to visualize the impact of your settings on your haptic experience in real-time. This means you can adjust your settings on the fly for optimal immersion. Profile Workshop: Community comes to life! Thanks to the Profile Workshop, players can create, share, and download presets crafted by enthusiasts from around the world. Choose from a plethora of profiles and manually load them into the application for the ultimate customization. Dive into the heart of the action and feel every movement, impact, and sensation like never before. Your next VR adventure awaits!
row.short_description: ProtubeVR's Companion App is your tool of choice to use with our haptic devices ! Customize your Haptic device settings on the fly using all the parameters the app provides. Wide range of Customization, Presets, and more !

row.name: CATACOMBS
row.detailed_description: Roam around the catacombs, collect the cubes and avoid IT at all cost. Collect everything before it finds you Every maze comes with it's set of tasks you need to do before you can escape and move on. While doing so, avoid it at all cost. It lurks in the darkness Always listen to your radar. The closer it gets, the more frequent it emits a warning sound. As long as you are in a chase and it is following you, the radar display turns red. FEATURES Steam Item Drops Survival & Endless Gamemode Intense Gameplay Speedrun-able Intelligent Enemy That Adapts 6 Unique Endless Modifier
row.short_description: Roam around the catacombs, collect everything and avoid being found at all cost. Collect rare item drops while doing so.

row.name: Blamcon Shooting Gallery
row.detailed_description: TEST YOUR SKILLS WITH A LIGHT GUN This game is only properly experienced when using an Infrared Light Gun, but you can play with a mouse. Left mouse shoots Right mouse aims Center button toggles crosshair (this will not work well without a light gun TEST YOUR REFLEXES PARTNER! Using your trusty 6 shooter shoot the targets as fast as you can in 30 seconds to rack up points. Each consecutive hit gives you bonus points. You can reload as many times as you like but keep an eye on that ammo, 6 shots doesn't last! PUSH YOUR SKILLS Scoring high wins high! As you rack up points your game will level up, showing you more targets faster. You'll need the eye of an eagle and the reflexes of a Texas rattlesnake to shoot and reload fast enough to keep up.

row.name: 大话商周
row.detailed_description: This game is a turn based game set against the backdrop of the Apocalypse of the Gods, with characters from ancient mythological stories as the framework. In the game, players play the role of a cultivator, obtaining cultivation and supplies by completing daily tasks and defeating dungeon tasks, improving their own level and equipment, and thus fighting against various forces in this chaotic Apocalypse of the Gods! The game includes various gameplay methods such as pet system, skill system, equipment system, and companion system. For example, the pet system includes 19 types of pets in 3 categories, and each has its own strengths in the four dimensions of blood magic sensitivity, which can meet the personalized needs of players; There are a total of 9 skills from 3 races in the skill system, with diverse gameplay modes such as human control, immortal output, and demon assistance; The equipment system is extremely rich, with over a hundred types of equipment in three categories. Different combinations can be adjusted according to equipment level and race needs. For more gameplay, players should try it out themselves!
row.short_description: 大话商周是一款以封神大劫为背景的回合制游戏。游戏内有角色体系、装备体系、宠物体系、任务体系、转生体系等构成部分。 角色体系：分为人仙妖三个种族，各有技能特点，如人族负责控制、仙族负责输出、妖族负责辅助。玩家需要合理搭配阵容才能起到最大效果。 装备体系：分为普通装备、高级装备、圣装，普通装备会以主线剧情、等级礼包、日常任务的方式发放到玩家手中，高级装备依靠消耗材料将普通装备升级获得，圣装通过高级副本掉落等方式合成。 宠物体系：游戏内现有19种宠物，分普通、高级宠物和神兽，不同宠物属性各有千秋，可血可法可力可速，宠物技能也分输出和辅助类，更有额外技能进行加强。
developers: 北京懿宸科技有限公司
publishers: 北京懿宸科技有限公司

row.name: Echoes of Fear
row.detailed_description: Echoes of Fear: Remastered draws you into a forgotten valley, a place untouched by time, yet far from lifeless. Beneath the quiet fog and decaying homes, unseen voices stir, and something in the shadows seems to listen. Deep within the valley lies an ancient vault said to contain a powerful Artifact…  but there is something, centuries old, guarding it. Your task is simple: find the keys and unlock the vault and get out. Alive. But as you explore, you’ll come to realize you’re not alone. The valley remembers — and it wants to be heard. Gameplay Features Explore the Forgotten Valley Venture through dense fog, empty houses, and long-abandoned paths as you uncover the valley’s buried past. The Spirit Box Use a spirit box to communicate with lingering souls. Their voices echo faintly through static, offering guidance—or warnings. The signal grows stronger indoors, where the veil between worlds feels thin. The Lurking Presence Something follows you through the mist. It doesn’t speak, and it doesn’t stop. You may not always see it, but it always sees you. The only warnings of its approach: your heartbeat, growing louder and faster, and the booming echo of its footsteps.  Unbroken Immersion No stamina limits. No torch restrictions. Just the sound of your footsteps, the hum of the spirit box, and the weight of what hides in the fog. Lost the beast? Find the statue. Once placed by the valley’s lost inhabitants, the angel’s sword serves as a grim guide to the creature stalking the shadows. Can You Face What Watches You? There are no weapons. No safety. Only whispers, shadows, and the echoes of what should have been forgotten.
row.short_description: Venture into a haunted valley to retrieve a priceless artifact at any cost. A lurking creature stalks you, booming footsteps, a quickening heartbeat, and an angelic statue left by long-gone inhabitants pointing the way. Survive and complete your mission… whatever it takes. Get in. Get out. Alive.
row.notes: Contains paranormal moments in game that some viewers might find unsettling.

row.name: Three Kingdoms: Strategy MOBA
row.detailed_description: Three Kingdoms Strategy MOBA is a new fast-paced real-time strategy mobile game with a 7-day cycle and a 100vs100 battle mode. Enjoy the fun of fast-paced strategy games. The game contains a large number of strategy MOBA elements. Real battlefield! Fast national war! Adopting Chinese style, real art style, carefully designed combat and strategy gameplay. [Global Server] Global server, join the Three Kingdoms strategy battlefield with Three Kingdoms game enthusiasts from all over the world. [Fast-paced] Fast-paced, season-based gameplay, 7 days per season, settle rankings, settle rewards, and give away season card pool after the season ends. [Personal ladder ranking] With the accumulation of the season, the rank continues to improve, civilians, county officials, prefects, governors, princes, emperors. [Team ladder ranking] Form your own team to fight and continuously improve the team's rank, civilian squad, warrior squad, hero squad, main general corps, famous general corps, supreme army corps. [Development history] Development history, record the development status of all players, rank and reward based on the completion of the development progress, passionate competition. [Emperor's perspective] Emperor's perspective, holographic presentation, participate in the Three Kingdoms battle from the perspective of the emperor. [Intrigue and deception] Intrigue and deception, unification, separatism, sneak attacks, decisive battles, you will experience the essence of the Three Kingdoms era one by one. [100vs100 Passionate Team Battle] 100vs100 Passionate Team Battle, in the torrent of the Three Kingdoms history, opportunities and dangers coexist, development is for team battles, and team battles are for better development. [MOBA Map] MOBA-like map, after occupying a city, the city will send out expeditionary forces to assist in the battle, with three attack and defense routes on the left, middle, and right, perfectly integrating MOBA and war strategy. ••[Download Now]•• *This software is classified as auxiliary level 12 according to the game software classification management method due to violence. *This game is free to use, and provides paid services such as purchasing virtual game coins and items in the game. *When playing games for a long time, please pay attention to the usage time and avoid indulging in games.
row.short_description: Fast-paced war strategy mobile game, 7 days per season, North vs South

row.name: Lords Mobile
row.detailed_description: Lords Mobile Lords Mobile is a Strategy game that immerses players in epic Clan Wars battles. In Lords Mobile, engage in intense Clan Wars and strategic gameplay in this thrilling online strategy game. Prepare for an epic clash like never before in Lords Mobile, an online real-time strategy game that takes the essence of Gamers to a whole new level! [Game Features]: 👑 Assemble Your Army of Legends 👑 The once-mighty Emperor has fallen, and now the realm cries out for a true hero, a Lord who can unite the fractured Kingdoms. Recruit legendary heroes from diverse backgrounds, including dwarves, mermaids, dark elves, and steampunk robots. Forge your unique army in this enchanting world and embark on a quest to establish your empire in the realm of strategy and ClanWars! 🏆 Collect Relics of Power 🏆 Explore the sacred Relic Chamber to unearth ancient relics of immense power. Enhance and upgrade them to unlock their full potential, granting you the edge in the battle for supremacy. 🏰 Conquer the Vergeway 🏰 For fans of tower defense, the Vergeway beckons! Collect and upgrade a variety of cards, strategize and adapt to overcome challenging stages, and put your tactical genius to the test as you face off against nefarious foes lurking within the Verge. 🏗️ Build Your Sovereign Realm 🏗️ Ascend to greatness by upgrading your structures, conducting groundbreaking research, training formidable troops, leveling up your Heroes, and steering your Kingdom towards prosperity in this strategic masterpiece. 🛡️ Master the Art of Formation 🛡️ Choose from four distinct troop types and six versatile troop formations to devise your battle strategies. Outsmart your adversaries by leveraging a counter system and aligning your troops with the right Heroes. Perfectionize your tactics to vanquish your foes! 🌟 Mighty Heroes Await 🌟 Assemble a formidable team of five Heroes and embark on an epic RPG-style campaign. Allow them to lead your realm to glory as valiant warlords! 🤝 Form Unbreakable Alliances 🤝 Join forces with like-minded warriors in guilds and take the battlefield by storm. Together, you'll conquer thrilling events, including Guild Wars, Kingdom Versus Kingdom clashes, Battle Royales, Wonder Wars, Darknest Invasions, and more! 🌐 Global Rivalries 🌐 Engage in intense clashes with millions of players worldwide. Crush those who dare to obstruct your path to supremacy! row.name: CatBallGravityMaze

Try finding a way to the fish and see if you can do it in lesser steps. We've designed 20+ levels from easy to hard, and may going to add more to it in the future.

row.name: Grappling Gunners: Arena FPS
row.detailed_description: It is an PvP FPS game where you can engage in high-speed gunfights with full freedom of movement, utilizing two grappling hooks on both sides. In addition to grappling, skills can be used to perform a variety of moves. Master seven skills, including instant teleportation and bullet time, to battle your foes. When you and your friends feel like playing something different, like an FPS, we'd be delighted if you could enjoy a quick game.
row.short_description: Grappling Gunners is a free multiplayer FPS with two grappling shots for high-speed gunfights and full freedom of movement. Utilize seven skills, including teleportation and bullet time.

row.name: Knight's Path: The Tournament
row.detailed_description: This game is a free CONCEPT demo created to showcase early ideas for Knight’s Path and does NOT represent the final game!!! The Tournament is a short (2-3 hour long) medieval action RPG featuring challenging combat, an immersive progression system, and a nice little story. It serves both as an announcement and a teaser for the forthcoming open-world RPG Knight's Path , which is currently in active development. You begin your journey with nothing. Once you acquire a weapon and learn how to fight, you can enter the tournament, where you test your might and earn rewards. These rewards can be used to purchase new armors and weapons, enhancing your capabilities for future battles. The tournament consists of four rounds and pits you against eleven unique NPCs, each with their own distinct fighting style, including the reigning, undefeated champion of the arena. Are you ready to face this challenge? Or, if you need a moment to relax, you can partake in various activities, like chilling by the fireplace or forming a heartwarming bond with a local cat. Why are we releasing it for free on Steam? Here are our honest reasons: We aim to make our game as immersive and enjoyable as possible, and for that, we need your help and feedback! Is there anything you'd change or add to enhance your gaming experience? What features do you love, and what would you like to see improved? Tell us, and help us shape the game! We hope you find joy and excitement in this little adventure!
row.short_description: This game is a free CONCEPT demo created to showcase early ideas for Knight’s Path and does NOT represent the final game!!! The Tournament is a short medieval action RPG featuring challenging combat, an immersive progression system, and a nice little story.
row.notes: Our game includes a tournament mode with duels, where hitting opponents results in a minimal blood effect. These are non-lethal, friendly matches. The only characters that can be killed are fictional rats. Some NPCs in the game may be rude and rarely use slurs.

row.name: Scrap and Battery
row.detailed_description: Scrap and Battery stars a little robot working in a factory since the day he was made. Tired of working, he decides to take matters into his own hands and attempts to escape! Help him navigate through the large facility and reach the bottom of the facility. Utilize various abilities to build your playstyle and bring havoc to the facility! However, your limited battery is your enemy. Will you make it to the end? Or become scraps while trying? Express how you want to play by building your load out of your abilities! Upgrade and improve your abilities with scraps picked up through levels! Navigate through 7 levels and confront various types of enemies within. Absorb their energy by defeating them. Hold onto your battery to stay powered! Enemies will try to knock it off by any means necessary! Attempt multiple runs to test your best builds and break your records! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Take control of a small robot on a personal quest to escape a facility. Utilize a variety of abilities to build your own playstyle and bring havoc to the facility!

row.detailed_description: Tugboat Terror is a frantic and exciting task-management adventure game where you play as Alessandro, a fish with human legs, and pilot a tugboat through a dangerous swamp of radioactive monsters! 4 hand crafted levels Original art and music Full controller support This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

row.name: Mizi NO!
row.detailed_description: We love cats! They are simply the best. But let's be honest: These little rascals can also drive you crazy! You are sitting relaxed on the couch and see from the corner of your eye that your cat jumps on the table, on which there is also a glass of water. They approach curiously and push the glass closer to the table's edge with their paw. No matter how often you say NO, they push it over the edge, making 'clink'.... Mizi NO! is about putting together the shards the beloved cat left behind. Sort and rotate the shards and reassemble the whole in classic puzzle style. KEY FEATURES Handcrafted Puzzles Handcrafted puzzles to tickle your brain and help you recover from a stressful day. Simple Controls The game can be played by just clicking the left and right mouse buttons, which makes it very accessible for newcomers or seasoned puzzlers of any age. Relaxing Music Mizi NO! has calming music - perfect for a relaxing puzzle session!
row.short_description: In this free 2D puzzle game, you must reassemble broken objects that your cat has knocked over.

row.name: Crown Wars: The Black Prince Playtest
I'll Do It Tomorrow
row.detailed_description: It's Sara's first day of work. However, when she takes the elevator to go to the office, she suddenly finds herself on a mysterious floor . What truth lies behind these weird rooms? Will you be able to move on? Or rather... will you want to move on? Features: Play as Sara, a 24-year-old girl. Explore mysterious rooms. Interact with people with familiar faces. Collect key fragments. Find a way to leave this place.
row.short_description: It's Sara's first day of work. However, when she takes the elevator to go to the office, she suddenly finds herself on a mysterious floor. What truth lies behind these weird rooms? Will you be able to move on? Or rather... will you want to move on?

row.name: Blast Course
row.detailed_description: Blast Course is a first-person puzzle-platformer centered around the classic game mechanic of Rocket Jumping . Control Kit in a day at work testing 'Hyperboom', a revolutionary transport technology based on explosives. Overcome four different levels with the help of your own 'Hyperboom' and its set of modifications while testing the viability of this new product. REVISITING A POPULAR AND CLASSIC MECHANIC This game is, in a way, intended as a love letter to kinesthetic gameplay, exemplified through the possibility of combining complex movements with just one singular tool, bringing rocket jumping to the spotlight. MAKING ROCKET JUMPING UNDERSTANDABLE AND ACCESSIBLE The goal of this game is to design rocket jumping from the ground up, bringing home its most engaging aspects, whilst streamlining it for a modern audience by getting rid of unnecessary complexities and making it more intuitive and less fiddly. KINESTHETIC PUZZLE LEVEL DESIGN: TECHNIQUE RATHER THAN SPEED By conceiving complex jumps and maneuvers not as a test of skill, but as a solution to a puzzle, we can create levels that are potentially more complex, with more flexible pacing, and that put less pressure on players. Project made for the B.A. in Interactive Product Design, B.F.A in Animation and B.F.A in Digital Design degrees of U-Tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.
row.short_description: Blast Course is a first-person puzzle-platformer centered around the classic game mechanic of Rocket Jumping. Control Kit in a day at work testing 'Hyperboom', a revolutionary transport technology based on explosives.

row.name: Shadow Of Sound

This is also the first project I developed using the cocos2d-x game engine. I hope you like it! Game features: The gameplay is simple and only requires 4 buttons. Different difficulties, there is always one suitable for you. Completely free, now and in the future. A lot of beautiful music that I like. Moreover, this is an open source project, everyone is welcome to learn and continue to develop! Immerse yourself in the world of Shadow Of Sound together!
row.short_description: Traditional 4k drop style music game —— 'Shadow Of Sound'.

row.name: Rivers of Blood
row.detailed_description: The protagonist is a girl who is looking for a way out in an unknown and melancholic world. The player's objective is to cross the scenarios. On your way there are dangerous traps and macabre beings! You will die many times! And in the most violent and agonizing ways possible. Rivers of Blood is a game of trial and error. Discover the limits of your patience and test your skills – how far can you go without dying in the attempt? Bloody and visceral game.
row.short_description: Alice suffers an accident and wakes up in a parallel world created by her unconscious in a state of coma. Now she needs to find the strength and means to survive and return to the real world, in this new reality that is completely different and much more terrifying than any nightmare.

row.name: Staff Runner

Say goodbye to dull lessons and hello to a fun, interactive way to read sheet music. 🎵 What is Staff Runner?
