Dive into a vibrant, gamified environment where you'll master the art of reading musical notation effortlessly. 🎮 Key Features: 🎵 Gamified Learning: Staff Runner makes the process of learning to read sheet music an engaging and enjoyable experience. 🌟 Adventure Mode: Embark on an epic musical quest through various levels, each packed with challenges and rewards. 🎼 An Endless Runner Mode with Online Leaderboards waiting for you to top the charts 🥇 Progress Tracking: Keep track of your achievements and watch your skills improve as you conquer each level. 🎉 Rewards and Recognition: Earn badges and accolades for your musical achievements and keep the motivation flowing. 📚 Why Choose Staff Runner? Unlock a world of musical possibilities and join countless others in their quest to become sheet music experts. Whether you're a seasoned musician or just starting your musical journey, Staff Runner offers something for everyone. 🎁 Perfect for Music Enthusiasts, Students, and Teachers 🏆 Boost Your Musical Confidence and Competence 🤩 Fun and Engaging, Making Learning Enjoyable 🌐 Accessible Anytime, Anywhere Are you ready to master the language of music in a way that's both entertaining and educational? Staff Runner is your ticket to becoming a sheet music virtuoso. Don't miss your chance to embark on this extraordinary musical adventure! Get started with Staff Runner and unlock the world of sheet music with the joy and excitement of gaming.
row.short_description: Unleash your inner musical maestro with Staff Runner, the captivating educational game that transforms sheet music learning into an exciting adventure. Say goodbye to dull lessons and hello to a fun, interactive way to read sheet music.

row.name: Blood Orange: Definitive Edition
row.detailed_description: Searching the Amazon for the elusive razorback dolphin, Nora discovers more than she bargained for... Features: Explore ruins beneath the amazon river basin, and converse with their dolphin inhabitants Character-driven psychological thriller narrative Skillfully capture and develop photographs with your underwater camera Beautiful, mind-warping environments which ride a line between psychosis and reality Original Soundtrack with a number of atmospheric tracks from Chilly Makes Music 3 distinct endings, and a bonus 'perfect' variant 100% FREE!
row.short_description: Underwater psychological horror with a shocking, character-driven narrative. Explore ruins beneath the amazon river basin, and converse with their dolphin inhabitants. Skillfully capture and develop photographs with your underwater camera.

row.name: Galacticverse
row.detailed_description: Galactic Verse is a multiverse gaming experience that was released during its development phase. The game features multiple game modes and offers a diverse range of gaming universes. As a dynamic project, Galactic Verse provides players with the opportunity to explore and engage with different modes, creating an evolving gaming experience.
row.short_description: Free to Play! Galacticverse is an single player game. Discover and join the special events! For now just open for what we are building! Don't forget this is early access!

row.name: One Week With The Mafia
row.detailed_description: After having spent years using a dark-web sports betting website, an old friend ends up running up quite the debt. He discovers very quickly that the owners, the Italian mafia, makes sure their clients pay them one way or another. Thankfully for him, the mafia was sent to your house instead! In this parody of Scott Cawthon's 'Five Nights at Freddy's', you find yourself trapped inside your conveniently located nuclear fallout bunker, with unwanted visitors rapidly approaching your location. From your bunker, you must stalk the intruders movements until they become a threat, and use the bullet-proof steel doors at your disposal to lock them out. But use these tools conservatively, as you are running off a crappy generator, in need of constant repair, and with very limited gas left. To them, you are a sitting duck, it is up to you to ensure you make it to midnight. Good Luck! Made With Godot
row.short_description: After a misuse of your home address, and the general incompetence of an old friend, you find yourself stuck with the Italian mafia hunting you down. In this parody of Scott Cawthon's 'Five Nights at Freddy's', it is up to you to stop the mafia from wasting you.

row.name: Meta Soulmate
row.detailed_description: Meta Soulmate is a virtual mate creation tool that allows you to craft your own virtual companion through a game-style character customization tool. With it, you can debut as a VTuber or create your own secret friend. Implement the excitement of beginning in our own way This project aims to convey the excitement felt when creating oneself or another character while enjoying various games or services. Materialize the emotions of that experience and feel the thrill of completing the project. Your own character with infinite possibilities. The possibilities of your own character are endless. Especially for VTubers, we plan to provide an all-in-one tool, allowing you to debut as a VTuber in the easiest way possible. Costume parts that maximize a multitude of possibilities Efforts were made to divide all costumes into individual parts, maximizing a myriad of possibilities, allowing you to express each soulmate’s individuality beyond simply predefined costume templates. Texture editing feature designed to create Soulmates with true uniqueness You can freely edit not only the costumes but also the textures of face and body, allowing for a truly unique Soulmate. Showcase your skills to create a one-of-a-kind Soulmate that is exclusively yours! Meta Soulmate's unique and easy makeup method Meta Soulmate introduces a new approach to makeup editing, allowing for both freedom and simplicity. Save your character's portrait as a standard 2D image file. Edit the image in any way you like, and those changes will seamlessly reflect on the 3D character. Future of Meta Soulmate Beyond the initial excitement, we are preparing various contents for you to freely enjoy with the Meta Soulmates you create. They will be gradually released through Steam. Look forward to the unique experience laid before you and your Meta Soulmate!
row.short_description: Create your own virtual mate with a game-style character customization tool. Debut your ideal as a VTuber, or make it your own secret friend. Create your meta soulmate now!

row.name: Untitled Rougelike Arcade Game
row.detailed_description: The game will be a short roguelike around 1-2 hours of playtime. Your goal is to escape the game by beating all the minigames the arcade gods present you. Although you will only be able to use a single finger due to some medical complications. Will you be able to tap to your victory or will you be forever trapped within this black and white world. Note: This is a student project, expect the worst thing on Steam hahhaha.
row.short_description: A short arcade roguelike.

row.name: SCP: Bloodwater
row.detailed_description: THE STORY In this universe, SCP-354 has been elevated to Thaumiel for the discovery of SCP-354-B, which are valuable organic material that drops from entities that SCP-354 manifests, referred as SCP-354-A. For this reason, the SCP Foundation have launched operations in order to harvest more SCP-354-B which in turned had only made SCP-354 angry. Consequently and unsurprisingly, the more they harvest SCP-354-B and the more they slaughter SCP-354-A entities, the larger and stronger the swarms become. But you got no choice, similar to the Y-909 compound, SCP-354-B is just too valuable so these harvesting operations must continue as much as possible. ABOUT THE GAME In this game, you take the role of a newly appointed Site Director at the Red Pool Containment Zone, also known as the Area-354 Containment Site. Your mission as the new Site Director is three fold: 1) Harvest Resources: 2) Attack and Defend: 3) Research and Progress: Be warned; this is an anomalously strategic game. Which research should you do first? How many D-Class should you deploy? What type of military unit should you use against that beast? Should you retreat now and save your team or continue the assault? Should you focus on your military and conventional weapons or research genetics instead and use the Red Pool's monsters against it? Do you have what it takes to defend your base until the Red Pool awakens?
row.short_description: SCP Bloodwater is a strategy management defense game inspired by the SCP Foundation's SCP-354, also known as the Red Pool. Take the role of a newly appointed Site Director at the Red Pool Containment Zone, harvest valuable organic material, and defend the facility against the Red Pool's attacks.

row.name: Elara: A Coding Adventure in Space
row.detailed_description: Elara is a completely free coding game targeted toward beginners. It includes 25+ levels plus optional bonus challenges to really test your knowledge and coding skills. It also features an engaging story told through dialog and animated cutscenes. The game takes place on Elara, one of Jupiter's moons. You are a coding intern for Ganymede Robotics. Throughout the game, you write code to control a small rover named G.R.O.V.E.R., navigating the lunar surface, avoiding obstacles, and solving puzzles. Kalina, your mentor and fellow Ganymede Robotics engineer, will help you out along the way. Things start out smoothly, but unfortunately your internship doesn't exactly go as planned. It's up to you to fix things! Do you have what it takes to save the day?
row.short_description: Solve puzzles and learn how to code in this unique and gripping sci-fi adventure!

row.name: Art is dead
row.detailed_description: Art is dead is a DIFFICULT GAME. It's a 2D top-down shooter that redefines the idea of AI enemies. In this game, walls can become your most dangerous enemy. You can't hide behind them, you can't use them to your advantage, and your bullets can't pass through them. Meanwhile, enemies can move freely through the map and they will chase you to your death. No matter how deep you are into the game, one stupid mistake can end your progress abruptly, so be careful and never underestimate your enemies. In addition to this, there's a deep lore behind the game explained in a very easy way, so you don't have to read long texts or memorize multiple names, just enjoy the way everything unravels. Enemies are optimized to make your life there miserable. If you think you are fast enough, a new soul will approach you with terrifying speed while dodging your useless bullets. If you think your weapons are strong enough, a new soul will appear in the darkness, coming to you slowly but resisting all your damage. If you think you have everything under control, which you should never do, your surroundings will become the playground of a sneaky soul only visible through your lantern. All of them will tear you apart in seconds, so you better get away from them and think fast. These are not the only enemies there are, so don't get cocky and learn from all their movements. The game has two main modes: - Ego chamber : If you want to understand the lore of the game, this is where you should go. It can be done in 40 minutes or 100 hours, depending on your skill level. Take into consideration it's very challenging and can become frustrating at times. Each level works as a checkpoint, but be aware of every trick the weird entity tries to pull on you. You can lose all your progress if you are not careful and be forced to start the Ego chamber from the start. The more you advance, the more things you'll understand, and the more challenging enemies will become. - Survival : Just to have fun and break scores. Make use of the best weapons, the best strategies, and the best equipment so you can last the most rounds possible. Just try not to break all the lights, you'll miss them on late rounds. You can choose from 2 different maps. Survival Corridor is composed of 27 rounds designed manually to make the experience there frustrating and difficult. You'll need to explore the map in search of better equipment and not get trapped in narrow corridors. Combat Arena on the other hand is very easy to explore, and rounds are randomly generated. If you have the patience and skills to get to round 100, that's a win, but I doubt you are capable of that. ************************************************************************** The game has a very defined and dark sense of humor. For every achievement you complete, a new skin will be unlocked so you can be more stylish while killing tormented souls. Some of them have a very rough sense of humor, while others are just cute, fun, or related to other products of Darkhunter Studios. Beware, even the little puns and jokes that may seem unfunny, have a reason for it. We made sure to create a very deep and dark lore behind this game, so anyone can have fun trying to understand exactly what's this game about. So, what are you waiting for? For the price of a Happy Meal, you can hold the power to execute indiscriminate genocide on poor little sad souls. If you ask me, that's a safe bet. We are thinking of adding multiplayer to the game, which would increase a lot the hours of entertainment. If we see a good reception from the players, we will start with the development and you will be able to enjoy the game with your friends in less than a week. You know what people say, genocide with friends tastes way better
row.short_description: Art is dead is HARD. This 2D top-down shooter DOES NOT forgive mistakes. Enemies have the high ground, and you are trapped like a little mouse inside experimental levels. If you're skilled enough, you might unravel everything behind that annoying creature that forces you to play its games.

row.name: SkyFly
row.detailed_description: Fly high through the Sky! SkyFly is a casual indie game, where you navigate your way through the tracks as a rolling ball! SkyFly features: Random RGB Color Generation, to customize your ball to a color you like. 30 tracks to navigate your way through and a soundtrack of ambient, non-copyright sounds to listen to (with volume adjustment).
row.short_description: A casual, high flying racing game

row.name: Trophy Hunt
row.detailed_description: Trophy Hunt is a silly multiplayer game all about stealing and defending trophies from your friends! With Trophies in the center of the map, its an all out rush to bring them back to your base. Use your sword to trip others and steal their trophies! Use power-ups to boost your speed, turn invisible, plant traps and more! Play any setup from 1v1, 2v2 or 4 player free-for-all while asserting dominance with your trophy hunting skills!
row.short_description: Trophy Hunt is a silly multiplayer game where you must battle your friends to get and keep trophies on your base. Use mines, turn Invisible, Walk through walls and more in this fast paced Beat'em up.

row.name: Space Rock Armageddon
row.detailed_description: Space Rock Armageddon is a bold and dynamic space arcade game, boasting lightning-fast gameplay and an explosion of vibrant colors that make it feel like an eighties arcade classic. While the original Asteroids relied on minimalist black-and-white graphics and a gradual pace, Space Rock Armageddon catapults players into a visually stunning and high-speed cosmic adventure from the outset. Asteroids hurtle towards the player's spacecraft with breathtaking velocity, demanding rapid reflexes and precision. What sets Space Rock Armageddon apart is its visual brilliance. Every collision results in a spectacular burst of neon hues, creating a dazzling spectacle. It's like navigating through a cosmic fireworks display where each explosion is a work of art. This captivating visual design, combined with the game's relentless pace, creates an exhilarating experience.
row.short_description: Space Rock Armageddon is a bold and dynamic space arcade game, boasting lightning-fast gameplay and an explosion of vibrant colors that make it feel like an eighties arcade classic.

row.name: Wild Angels | Episode 1
row.detailed_description: Wild Angels is an interactive visual novel in the genre of comedy and drama. According to the plot, a criminal gang of five young guys appeared in modern Russia, which became unexpectedly successful and elusive. All bandits have completely different points of view and life stories, but they are united by a common goal - to 'earn' as much money as possible through risky and reckless actions.
row.short_description: An interactive visual novel about a mysterious gang who decided to break the law.
row.notes: The game may contain text descriptions of brutality and murders. Mentions of adult topics. Some characters smoke tobacco and drink alcohol. The characters may seem rude and immoral.

row.name: Watermelon Game
row.detailed_description: 10 possible fruits and one goal, reach the Watermelon. Your job is to combine matching fruits to evolve them to the next one and eventually reach the coveted Watermelon. To help you, you have 3 different abilities at your disposal. But watch out, using these will cost you some of your points. Be smart about when you use them to get the highest score! MULTIPLAYER Measure your fruit skills against another player. GET THE WATERMELON How many Watermelons can you combine before your basket overflows? USE YOUR ABILITIES Power, level up and destroy — These abilities will help you reach the Watermelon, using any of those will also allow you to angle your aim. GOLDEN FRUIT If luck is on your side, you might even see the mysterious Golden Fruit. Find it and witness its effect firsthand. STATISTICS Track your progress with in-depth statistics. Visit the menu to see the number of fruits you've combined, your ability usage, and much more.
row.short_description: A Casual Physics Puzzle game, where you have to combine matching Fruits to get Points and increase your Highscore. Play solo or measure your skills against another player online.

row.name: Carsick Carventure
row.detailed_description: You are about to play a student game made by a small but ambitious team. Releasing our first game on Steam is a dream come true! The game is crafted under the guidance of the developer of the Engine Evolution franchise, and we can't wait until you try it! In this Chrome Dinosaur inspired mode, you take a looong ride through an endless world as you dodge a wide range of foes and pull off epic flips to dominate the leaderboards. Do you have what it takes to set the all-time high score? Buckle up for a ride in stylish procedurally generated worlds. We went the extra mile and took a special course at the university to learn how to make them! The game was created by Vladimír Hořký (MFF UK), Jan Nekarda (MFF UK), Sára Borovičková (PedF UK). Published by Petr Šimůnek (MFF UK)
row.short_description: Carsick Carventure is a hyper-casual game where you drive your cute 2D car as far as possible. Discover new places, set new records, and beat your friends! Enjoy infinite levels and different game modes!

row.name: AquaRevive - VR Game
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in the groundbreaking VR experience of 'AquaRevive'. Combat algal bloom pollution in a visually stunning underwater world, restoring the ecosystem's health. Dive into an unforgettable journey of environmental restoration and make a difference in the fight against algal bloom pollution. The story begins as you step into the dome, where the walls come alive with luminous targets representing algal blooms. Your mission is to use the dynamic chemical spheres to destroy these algal targets and save the ecosystem from their devastating impact. As the game progresses, waves of targets emerge, testing your speed and precision. You must swiftly strike the spheres, aiming accurately to shatter the targets one by one within a limited time frame, clearing them out. Get ready for this environmental journey and become the hero who defends against the invasion of algal blooms!
row.short_description: Dive into AquaRevive, a VR game in a glass dome battling algal bloom pollution. Armed with a dynamic chemical ball, you must destroy illuminated targets to save the ecosystem. Face waves of challenges, testing your speed and accuracy in a race against time.

row.name: Will The Man Get Frog
row.detailed_description: Will The Man Get Frog is a semi-random writing game in which you compose haikus (japanese short poems) in a cute and soothing atmosphere. Carefully crafted constraints will help you be creative regardless of your writing skills. The minimal design gives you space to focus, explore and express yourself. No achievements, no scoring, no leaderboard. It's about you and the words spending quality time together. A game session can take from 5 minutes to... well, hours. It all depends on how carried away you get. Sometimes you just want a little distraction, and sometimes it gets more introspective. Both are great ways to enjoy the game! Pick words! Compose! Enjoy and Share! FEATURES Thousands of words to choose from! Six beautiful pixel art backgrounds ! An Inspiring chip-tune soundtrack made by the talented c.diffin! Gif recording system: share your art with the world! Streamer-friendly! Ask your viewers for advice, or have a writing workshop all together! Asynchronous multiplayer-ish! 'Shared Game' mode allows players to compose with the same word set using a clever password system. Get together, play and compare your works, or play by yourself, send your friends a poem and wait for theirs! ... That's it, really. It's a small game. Ok, my poem is ready. What do I win? Well, you win… a .gif of your creation, to use however you see fit! Maybe you'll be so proud that you'll post it on every social media. Maybe it'll remind you of a loved one. Why not send it like a digital postcard? Maybe it'll be personal, so you'll simply keep it close. As a souvenir. Maybe it won't make much sense. That's okay, things don't always have to make sense. Maybe you just won't like it. That's okay too, writing is hard. You can try again later. Point is, I can't tell what you'll get out of it. But it's probably worth exploring!
row.short_description: Will The Man Get Frog is a chill little game about composing silly or sweet haikus (short poems) and sharing them with the world! Don't worry about the blank page, the game will provide words for you. Just arrange them the best you can!

row.name: 3DC
row.detailed_description: 3DC is an educational video game to raise awareness about depression among children between 8 and 12 years old. The game teaches the main symptoms and risk factors, the importance of empathizing with those affected and the need to ask for help if they recognize themselves in a similar situation. Players live a day in the life of Dante, a 9-year-old boy who has developed depression. They will go through his daily tasks to learn about his problems and try to help him. To do so, they will have to learn about his thoughts, talk to his family and overcome several mini-games.
row.short_description: 3DC is a graphic adventure that teaches children from 8 to 12 years old what depression is.

row.name: Feast Tower
row.detailed_description: ¿Qué tan alto puedes hacer tu propio sándwich? Feast Tower te dará horas de diversión, ya sea que elijas jugar en solitario o compartir la experiencia con tus amigos de manera local. Feast Tower es un minijuego desarrollado por Orange Planet Lab y University of Advanced Technologies (UNIAT) con el reto de planear, diseñar y programar este juego en tan solo un mes, el equipo de Orange Planet está comprometido con la constante evolución y mejora del juego, con futuras actualizaciones diseñadas para enriquecer la experiencia de los jugadores. UNIAT ha colaborado en desarrollar este minijuego con la intención de inspirar a nuestros alumnos y comunidad creativa a adentrarse a la creación y publicación de videojuegos, sin la necesidad de cumplir con los excesivos requisitos asociados a proyectos de nivel AA o AAA, como exuberantes presupuestos y grandes tiempos de producción
row.short_description: Pon a prueba tu destreza en la creación del sándwich más monumental y asegura tu lugar en lo más alto de la puntuación. ¿Te atreves a asumir el desafío?

row.name: Alien Cafe
row.detailed_description: Have you ever wanted to go to space? How about run a restaurant for aliens in space? Well, lucky for you, now you can do both! Your mom always said it was about time you got a job, so get to work and make those customers happy! Earning money, and making a living has never been this easy. You are an Ai bot, built to run a fast-food restaurant so the extra-terrestrial residents of the fleet don't have to. Every day you slave away, doing the same. Job. Every. Day. Do your job wrong, get scrapped, do it right you get to live in the fleet. Is it worth it though, should you break free from the constrains of your programmers?
row.short_description: Run a fast food restaurant for aliens powered by AI, and experience life in space! Cook orders, manage tasks, and make money!

row.name: Cake Game
row.detailed_description: 'Cake Game' is a sweet puzzle game that combines strategy and fun. Your mission is to drop various pastries and cakes into a jar, aiming to combine similar treats to create bigger, more scrumdiddlyumptious delights. With each successful combination, you'll be one step closer to achieving the ultimate pastry: the Legendary Papa Cake! But beware, space is limited, and you'll need to plan your moves carefully to avoid running out of room in the pastry display. The game has three levels of difficulty: easy, medium, and hard. Make a Mama Cake and Papa Cake to get the Steam achievements. Achieve high scores and get on the global leaderboard. Immerse yourself in a world where the visuals are as enticing as the gameplay and accompanied by a lighthearted and engaging soundtrack. Whether you’re a puzzle lover or a pastry lover, 'Cake Game' is sure to satisfy your hunger. So, use your strategic mind and dive into a world where confectioneries and puzzles collide!
row.short_description: Strategize, combine cakes, and bake your way to victory!

row.name: 灵师
row.detailed_description: 欢迎来到灵瀚大陆 感谢大家关注《灵师》，获取最新游戏讯息 QQ交流群：935786519 B站：Var影竹 灵师是一款俯视角开放世界休闲冒险RPG像素游戏，灵瀚大陆灵气复苏，诡怪归来收割生命，大陆所有的国家联合起来成立了联盟，主角亲人被诡物杀害，但在其中却有无法描述的交易，主角需要探索灵瀚大陆寻找当年的真相，为自己复仇。灵瀚大陆最重要的便是灵力修行，和掌握强力的灵技。 游戏有丰富的灵技，分为火，水，雷，土，风五个属性，一共100多种技能 开放世界探索，有丰富的剧情和任务，除了开局交代背景，没有任何的剧情限制 有趣的小游戏，休闲的赚钱玩法（钓鱼，种田，宠物，螳螂比斗，挂彩票，21点，骰宝，装备刷取，塔防小游戏）
row.short_description: 灵师是一款俯视角开放世界休闲冒险RPG像素游戏，灵瀚大陆灵气复苏，诡怪归来收割生命，大陆所有的国家联合起来成立了联盟，主角亲人被诡物杀害，但在其中却有无法描述的交易，主角需要探索灵瀚大陆寻找当年的真相，为自己复仇。灵瀚大陆最重要的便是灵力修行，和掌握强力的灵技。

row.name: Teku
row.detailed_description: Teku is an island-building game using hexagonal tiles. You have a deck of tiles to place on specific, randomly-generated locations. Your goal is to score as many points as possible by positioning the tiles correctly in relation to each other. Each type of tile scores points in different ways. During the game, you'll be taken through levels, each with its own rules, scoring objectives and tiles to assemble. Each game is short, lasting just a few minutes, ideal for short play sessions or the hunt for the top score. When you start, two game modes are immediately available: Classic mode, in which you must place all the tiles in your deck to finish the game. Challenge mode, in which you unlock new tiles as you score points. In this mode, you can place the tiles wherever you like.
row.short_description: Place hexagonal tiles to form islands across a selection of varied levels. Teku is a peaceful game where the goal is to achieve the highest possible score.

row.name: ManaSoul
row.detailed_description: In ManaSoul you take on the role of a Mage in the world of Valeyra! In this world, everyone has the ability to learn magicks, but not everyone can master them! Explore a hand-crafted open world made with passion and love pixel by pixel. Begin your journey to become an Archmage and leave your mark on history! Start a Guild and create memories with friends, challenge yourself against difficult encounters, put yourself to the test against other players in opt-in PvP, discover powerful and ancient artifacts and gear your character, learn hundreds of spells and create your own perfect Mage! Well, what are you waiting for? Valeyra awaits! ManaSoul is free-to-play and features NO Pay-2-Win. Enjoy the fun of Gacha without ANY predatory microtransactions. You heard us right, you CAN'T spend money on the Gacha. Support the development with an optional cosmetic shop with monthly updates, its that simple! Nothing in the game was designed to be inconvenient to sell you a solution and all development is focused on delivering a fun small scale mmo experience to play with your friends. The way it should be. With 4 Elements, 4 Schools of Magick, Dozens of Specializations, hundreds of Spells, and thousands of pieces of loot, you can create a character that plays exactly how you want and that represents your own unique playstyle. The vast majority of content is scaled with creativity and experimentation in mind. You won't be punished with brutal difficulty here unless you look for it. Instead enjoy a vast array of potential playstyles and combos and experiment at your hearts whim, almost anything is viable! Play Solo or with friends, with plenty of content types including non-combat Exploration, Mini-Bosses, World Bosses, Quests, Delves, Trials, Dungeons, Raids, Events, Mini-Games, Guild Wars, and more, you can truly play your way. Join the ManaSoul Community today by joining our Official Discord! Chat directly with the devs, ask questions, make suggestions, meet new friends, and get updates live from the source. We also host giveaways, post teasers, and have a bunch of other fun community stuff happening all the time, so come check it out and join the ManaSoul Community!
row.short_description: ManaSoul is a 2D Pixel Art MORPG where you create and play as your own unique Mage in a world of magic. Play solo or with friends and take on challenges, solve puzzles, and explore the beautiful hand crafted open world.

row.name: Aliya's Ascent
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Bridgeworld Aliya’s Ascent is a character-driven, interactive adventure story filled with amazing cinematic elements about a girl who mysteriously found herself in the middle of a boat towards an unknown land. Embark on a journey in the world of the first Legions, meet familiar faces as you unravel the tales that made the fabric of Bridgeworld & Treasure, every choice you make matters. Aliya’s Ascent is based on the Treasure’s 7-part Bridgeworld community-novel Aliya’s Ascent, also available in Audiobook format. Features Fully illustrated story Complete voiceovers Multiple Endings 50+ Unlockable Gallery Images Gallery view unlocked in the game Trigger Warning Death Violence Larger World of Treasure Aliya’s Ascent is just a part of the larger world of Bridgeworld, a game in the Treasure Ecosystem.
row.short_description: Aliya’s Ascent is a story about a girl who mysteriously found herself in the middle of a boat towards an unknown land. Embark on a journey in the world of the first Legions and meet familiar faces as you unravel the tales that made the fabric of Bridgeworld. Every choice you make matters!

row.name: Hypersomnia
row.detailed_description: JOIN US About the Game Hypersomnia is a hardcore arena mixing eSports with pixely nostalgia. Every match will be unforgiving - every duel a psychological battle. More of a peaceful soul? Unleash your creativity in the WYSIWYG in-game map Editor that lets you instantly playtest your maps online. It's all free and open-source. Written without a game engine, in bare C++. Only 50 MB. Feel free to build it yourself from GitHub and modify Hypersomnia to your heart's content. 24 unique firearms. 2 game modes: Bomb defusal (team-based) and Gun game (free-for all). 6 magic spells, 4 grenade types and 7 melee weapons. An in-game map editor that lets you host a work-in-progress map to test with your friends in a single click . Quickly iterate your map unlike in any game engine. Declare allegiance to one of the three factions whose apple of discord is a disparity between prevailing notions of moral excellence: Metropolis. Atlantis. Resistance. Will you take revenge for the unethical simulation of an inferior universe? Will you support the cruel experiments to win total control over metempsychosis? Or will you join the underground civilization that awaits the end of war in this dangerous afterlife reality?
row.short_description: Challenge your friend to an intense duel, or gather two clans to fight a spectacular war. Reawaken your competitive spirit in this relentless top-down shooter. Comes with an in-game map Editor! Forever free and open-source.
row.reviews: “The whole package is a zany quick blast of adrenaline.” Linux Magazine “Not just fun, it’s technically innovative.” GitHub Blog “Sounds like some impressive tech going on behind the scenes.” Liam @ GamingOnLinux

row.name: Goober Dash
row.detailed_description: Discord About the Game Welcome to Goober Dash, an adrenaline pumping Race Royale, pitting 32 players against each other on hundreds of hand-crafted courses full of hazards to avoid and shortcuts to discover! Play as adorable, customizable characters known as Goobers and run, jump & dash your way to victory. Dash to outmaneuver your opponents, smash through obstacles, or take down rivals in this action-packed race to the finish line! Customize your Goober with a variety of items to make them stand out in the crowd! Collect outfits, emotes, and even unique reactions and celebrations to make your Goober expressive and distinctly unique! row.name: Glitched Out: Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: Glitched Out tells the story of IT Engineer ‘Lex’, who wakes in a government research facility to learn a malware has run rampant. The facility is home to many alien entities who have escaped containment and now stalk our hapless hero through the complex. Lex’s only hope is to team up with an A.I companion known as ‘Chip’ and hack her way to freedom. Along the way Lex and Chip encounter a host of entities, both friendly and hostile, as they seek to uncover the mysterious origin of the security outbreak. (*No actual A.I used in the creation of this game!) The Federal Bureau of Containment was set up to house the many terrifying horrors of the cosmos. Now these monsterous entities have escaped confinement and rampage around the facility unchecked. Lex must use her wits, and ever growing arsenal of tech upgrades, to evade and combat these horrifying creatures. Glitched Out features a nifty hacking device known as the 'Portable Glitch Fixer'. Via a selection of hacking mini-games, this handy tool allows users to fix corrupted power units on the fly and restore power to the facility. With a little help from state of the art A.I companion 'Chip', that is. Glitched Out is an episodic horror game. The story unfolds chapter by chapter. Lore is revealed via cutscenes, environmental storytelling, audio recordings and secret notes. Uncover the truth behind the sinister goings-on at the Federal Bureau of Containment.. if you dare.
row.short_description: Trapped in the depths of a top secret alien research facility, Lex must team up with A.I companion 'Chip' and hack her way to freedom. Along the way, she discovers the sinister secrets of the facility and meets the many monstrous creatures contained within.

Those who purchase the Deluxe Collection: Gold Road will also receive the Deluxe in-game items. Players purchasing the Collection editions can jump into the base game, Gold Road or any previous Chapter right away. The Elder Scrolls Online Upgrade: Gold Road and The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Upgrade: Gold Road includes Gold Road only, plus Deluxe in-game items for those who purchase the Deluxe Upgrade: Gold Road . Digital Deluxe Edition DELUXE Those who purchase The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Upgrade: Gold Road or The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Gold Road will receive the Deluxe in-game items, including: All past Chapter Collector's Edition / Deluxe items** (only included in The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Gold Road ) Mount: West Weald Tharriker Pet: Skingrad Guard Mastiff Outfit Style: Skingrad Vedette Armor Pack Memento: Ulfsild's Tome of Legends Colovian Emote Pack (3 emotes) **Does not include past Chapter pre-order / pre-purchase in-game items. About the Game Begin your journey and experience the unparalleled storytelling and lore of The Elder Scrolls . Explore Tamriel—a massive living universe where your choices shape your adventure. Go it solo or with friends and allies as you explore, quest, craft, and roleplay in a world where you can customize your abilities and gear to suit any playstyle. No game subscription required—buy once, play anytime. GOLD ROAD BRAND-NEW ELDER SCROLLS STORY - For the first time in The Elder Scrolls Online , a new Daedric Prince walks Tamriel. Forgotten to even her most devout followers, Ithelia has returned. Why has she returned now? And what are her followers' plans for West Weald? Embark on an adventure to preserve reality before the threads of fate unravel in Ithelia’s wake. EXPLORE A NEW ZONE - Venture into West Weald, an Imperial region last seen in TES IV: Oblivion, now threatened by the encroaching Valenwood jungle and Daedric incursions. Defend the Colovian capital city of Skingrad, investigate the wilds of the Dawnwood, and explore ancient Ayleid ruins and the mountainous Colovian Highlands, all endangered by the chaos of Ithelia’s return. SCRIBING - Delve into the heart of magic itself with Scribing, a unique system that allows you to customize your playstyle in new and exciting ways. Collect special skills and modify their effects and functionality to make them yours. With Scribing, you truly have the freedom and power to play your way. DISCOVER GREATER ADVENTURE! - Dive into a challenging new 12-person trial called the Lucent Citadel, contend with dangerous world events and bosses, immerse yourself in captivating new delves and public dungeons, earn unique in-game rewards, and much more. COLLECTION Purchase The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Gold Road or The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Gold Road to get instant access to all major Chapter zones, biomes and quest arcs from across Tamriel. The Collection: Gold Road and Deluxe Collection: Gold Road includes the base game, Gold Road and all previous Chapters, as below (plus Deluxe items for those who get the Deluxe Collection: Gold Road ). Gold Road (NEW in 2024) Unlocks instantly: Necrom High Isle Blackwood Greymoor Elsweyr Summerset Morrowind Base game †Those who purchase The Elder Scrolls Online Upgrade: Gold Road or The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Upgrade: Gold Road will receive the Gold Road Chapter - or Gold Road Chapter and Deluxe items, respectively - these versions do not include the previous Chapters or the base game.
row.short_description: A forgotten Daedric Prince has returned, bringing chaos to West Weald! Explore a new zone and defend the city of Skingrad, now beset by a dangerous Daedric cult and the jungles of Valenwood. Customize your skills like never before with the new Scribing system.

row.name: Ghost Knight: A Dark Tale Playtest
Durak NTR: the Fool who lost his gf in a card game
row.detailed_description: Durak (Russian for 'Fool') is a classic card game of skill, chance and risk. Played with the 6-Ace cards from a standard deck of playing cards, 2-4 players take turns attacking and defending in this timeless game of social and psychological domination. Historically tied to gambling, Durak isn't just about winning - it's about what you're willing to lose. Money, possessions... or something far more intimate. Step into the role of James, a cunning and charismatic loan shark, sitting across from your desperate debtor and his beautiful girlfriend Charlotte. The stakes couldn't be higher: their freedom - or her. Each hand raises the tension: win, and you edge closer to claiming Charlotte for yourself. Lose, and they pull away, but for how long? Watch as Charlotte's reactions change with every turn, caught between loyalty and your growing influence. ﻿﻿Win 5 games, and Charlotte becomes entirely yours. ﻿﻿Lose 5, and they escape... if you let them. If Charlotte doesn't suit your tastes or you're hungry for more, DLC girls with unique personalities, reactions, and secrets let you dive even deeper into this thrilling netorare experience. Whether you crave the power of being the bull, relishing every humiliating win, or love living through the torment of a cuck, this game will leave you wanting more. “In this game of passion and humiliation, only the bold take it all.”
row.short_description: Play as James, a ruthless loan shark, and turn the tables on a desperate debtor. Each loss drags his girlfriend closer to you in this humiliating, erotic experience of control, power and desire.
row.notes: Warning: This game contains such topics as netorare, cuckolding, humiliation, nudity and crude language.

row.name: The Labyrinth
row.detailed_description: IMPORTANT: IF YOU WISH TO INCREASE THE VISIBILITY OF THE GAME, PRESS ESCAPE, AND TURN OFF POST PROCESSING UNDER GAMEPLAY NOTE: This is the first game that I have released on Steam as a high school student. Please be patient as I address all the problems and bugs with the game as a solo dev. Welcome to ' The Labyrinth ' – an electrifying multiplayer action platformer that will push your speed, strategy, and teamwork to the limit! Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey through crossroads, pitfalls, and deep treachery? In ' The Labyrinth ,' your mission is clear: win by reaching the coveted gold chest at the end of each level. But don’t be fooled by this seemingly straightforward goal – this game is a whirlwind of challenges and excitement. Special Features Shaped Maps: Each time you play, a map is designed in a way that allows for a unique experience. Say goodbye to monotony and hello to near-infinite replayability! This game thrives on surprises, and improves your ability to adapt to ever-changing environments. Dangerous Roads: Be careful, adventurer! The road to glory is fraught with danger. Insidious traps, insidious obstacles and mind-numbing puzzles await to hinder your progress. Only the cunning and quick-witted will emerge victorious. Multiplayer Mayhem: You are not alone in this journey. 'The Labyrinth' is a multiplayer adventure, which puts you among friends and players around the world in a race to the end. It’s not just about reaching the chest – it’s about getting there before anyone else. Team up or go solo, the choice is yours, but remember, only one can emerge as the ultimate winner of this labyrinthine battlefield. Gameplay Highlights Stunning Visuals and Immersive Soundscape: The game's breathtaking visuals and immersive sound design draw you into its world, where danger and excitement revolve in all cases. Quick thinking, strategic planning, and a bit of fun will guide you through the challenges ahead. Intensive Challenges and Puzzles: Tackle a variety of intense challenges and puzzles that keep you on your toes. Each level presents new challenges that require both skill and strategy to overcome. Competition and Cooperation Opportunities: Whether you're in it for the glory or the fellowship, 'The Labyrinth' offers both competition and cooperation opportunities. Team up with friends to conquer levels together or continue in a headlong race to the end. The Challenge Awaits So gather your friends, lace up your shoelaces, and step into the ever-evolving maze. Will you conquer its treacherous passages and claim victory, or will you fall prey to its deceptive snares? Only time will tell in this electric race for supremacy! Prepare yourself for a unique adventure. Welcome to 'The Labyrinth.' Enjoy! :)
row.short_description: Race friends in trap-filled mazes. Reach the gold chest first in 'The Labyrinth' – Can you escape?

row.name: Undeads
row.detailed_description: Undeads is a PvP-PvE top-down shooter where survival is earned through skill, tactics, and a bit of luck. Explore devastated cities, scavenge for loot, fight zombies and players alike, and build your reputation in a brutal post-apocalyptic world where trust is a rare commodity. Pure gameplay. No generative AI. No blockchain. No NFTs. No crypto. Fast-paced firefights and explosive action await. Switch between guns, experiment with loadouts, and make every shot count. Open chests, collect rare items, and upgrade your gear. Sell what you don’t need after each raid and gear up for the next one. Enter brutal PvP battles and fight for dominance. Use tactics, precision, and timing to outsmart every opponent. Discover, collect, and upgrade hundreds of weapons — from classic rifles to experimental gear. Find your perfect loadout and show the world what true firepower looks like. GAMEPLAY FEATURES Random player placement – each new match starts with players spawning in random locations, making every run unpredictable. Play as humans or zombies – both sides have unique abilities and combat styles. Experiment to find your ultimate strategy. Ranking and rewards – perform well in matches to climb the leaderboard and earn in-game currency. Resource management – search for water, food, medicine, weapons, ammo, and valuable loot. Everything you find stays with you — if you survive. Safe storage system – all collected items go into your personal vault. Expand your storage to keep more gear for future raids. In-game store – trade with merchants, sell unwanted loot, and buy new weapons, ammo, and characters. Don’t miss limited-time offers! Equipment durability – every weapon and armor piece wears down over time. Keep your gear in shape or risk losing it mid-fight. Permanent death warning – if your character dies, everything carried is lost. Choose wisely what to take and what to leave behind. UNDEADS WORLD The greed of corrupt politicians, the zombie virus pandemic, reckless experiments to create super-soldiers, and sheer human panic have forged a grim world where anyone can be an ally — or an enemy. On the battlefields, you’ll encounter townspeople and farmers, builders and engineers, bandits and hunters, survivalists and scavengers, nomads and soldiers. They face reanimated corpses, plague carriers, blood-soaked butchers, ghouls, mutant zombies, and even cybernetic undead warriors. All of them fight for a place to exist among the ruins of civilization. Choose your characters and master their unique abilities. Form alliances or betray your partners when it serves your survival. Gather resources, upgrade your weapons, and rise through the ranks to carve your name into the legend of the Undeads world!
row.short_description: Embark on a risky but exciting journey through the world of Undeads. Search for weapons, armor, supplies and medicine. Survive or hunt survivors. Enjoy unique matches, sell your loot, and fight bloody and challenging battles against the background of the zombie apocalypse!

row.name: Pacific Minesweeper
row.detailed_description: Overview: Advanced physics engine for an arcade style gameplay High-resolution graphics with 8K monitor support Suitable for all ages Immersive sound effects enhancing underwater experience Multilanguage interface for global accessibility No time limits for stress-free strategic play Dynamic score system based on skill and strategy Progressive difficulty with fewer shots at higher levels Engaging warning system for heightened tension Optional: Internet connection required only for leaderboards and achievements INTRODUCTION Dive into the Pacific's depths in a submersible, navigating through different areas to defuse mines and score points. GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW Your mission is to remove six mines, numbered from 1 to 6, from the seafloor using a remotely guided submersible drone. Select using the cross cursor and direct your drone with pinpoint accuracy. But beware, each move is a test of skill and judgment – one wrong shot and you risk a catastrophic underwater explosion. SCORE AND CHALLENGE Score points by successfully removing mines, with each mine's score value calculated using a dynamic formula. The stakes rise with each level, demanding greater precision and strategic foresight. URGENCY AND TENSION Keep an eye on the shot counter! If it reaches zero, you'll face the consequences of an unremoved mine: an underwater detonation and you lose a life. A warning bleep adds to the tension, signaling your last chance to act. As you advance, the game intensifies, offering fewer shots and increasing the challenge. RISK AND PENALTY Mistakes carry a heavy price. Failing to strike a mine or accidentally removing your aiming drone results in the loss of one of your four lives. Each firing decision will be the difference between victory and defeat. GET STARTED Ready to embark on this underwater mission and become the ultimate mine hunter ? Simply hit the start button in the main menu.
row.short_description: Dive into the Pacific's depths in a submersible, navigating through different areas to defuse mines and score points. Aim for precision with limited shots. Avoid errors to keep your lives. Experience high-stakes, strategic gameplay in this free singleplayer adventure!

row.name: End Of Life
row.detailed_description: End of Life is a third-person action shooter set in a fragmented and ever-moving city, rotating like a Rubik's Cube. The player will shoot needles to overcome enemies and obstacles, dodge deadly attacks, and navigate the changing landscape with a grappling hook, always seeking an advantageous position to eliminate rivals. Story The world is governed by two goddesses. Asdis is the creator, while Disad must balance her sister's creations to prevent chaos. When Asdis creates humans, her greatest creation, Disad decides to divide her power and personify it in the Aarendjin, an extension of herself. The mission of the Aarendjin is to kill those humans who pose a real threat to the planet. Over time, a city discovered the Aarendjin's weakness and started a war to acquire the magic within them. They killed them all and stole their power cores, except for one, Nashla, whom they imprisoned. This power allowed the city to be in constant motion, rotating on itself, preventing Nashla from escaping. Years later, a revolt within the city aimed to kill the Aarendjin, providing Nashla with the perfect opportunity to execute her plan: recover her core and seek revenge on humans for killing her sisters. What is End Of Life? Changing World: A world based on a Rubik's Cube that the player and enemies can manipulate to create combat situations, new paths, and challenges. Multiple Gravities: Each area of the world has its gravity, with no safe spots when enemies can shoot from the sky. Relentless Movement: Everything in this world is in motion—the player, enemies, and the world itself. Constantly changing, the player must strive to find their way through battles and gravities. Gameplay End of Life is a third-person action shooter where the player embodies a demigoddess with a broken power seeking revenge and reclaiming stolen power. The player faces decisions that define whether they remain faithful to their original mission or succumb to revenge. The player must use the demigoddess's remaining powers and the world's resources. Different gravities and world modifications create new paths and allow the player to escape enemies when unable to face them. During the adventure, the demigoddess will find traces of her fallen sisters, recovering part of their powers. These powers grant her new abilities to progress in the world and new tools to defeat her enemies. Mechanics Navigation Gravity Shift: The game world is fragmented, and each fragment has its gravity on each face. Nashla can observe the world from different perspectives, finding paths that would be invisible otherwise. World Movement: The fragmented world is constantly moving, and the civilization residing there has created mechanisms to alter the world's movement at will. Nashla will use these to turn her enemies' tools against them. Grappling Hook: Nashla's main tool is a grappling hook, constantly used to reach otherwise inaccessible places and quickly approach enemies to finish them off before they can react. Combat Needles: Needles symbolize Nashla's power, each type providing effects to her projectiles. Each needle she carries once belonged to her fallen sisters. Bullet Time: Nashla's keen senses allow her to enter a state of total concentration. In this state, the world slows around her, allowing for quick decisions and providing a devastating advantage. Fury: As a vengeful demigoddess, Nashla becomes enraged at the mortals' challenge. When Nashla accumulates enough anger, she enters a Fury state, launching her projectiles more frequently and forcefully. The needles she launches in this state drain life from her enemies to heal her. Barriers: Enemies, aware of their weakness, constantly try to corner and wear down Nashla. Using complex magical barrier mechanisms, they will trap the demigoddess in an inescapable battle to weaken and defeat her. Core Loop The core of End of Life is primarily divided into three parts: advancing through the level, killing all enemies in the way, and discovering how to use her powers to interact with the world. This core loop represents a partnership between the player and their avatar, discovering the world and the demigoddess's powers at the same pace, fostering player immersion and empathy. Throughout the adventure, the player's style will reinforce each of the three core elements, from trying to advance by avoiding unnecessary conflicts to exploring the presented world or simply ending all life like a bloodthirsty beast. The decision of which aspect to reinforce will depend on the player's gameplay style, reflecting in Nashla's adventure their own story. Visual Style End of Life features a fusion of realistic environments and stylized characters, providing greater creative freedom while maintaining realistic textures for consistency. The environment represents a Middle Eastern style with warm, earthy, and luminous colors in squares where life once thrived. The warm tones contrast with Nashla's cool palette, indicating she doesn't belong to this world. The world is portrayed as a Rubik's Cube mirror, with marked edges and different sizes present throughout the entire scenario. It floats disorderly due to the ongoing war, constantly rotating and repositioning as the protagonist advances in the story. The sense of enormity and frenzy is reflected in all the cubes sustaining the world, and the magnitude in each playable scenario. Magic is prevalent throughout the game, playing a fundamental role. It's represented with brighter and more vivid colors in the environment, highlighting the game's mechanics. References The dynamic and changing world created in Doctor Strange inspired the game's dynamic landscape, covering both land and sky, the constant change through battles, and the extraordinary yet partially common landscapes. Rollerdrome is a central reference regarding gameplay. The combination of action with constant movement is a point that End Of Life seeks to achieve. The game's story draws strong influences from Hellblade, where both protagonists embark on a revenge story and face psychological issues distorting their perception of reality and objectives. The world-based puzzles served as inspiration for level design.
row.short_description: End of Life is a third-person shooter that takes place in a city that is fragmented and in constant motion. These fragments that make up the city rotate as if it were a Rubik's Cube, creating different gravitational directions that allow the player to traverse the city.

row.name: Project: NEO
row.detailed_description: Project: NEO is a sci-fi action roguelike game. You play as a newly-hired ‘Planet Adventurer’, whose job is to set out and explore the exciting yet dangerous areas beyond the city. You will fight many hostile creatures as you navigate the three distinct regions surrounding the city. Gather ore and gain coins to spend on upgrades when you return home. While you're there, chat with the local inhabitants and get to know them. This is Project: NEO. (and did we mention, it’s completely free to play! ) Features - An immersive world - 5 different environments - Randomly generated map layouts - Gather resources - Upgrade gear - A local community you can interact with - And so much more! Developer Notes Project: NEO was created by a small team of passionate developers over the course of a few months. Considering it's the first game we have created on our own, we are proud and confident in how our project turned out. However, we are also aware that the game is not perfect, but as we worked through it we treated it as a learning experience to grow our skills so that we can create games that provide the exact experience a gamer wants in their game. We hope you enjoyed this little project we put together. -Project: NEO Team
row.short_description: A free-to-play sci-fi action roguelike game set in an alien world where the sun never shines. Explore the world as a ‘Planet Adventurer’. Fight hostile creatures, gather ore, and interact with the local community in your downtime. Upgrade your gear with resources earned during your expeditions.

row.name: Grimhook
row.detailed_description: Embark on a harrowing journey beneath the ruins of the once-vibrant city of Miletos. Grimhook, a fast-paced, first-person action-adventure game, thrusts you into the heart of a flooded wasteland where robotic minions reign supreme and an ancient deity lies dormant beneath the city's surface. As Dart, you'll harness powerful abilities to navigate through cavernous depths; grapple, bounce, dash, and slash your way through relentless automata in intense combat arenas while you experience a grim world and a somber narrative. Game Features: Fast-paced First-Person Platforming: Unleash a myriad of Lovecraftian abilities as you navigate the caverns of Miletos. Time and combine your powers to swiftly traverse the game's terrain and outmaneuver your enemies. Tightly Tuned Combat: Engage in intense battles in multiple combat arenas, utilizing your powers to dodge bullets and decimate robotic foes. Watch as fully destructible adversaries explode, leaving a chaotic aftermath on the battlefield. Explore a Cavernous World: Traverse dilapidated skyscrapers, rushing rapids, and forgotten excavations in a sprawling subterranean world. Encounter diverse biomes that add depth and variety to your adventure. Hand-Painted Art Style: Immerse yourself in a somber environment brought to life by a carefully hand-painted art style, capturing the melancholic beauty of a city on the brink of ruin. Immersive Audio Experience: Immerse yourself in the tragic journey with over 10 electronic tracks in the musical score, composed by BelowCloudNine. Voiced Characters: Two fully voiced characters bring intimacy to the narrative and characterize the unlikely camaraderie between Dart and the dormant deity beneath the city. Dynamic Animations and Cutscenes: Dynamic first-person animations strike a vivid contrast with the desaturated world. Multiple fully authored first-person cutscenes enhance the immersive storytelling experience.
row.short_description: Bounce, dash, and grapple through flooded caverns in this fast-paced first-person action platformer. Descend into Grimhook's sunken ruins as Dart, mastering Lovecraftian powers and decimating robotic foes. Explore, battle, and unravel the mysteries below Miletos.
row.reviews: “A sweet, free first-person platformer with a touch of Lovecraft” Rock, Paper, Shotgun

row.name: World War Next
row.detailed_description: WORLD WAR NEXT IS IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT WITH NEW UPDATES EVERY WEEK AND A NEW MAP EVERY TWO WEEKS. WE FIX ALL REPORTED BUGS & ISSUES. WE RELY ON COMMUNITY INVOLVEMENT TO HELP DECIDE WHICH FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS SHOULD COME NEXT. World War Next is a low poly multiplayer FPS set during a World War 3 conflict. Team up in squads to battle it out on real-world locations like Odesa Port, Donbas, and Taiwan. Maps aim to focus on the Eastern European, South Pacific and Middle Eastern theatres. Choose from over 25 countries and vehicles like tanks, helicopters, boats and armored cars help players get around fast. We've built the core gameplay features of World War Next and are now focused on adding more higher polished maps based on real locations, optimizing, improving player count and adding popular features that the community requests. WHATS NEXT? The full version of World War Next will focus on the features the players love the most. The goal is to find the perfect balance between casual and tactical FPS. We want to improve on our humble offering of maps by adding more higher polished, higher quality maps, both large and small. The maps will be based on real possible World War 3 battle locations in the Pacific Theatre, Eastern European Theatre and Middle Eastern Theatre. We want to improve support for more players, first 32 then 50+. We will add support for proximity voice chat with more weapons and a weapon levelling system. We want tighter vehicle controls with smoother, more optimized gameplay. We'll add more game modes and a completed UI/UX. COMMUNITY The community is the heart and soul of World War Next. The community will vote on which maps are next, which theatres and countries to focus on and what authentic tanks, planes, boats and weapons should be remade in low poly. Our Discord server is the main hub for interactions. By joining, you can share feedback, report bugs, find squad members and engage with other players. By being low poly, World War Next has the unique opportunity of being able to release an entirely new map within a week or two of a real battle breaking out. Being this adaptable allows us to stay on top of breaking news and create an experience unlike anything seen before. A live game to reflect the World War 3 conflict featuring authentic maps, vehicles, weapons, and uniforms – all in glorious low poly.
row.short_description: World War Next is a low poly multiplayer FPS set during a WW3 conflict, Choose from over 25 countries. Vehicles like tanks, helicopters, boats and armored cars help players get around quickly.

As the Adjutant of Heimdall Force, bravely undertake missions alongside Manifestations with the powers of gods and unique personalities, seeking to bring this bitter winter to an end... [Enjoy Hybrid Combat] Snowbreak's weaponry injects realism into a sci-fi setting, with designs closely simulating future firearms technology. This combines with the otherworldly, RPG-like skill mechanic to create a refreshing combat experience. [Take on Titans] The Descent of the Titans completely changed the world, and the battlefield. row.detailed_description: Believe in it, and anything can be the truth. When Lovan opened his eyes again, the ship was in utter chaos. Many crew members died for unknown reasons, leaving only six survivors on the ship. The specter of the deceased crew members spread fear. While Lovan was still trying to make sense of the situation, the 'Messiah' appeared. He wants you to find the murderer hidden among the surviving crew members and kill him. So Lovan, with a mixture of doubt and determination, began his mission to save everyone... He will face yet more choices... Game Features Players will explore the ship from the perspective of Rowan. Search for a water source before dehydration sets in. Uncover the truth about the deaths of other sailors on the stylistically intense ship. This game contains elements such as blood and violence and is not suitable for those who may find these elements disturbing. Also contains elements of depression, suicide, etc., please consider carefully before playing if sensitive.
