row.name: RaceTrap
row.detailed_description: Welcome to The World of RaceTrap Experience an entire world devoted to the brutal art of racing! For aeons, the diverse tribes of RaceTrap have been practicing the oldest ritual: racing. Countless drivers devote their lives to complete the ultimate challenge of winning a race for the entertainment of the gods. Complete a set number of laps on the ceremonial track with your life intact to prove your devotion and please the gods testing you from above! Spend fuel on Awesome Powers to Evade the Challenges Laid out by the Gods Create Decks Using Cards From up to 2 Tribes Choose a God and cherub, and use their unique cards to exert your divine will upon the races below. Spend Devotion to Play Devious Spells and Traps from your Deck of Tricks Activate Traps Show no Mercy as you Destroy the Cars Below! Gnomes The gnome tribe is one of the most zealous tribes in the world. Gnome gods build shrines and cast prayers to maximize the devotion they can spend on their particular flavour of chaos. Lizards The lizards are a tricky bunch... Drivers racing for these gods need to be on their toes to anticipate surprise traps and wily tricks. An industrious tribe, lizard gods place pressure plates and scouts to automate the activation of their traps. They also have an affinity for generally messing with the drivers, taking away agency through smokescreens and tricks like reversing the cars controls. Plants This tribe of sentient plants comprised primarily of mushroom men is terribly misunderstood. One of the most benevolent pantheons in RaceTrap, they devote their energy into cultivation. Gods of this tribe tend to cultivate a fruitful harvest of cards from their deck. Unfortunately, despite their best intentions of beautifying the track, the items they grow tend to harm the drivers more than help. Insects The insect tribe is one of the most sinister tribes in the land. Drivers unfortunate enough to race against the insect gods should prepare for a harrowing experience. The gods of this tribe like to play with their food. They tend to pin the cars in place with webs, honey or worst of all, giant overwhelming swarms. Gain XP to unlock new cards, items and skins All New Multiplayer Expansion Featuring: Up to 4 Trappers Up to 8 Racers Teams or FFA Host Public or Private Lobbies Set your Round Time & Laps Coming soon... More GameModes (Role Switching each round / multiple drivers / multiple gods etc.) Ranked Matchmaking Designer VR support More Tribes
row.short_description: Arcade racer that lets you choose to race as your top driver in a custom car or wield traps as the ultimate racing deity.

row.name: PsychShift
row.detailed_description: Welcome to 'PsychShift' - A Mind-Altering FPS Adventure! Dive into the heart of the NeuroHive, a mysterious laboratory where reality twists, and your mind is your most potent weapon. 'PsychShift' is an FPS experience that combines innovative mechanics with a gripping narrative, challenging you to navigate through the labyrinthine corridors of the NeuroHive. Key Mechanics: 1. Mindswap: Master the art of Mindswap, a groundbreaking ability that allows you to switch places with enemies. Swap health, ammo, and location on the fly to outmaneuver your adversaries and conquer the challenges that lie ahead. 2. Parkour: Embrace the freedom of movement with dynamic Parkour elements. Wall run in a state of flow and stick to walls in a static state, allowing you to traverse the NeuroHive with unparalleled agility. Your acrobatic prowess becomes a vital asset in your quest for escape. 3. NeuroNetwork: Manipulate time with the NeuroNetwork, slowing it down to enhance your combat finesse. Execute lightning-fast Mindswaps and utilize the push-pull mechanic with precision, creating a symphony of destruction as you navigate the NeuroHive. 4. Push Pull Objects: Shape your environment with the unique Push-Pull mechanic. Pull ledges into existence or push objects to create cover, adding a strategic layer to the fast-paced FPS action. Adapt the NeuroHive to your advantage, turning the tables on your enemies. 5. Shooting: Engage in intense firefights with a diverse arsenal of weapons. Perfect your marksmanship skills as you face off against enemies in the ever-shifting NeuroHive. Combine your shooting abilities with the game's unique mechanics for a truly immersive FPS experience. Story: As a blank slate, you wake up in the NeuroHive, driven by an instinctual need to escape. A mysterious guiding voice urges you forward as you navigate through the labyrinth, encountering the Warden, a formidable guardian standing between you and freedom. Your journey is a relentless climb through the layers of the NeuroHive, with each level bringing new challenges and revelations. Prepare for a mind-bending FPS experience! 'PsychShift' will push your reflexes, strategic thinking, and parkour skills to the limit. Unravel the mysteries of the NeuroHive, and let the adrenaline-fueled action immerse you in a world where every shot counts. Your escape from the NeuroHive begins now!
row.short_description: PsychShift is a unique take on the fast and frenetic First-Person Shooter/Parkour formula. With one core mechanic at its center, the ability to instantaneously swap minds with nearly any enemy you choose. Taking on both their current position and also their characteristics.

row.name: Puzzle Cube
row.detailed_description: Puzzle Cube was initially developed as a game jam entry for the theme 'Life in 2 Dimensions'. It provides a variation on the challenge of solving the 3x3 cube, by limiting the view of the 3D cube to a 2D perspective and limiting the controls somewhat. The cube can be manipulated to any of the possible configurations that a Rubik's Cube* can. This current version of Puzzle Cube has been developed and is being published as a resume piece. Because of this, it will always be free! With enough interest, development will continue, adding more features to the game. FEATURES Online Leaderboards Various Music, Background, & Cube Skin settings The timer can be disabled (must return to the main menu to re-enable it) Tutorial Video Link for learning to solve the cube Keyboard & Controller support (tested w/XBox One Controller) * Puzzle Cube is not associated with or endorsed by Rubik's Cube. This software does not infringe on any Rubik's Cube patents or trademarks. Copyright does not apply to the physical Rubik's Cube product.
row.short_description: Solve the 3x3 cube from a 2D perspective and set a record time! Tutorial video available on YouTube via in-game link. Various backgrounds, music, and cube skins to customize the experience. The timer can be turned off for learning or casual play. Online leaderboards track best times.

row.name: Mannerheim's Saloon Car
row.detailed_description: Marshal Mannerheim’s Saloon Car is the train carriage that was used by Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim and his personnel in 1939-1946. Mannerheim was the commander-in-chief of Finland’s defense forces during World War II, and later he became the president of Finland. During the winter war between Finland and Soviet Union, Mannerheim traveled nearly 79 000 kilometers with the train. This historical train carriage is currently located in Mikkeli, Finland, where it can be visited once a year on June 4th. This application allows its user to visit Mannerheim’s Saloon Car in VR and to explore old items, documents, photo albums, film clips, and even listen to historical radio broadcasts. It is possible to choose from two languages: English or Finnish. The app was developed by Xamk Game Studios at South-Eastern Finland University of Applied Sciences in the ARMikkeli project. The project was partially funded by the South Savo Regional Council from the European Regional Development Fund.
row.short_description: Explore Mannerheim’s historical train carriage from World War II using this educational VR application.
publishers: Sodan ja rauhan keskus Muisti, Päämajamuseo

row.name: WATCHER
row.detailed_description: 게임 소개 '악몽 속에서 나를 주시하는 미지의 존재' WATCHER는 Unreal Engine을 기반으로 작업한 1인칭 공포게임입니다. 플레이어는 점점 악몽이 심해지는 한 인물의 입장에서 게임을 플레이하게 됩니다. 심화하는 악몽과 추격해 오는 악몽 속 주시자. 일기를 주워 무슨 일이 있었는지 확인하고 퍼즐을 풀어 악몽 속에서 탈출하는 것이 목표입니다. 게임 스토리 점점 가혹해지는 회사 업무와 병약한 연인의 급작스러운 불치병으로 인해 피폐해 주인공. 일기를 써가며 심란한 마음을 달래지만 점점 무너져 갑니다. 주인공의 무너진 마음을 비웃듯 매일 밤마다 악몽을 꾸게 되고 시간이 지날수록 심화되고 이내 주인공의 공포 속에서 유령이 등장하게 됩니다. 유령은 주인공을 집요하게 추격하고 영혼을 갉아먹습니다. 그런 주인공의 입장에서 게임을 플레이하고 플레이어는 2가지 결말에 도달하게 됩니다. 일기를 확인하세요. 주인공이 점점 피폐해지는 과정을 담은 일기장이 맵에 배치되어 있습니다. 이 게임에서 일기장은 게임 스토리를 전달하기 위한 주된 매개체입니다. 일기장을 모아 스토리를 감상하고 주인공에게 무슨 일이 있었는지 확인하세요. 다가오는 유령 조심하세요! 유령은 당신을 집요하게 추격해옵니다. 유령을 피해 퍼즐을 풀고 탈출구를 향해 나아가세요. 만약 스테이지 진행 중 유령이 플레이어에게 닿는다면 즉시 사망하게 됩니다.
row.short_description: WATCHER는 PC 싱글 플레이 기반의 공포게임 입니다. 2가지 스테이지가 준비되어 있습니다! 사무실과 밀실을 돌아다니며 퍼즐과 스토리 아이템을 모으고 다가오는 적의 추격을 피해 살아남으세요. 적은 넓은 범위로 배회하고 당신을 집요하게 추격할 것이며 플레이어는 적을 피해 달아나야 합니다. 피폐해진 주인공의 악몽 속에서 악몽의 발생 원인을 스토리 아이템을 통해 알아내고 결말에 도달하세요.

row.name: Medieval Machines Builder - First Siege
row.detailed_description: Prepare to take your first steps into a world of medieval intrigue, craftsmanship, and warfare. Will you withstand the First Siege and lay the groundwork for a legacy that echoes through the ages? The journey begins with Medieval Machines Builder - First Siege . Key Features 🛠️ Tools: Master the art of siege construction with a diverse array of tools at your disposal. Precision is key as you forge the instruments of war that will shape the battlefield. 🌾 Gathering: Venture into the medieval wilderness to gather essential resources for your siege endeavors. 🎯 Testing: Put your creations to the test on the proving grounds. 💥 Demolishing: In war, destruction is as crucial as construction. Learn the delicate balance of tearing down enemy fortifications with powerful siege engines, unleashing chaos upon your foes. 🏰 Building Siege Machines: Be the architect of devastation. Construct an arsenal of siege machines, from trebuchets to battering rams, each meticulously designed to breach enemy defenses and secure your dominance. 🔗 Connect with the Community: Join a community of fellow lords and ladies, share your experiences, and provide feedback as we collectively shape the evolution of the Medieval Machines Builder. Join other medieval fans on our discord: This is a prologue of the Medieval Machines Builder game that is coming out soon. If you've liked the prologue you will love full version of the game. Add it to the wishlist to be the first to know all news, a release date, and discounts.
row.short_description: Embark on a captivating journey back to the roots of medieval conflict with Medieval Machines Builder - First Siege. This free-to-play simulation game offers a taste of the grandeur and challenges that await in the full game. Design, build, and destroy. Medieval lethal weapons await you!

row.name: Controlled Death
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Our Multiplayer FPS Game! Experience the thrill of intense combat with a plethora of exciting features. Choose from three game modes: Team Deathmatch, Free For All, and Capture the Flag . Communicate effectively with voice team chat and lobby chat . Engage in battles alongside intelligent AI players , and utilize the player team system for organized gameplay in both private and public matches. Select from four distinct player classes— Assault, Engineer, Support, and Recon —each with unique abilities, and arm yourself with eight types of weapons, including Rifle, Sniper, Shotgun, Pistol, Grenade, Molotov, Grenade Launcher, and Knife . Features Advanced weapon handling , damage indicators , and the ability to kick disruptive players via the kick vote system . The game features a start countdown , Photon offline support , slide, jump, and crouch player movements , manual and automatic team selection , and various fire modes such as automatic, single, and semi-automatic . Experience precise synchronization of bullets and positions, realistic fall damage , comprehensive server statistics , optional health regeneration , kill feeds , scoreboards , and room time limits . Quality Features Include Headshot detection , foot IK placement , bullet trails , maximum kill limits , adjustable weapon FOV , ping limits , player identification , footstep sounds , in-room chat , smooth weapon movements , networked weapon pickups , weapon drops upon death , player waiting periods , throwable ammo and medic kits , kill cameras , teammate health bars , customizable UGUI crosshairs , network stats , friendly fire options , team switching mid-game , and optimized high performance for seamless gameplay. Head into the Battle field and have fun. Just not racisim.
row.short_description: Multiplayer FPS Game that has Quality Features including, bullet trails, kill limits, and adjustable FOV. Some server features is ping limits player identification. And we have a few Maps.

row.name: Dreamslayer
row.detailed_description: Dreamslayer is a student project developed in Unreal Engine 5 as a part of the year-long Diploma of Information Technology: Game Art and Design, Game Programming at Swinburne University of Technology . Each class group becomes a development team working on a single game project, from conception all the way to public release. Slay Your Demons Dreamslayer is an epic fantasy first-person hack’n’zap swarm arena game with retro styling. Play as Argeniton, a holy warrior ascended to dragon form, as a demon invasion engulfs your world from beyond the stars. Roused to war, you cross the dimensional threshold to confront Demon Lord Xondadus in his floating citadel of Cazardia, only to be trapped in an endless nightmare. Your dragon form is stripped from you. But this is not defeat. This is your final test. Defeat the hordes, confront Xondadus, regain your power, and break the dream – only then could you truly take your place amongst the gods.
row.short_description: Dreamslayer is an epic fantasy first-person hack’n’zap swarm arena game with retro styling. Defend your world from a Demon invasion from beyond the stars.
row.notes: Dreamslayer contains highly stylized and exaggerated depictions of blood and gore from enemy demons (blood splatters, dismemberment, death via explosions), as well as horror imagery of demons and demonic settings.

row.name: BLEED RUNNER
row.detailed_description: BLEED RUNNER is a 2.5D cyberpunk beat-em-up in which a lone knight fights an encroaching plague! Suddenly stricken with the disease, seek the cure on the mysterious spaceship and survive by grabbing, throwing, and pummeling enemies for blood! Survive a lethal plague by leeching your enemies’ blood Bask in the carnage from the perspective of security cameras in 2.5D Sprint through a dangerous spaceship where everything wants you dead Bonuses Gamepad support and keyboard controls with left- and right-handed bindings Accessibility settings for screenshake and hitstop intensity A DOWNLOADABLE SOUNDTRACK!! Inspired by classic space operas and ultra-violent combat games, BLEED RUNNER was created in collaboration between USC Games and the Berklee College of Music for USC's CTIN 489 ('Intermediate Game Design and Production') class for the Spring 2023 semester, by: Developers: Gladeline Rufo, Gage Tilly Audio Director/Producer: Carlos M. Bru Composers: Jackson Kubo, Brandon Skylar Sound Designers: Christopher Tan Ken Sen, Malachi del Rosario Publishing: Vikram Gonuguntla, Max Cavun, Luke Todaro, Ed Zobrist Special Thanks: Aaron Cheney, Paul Bellezza, Al Yang, Alex Tomkow
row.short_description: BLEED RUNNER is a 2.5D cyberpunk beat-em-up in which a lone knight fights an encroaching plague! Suddenly stricken with the disease, seek the cure on the mysterious spaceship and survive by grabbing, throwing, and pummeling enemies for blood.

row.name: ArenaWar
row.detailed_description: Get ready to live the real FPS Arena experience. In this game you will be able to face other players with many weapons in a large map. The game allows you to play free-for-all multiplayer games in an arena equipped with different weapons and pick-ups.  Compared to the first versions of the game, many bugs have been corrected and in the future further updates may be released to resolve them and to modify and expand the current map, as well as adding new weapons and improving various aspects of the gameplay.  You can report any problem to the email address specified in the support section.  Currently it is possible to play exclusively with mouse and keyboard but there is the possibility that Gamepad support will be added.  What can I say? Jump into the fray and challenge your friends. Who will be the best?
row.short_description: FPS Arena Competitive multiplayer

row.name: Really Dog
row.detailed_description: There are 7 types of dogs, each with unique skills and symbolic meanings. You can feel the joy of harvesting monsters, very decompression. The basic gameplay is a bit like whack-a-mole, easy to understand. In DLC, we provide Paku Mode, Mini Mode, and the Endless Level. We recommend it to players who enjoy challenges.
row.short_description: You see a dog. It pees the sea. You smash it! This is a refreshing small single player game.

row.name: Nut City Blues
row.detailed_description: STORY Nut City Police Department is full of eccentric characters. Captain Fox, for example, is a venerated veteran police officer whose favourite day of the week is Monday. And the new intern, Detective Raccoon, is a young, dumb and hot-headed pizza lover who is always sniffing for ways to bend the rules. The unlikely pair have to team up this summer to explore Nut City’s neon-washed streets, meet its strange citizens, and tackle bizarre cases. Danger looms around the corner, but love also blossoms. Be careful of where to look and which path to choose, because all actions have consequences. Will Captain Fox and Detective Raccoon form a deeper bond, or part ways in bitterness? The future is in your paws. FEATURES Crudely drawn but still lovable pixel animals Various unique locations with secrets to uncover Casual puzzles 5 comical thrilling cases! 6 endings! CONTROLS Mouse Left Click/Space Bar - Advances dialogue CTRL - Fast forward F - Toggles full-screen mode INSPIRATIONS The character dynamics are loosely inspired by Cyberpunk 2077, The Darkside Detective , The X-Files , and 90s buddy cop movies.
row.short_description: A comedy-mystery visual novel about Captain Fox, Detective Raccoon and the danger of pineapple pizza.

row.name: 时空传说-佣兵王战记 Playtest
Battle Poet
row.detailed_description: Demons have come from the north. You are Yutai, an acolyte of the Holy Men. When monsters descend on your village and the blades of warriors are found useless against them, the responsibility falls on you to go to the Holy Mountain and defeat them using the only weapon they fear; poetry. Become a Battle Poet Mix and match lines of poetry strategically to defeat your enemies. Every line has a unique effect, and the poems you create with them are up to you. Overcome Ever-Changing Dangers Every attempt to reach the mountain's summit plays differently. The enemies you face, the poetry lines you choose from, and the characters you interact with will change every playthrough. Reclaim the Holy Mountain Cleanse the mountain from the Yokani, demons who have corrupted its holy places, encountering characters from the world of Idaris on your journey. Discover a Labour of Love Created entirely by a single person, Battle Poet has been hand-crafted with a love of mythology, poetry, and roguelike games.
row.short_description: Battle demons with poetry to reclaim the Holy Mountain in this Strategy Roguelike about combining lines of poetry in turn-based combat.

row.name: THE MULLER-POWELL PRINCIPLE: Foreword
row.detailed_description: You are Harry Herman, an employee of the scientific organization Delta Laboratories, which was engaged in studies of possible ways to travel through dimensions. You were a part of a project that was supposed to benefit all humanity, but something went very wrong. Solve different puzzles and outsmart your enemies using physics interactions and your unique device - the Portable Energy Manipulator. PHYSICS PUZZLES & INTERACTIVE ENVIRONMENT Have fun by studying physical interactions: numerous items within the game are capable of being seized, relocated, or manipulated in other ways. Whether it's a door you should go through, a box you can carry, a terminal you can use, or even a simple mug on a table. Investigate various interactive environments for clues, explore upcoming puzzles, and find solutions, which in some cases may be more than one. PORTABLE ENERGY MANIPULATOR The universal device you carry throughout the game can interact with different types of energy from the environment, store it, and release it as shown. You could clear your way, protect yourself from the enemies, or destroy anything in your way. Why not? Absorb heat from fire and radiators to melt glass, blind security cameras with a beam of light, and freeze physical objects in place by draining force fields. In the upcoming full version of THE MULLER-POWELL PRINCIPLE you will be able to remove hazardous radiation from toxic puddles, use it to charge power generators, and even harvest quantum entanglement energy — the mysterious power capable of opening portals between worlds. Utilize your device to its fullest potential! Apart from solving environmental puzzles, your device can also be used against various creatures you'll find in parallel dimensions. Most of the time you can't really defeat your enemies, instead you can use the Manipulator to outsmart or suspend them. You find yourself in one of Delta Labs' off-world research facilities in an unknown dimension, so it looks more like a crashing-down laboratory. All you can remember are the words “The Muller-Powell Principle” stuck in your head. You need to figure out the meaning of these words, otherwise, you’re doomed. Your companions should try to connect with you shortly, and with their help, you start a journey through various dimensions and unveil the mysteries of this project and your past. Make your way back to Earth through mysterious parallel dimensions littered with puzzles and secrets to discover, uncover mysterious connections between the worlds you visit, and reveal the dark truth behind Delta Labs and your involvement with them. Solve various physics-based puzzles Unique gameplay mechanics that involve an energy-manipulating weapon A mix of sci-fi with surreal and esoteric themes makes the game setting unique design Deeply thought-out story and lore. Each character in the game has its own story, which is revealed through various notes, environmental narratives, and characters' conversations. This and much more awaits you in the main game, coming November 16!
row.short_description: This prologue was created to present an overall concept of the main game through a pair of gameplay hours to introduce you to some of the game’s mechanics, creatures, and ideas.

row.name: Wild Thaw
row.detailed_description: Wild Thaw is a third person platformer about a fireball facing down the mountain of ice. You play as a fireball, born of a volcano and the last hope to bring balance to the valley. Melt your way through walls of ice and grow ever larger by burning grass and trees. But don’t worry! As you burn through the valley you also spread life as seeds sprout flowers in your fiery wake. Explore a beautiful world filled with secrets Journey from the volcano and through the frozen valley to thaw the land. Find the core of the ice to save mother nature. Burn to grow your power Set fire to plants and watch the flames spread—collect their energy to gain access to new locations. Grow and shrink in size as you collect and exhaust your energy. This game was made by students in the University of Southern California’s Interactive Media and Games program in collaboration with students from the Berklee College of Music. The game is developed by Yue Wang, Quentin Burley, Jimi Stine, Bocheng Yao, Yimen chen, Austin Leshock, Thomas Ortola, and Svidanza Audio, . For more information, check out our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, please visit the USC Games website.
row.short_description: Wild Thaw is a third person platformer about a fireball facing down the mountain of ice. Bring life back to the valley by melting ice and growing your power!

row.name: Simply Rotate
row.detailed_description: Simply Rotate is a physics based puzzle game where you rotate the level to get a ball to the goal while conserving rotation for future levels. Think outside the box and efficiently rotate the world so you can complete complex puzzles. Rotate Your World Rotate the level while avoiding obstacles and trying to conserve rotation. Build up speed and carefully navigate through levels with different challenges and mechanics. Think Outside the Box Think carefully about how to solve levels using the least amount of rotation possible. Get taken up in the simple lo-fi aesthetic and relaxing ambient music. Compete for the Fastest Time Test your skills in the time frenzy mode. Speed through levels while making sure to conserve enough rotation. This game was made as a final project for the game prototyping class at the University of Southern California. The game was initially designed as a prototype by David Xu and Letitia Napitupulu to be simple enough to not need text to go along with the unit on accessibility. Simply Rotate was then further developed into a final project for the class with Andre Lebecki and Kelly Chan helping out with development. The game will now continue to be developed into a more complete experience with Calvin Thompson composing the music.
row.short_description: Simply rotate is a minimalist physics puzzle game where you rotate a level to get a ball to reach the goal while saving up on rotation for future stages. Learn the new mechanics introduced in every level and master conserving rotation between levels to reach the goal.

row.name: Hans
row.detailed_description: Hans is a visual novel baking simulator in which you play as an alien dropped off on Earth during World War 1, who bakes magical pastries to help the people in your small town. You can also choose not to make what they ask for, because sometimes their requests are not as thought out as they may think. Just be prepared, because your actions have eight endings worth of consequences! Bake magical foods for the local townsfolk In this moody handdrawn game, you have the power to help the townsfolk by baking magical pastries! Will you accept their requests? Summon aliens to obtain magical ingredients Enter the mysterious cat shrine and tap into your magical powers as an alien to obtain a special ingredient to use in your baking. Help two friends fall in love Addler is interested in their friend, Karl! Will you bake them some magical muffins to give them a boost of confidence and ask Karl out? Hans is a passion project made in a few months by a handful of college students. Art is pencil on watercolor paper, colored and edited in Photoshop. Designed together by Clei Barnhart and Elaine Toh. Produced by Clei Barnhart and David Contarino. Coding by Elaine Toh. Art and narrative by Clei Barnhart. Music by Fay Xu and Jacov Naumoski. Sound design and audio implementation by David Contarino. UI by Elaine Toh. Special thanks to Nicholas Linares and Marianne Zhou!
row.short_description: Step into Hans, a visual novel set during World War I, and play as an alien who bakes magical pastries to help the residents of a small town.

row.name: Heart-S-Truck
row.detailed_description: In 'Heart-S-Truck,' brace yourself for a platforming odyssey set in a whimsical universe where the fate of humanity rests on the wheels of brave delivery trucks. As a valiant truck with a vital mission, you'll navigate treacherous paths demanding precision, velocity, and unwavering focus. Forge Bonds with Quirky Characters Dive into deep interactions with the world’s vibrant residents. Listen to their stories, share in their dreams, and knit the threads of a scattered community together by fulfilling critical deliveries in their time of need. Conquer the Physics of Platforming Face the thrilling challenge of a physics-based driving platformer. Mastery over momentum and the art of balance is key as you turn each delivery into a heart-pounding trial. Revel in a Vivid, Hand-Painted World Journey through an enchantingly painted world that invites you to explore a spectrum of stunning and diverse environments, each alive with color and motion. Heart-S-Truck is an intermediate game project at the University of Southern California by Rosemary Wu and Yufei Xiao, in collaboration with students from Berklee College of Music. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 game program in the world, check out the USC Games website, linked to the right.
row.short_description: Navigate a world on the brink in 'Heart-S-Truck,' a challenging physics-driven platformer where you steer heroic delivery trucks on a mission to save humanity!

row.name: Cats and Seek: Osaka
row.detailed_description: 💚💚 MORE UPCOMING GAMES! 💚💚 About the Game This is the first title of Cats and Seek series. Do you have 5 minutes to spare? Let's play hide and seek with 100 cats in Osaka! 😻 ❤️     Can you find them all? ❤️ 🎮 1 level :: 😻 100 Hidden cats :: 🏆 100 Achievements 🔆 Brightness setting :: 🎨 Choose your favorite color :: 🔔 Free hints 💾 Save system :: 🔍 Zoom :: 🔉 Cute cat sounds 🎁 Extra level DLC (207 cats) And if bored with black and white doddles you can choose your own favorite color .
row.short_description: Hey, do you have 5 minutes to spare? Let's play hide and seek with 100 cats in Osaka! 😻 Can you find them all?

row.name: Bloodshots
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Bloodshots Overview: Immerse yourself in the chilling atmosphere of Bloodshots, set in the year 2010 within the ominous walls of the Abderc biochemical laboratory in Texas, United States. Unveil the events that led the place to be infested with hostile mutants. Storyline: Venture into the aftermath of twisted experiments that claimed the lives of Abderc's workers. As Joseph Alexander Blackwell, one of the few survivors, your mission is to navigate the depths of the facility to save your dying daughter from an imminent demise. Gameplay Features: Survival Horror Elements: Embrace the essence of classic survival horror games as you navigate through a dark and foreboding environment, where danger lurks around every corner. Additionally, challenge yourself by limiting your combat options to fire weapons only, intensifying the suspense and creating a uniquely gripping experience. Resource Management: Face the challenge of sustaining vitality using only syringes filled with blood. Every decision matters, as you push the boundaries of desperation, utilizing your blood as raw material for ammunition production. Narrative-driven Choices: Reconstruct the events through the reading of notes that unveil crucial details about what happened in the Abderc laboratory.
row.short_description: Immerse yourself in a terrifying survival horror experience set in a laboratory where horrific experiments have been conducted. Take on the role of Joseph Alexander Blackwell, who has to rescue his daughter. To succeed, you will be forced to use your own blood in unusual and twisted ways.
row.notes: This video game may include material that is not suitable for all age groups or may not be suitable for viewing in a professional setting. It may consist of frequent violence or gore and general mature content.

row.name: Alien Tag
row.detailed_description: Alien Tag is a NEW, FREE VR Game that includes built-in mods & built-in custom maps! Join the Discord at 👽 Sign up for the Beta at . Alien Tag puts you in the shoes of an extraterrestrial trying to tag other aliens! Use your long, flexible alien arms to swing swiftly across psychedelic alien worlds. See if you can master the art of alien locomotion and become the top tagger in the galaxy. With Mods & Custom Maps natively integrated, no two games of Alien Tag are ever the same. Challenge your friends to out-swing and out-tag one another in intense, fast-paced rounds. Transport yourself to new worlds and catch some alien vibes today!
row.short_description: Reject Monke, Become Alien. Discord.gg/AlienTag. AlienTagVR.com.

row.name: Free Chess
row.detailed_description: Free Chess Free Chess is a free physics based chess simulator where you are free to play the game of chess with the freedom of however you like. (Have we mentioned free enough?) With the use of physics simulation, move pieces just as you would on a real chess board, with the added benefit of playing with friends across the world! With many different settings and themes for your chess sets the game is always pretty to look at! Take the game up a notch and invite multiple friends to duke it out without limitations. Invent your own rules and play however you want! [Warning: This game is PHYSICS BASED, this means you CAN knock pieces over while you play. Please check the controls in the pause menu when playing to learn how to avoid doing this (hold right click while you move the piece holding left click to lift pieces over other pieces). Also note this game can be played very silly where you can move the opponents pieces and even skip your turn and be generally silly. If this isn't your jam, please don't leave a negative review detailing how you knocked over all your pieces and hated the physics aspect of the game, this is how our game was intended to be played]
row.short_description: Free Chess is a free physics based chess simulator where you are free to play the game of chess with the freedom of however you like.

row.name: DOMINO The Little One
row.detailed_description: Amidst the daunting specters of environmental destruction and climate change, a young, introverted hero named Domino embarks on a mind-bending eco-odyssey into the depths of their dreams. DOMINO: The Little One, an immersive interactive narrative experience, invites you to traverse a world where the alarming manifestations of global warming and ecological challenges will test your wit and determination. Embark on a personal odyssey into Domino's subconscious, where the domino pieces of their inner turmoil are cascading. Unravel the threads of their self-discovery and discover the power within to bring about change. This is a journey of self-conciousness and empowerment and a call to action that echoes beyond the digital world. Key Features Heartfelt Journey Dive deep into Domino's introspective adventure through a hand-drawn world where dreams and reality intertwine, each step revealing more about themselves and the world around them. Growing Companion Experience the evolution of Lilac Domino, a symbol of hope, resilience, and the continuous cycle of life, standing as a beacon against Domino's looming fears. Environmental Undertones Tackle puzzles and challenges reflecting not just Domino's internal struggles but also the greater ecological concerns that our world faces today. Poetic Depth Engage with a narrative enriched with poetic elements, drawing connections between nature's rhythm and the human journey, emphasizing the bond between humanity and the planet. Inspiring Change Through captivating storytelling, realize the impact of seemingly small decisions, embodying the philosophy that single small push can initiate a domino effect, leading to substantial changes in the grand scheme of things. A Message for All Ages Domino delivers a universal message, reminding us all that change starts from within, and that we hold the power to make a difference. No one but you can save yourself, and it’s time to take that first step.
row.short_description: DOMINO: The Little One, a hand-drawn 2D adventure game, invites you to traverse a realm where the perils of global warming and ecological catastrophe manifest as monstrous entities, and the only weapon at your disposal is your wit and will to make a change.

row.name: Moi Moi Heroes
row.detailed_description: Get ready to dive into the whirlwind world of 'Moi Moi Heroes,' an adventure like no other. On the sunny, tropical Moi Moi Island, you will transform into the wackiest Easter Island Head figure, embarking on a mission filled with laughter, mayhem, and jumping rocks Join the Chaos: Are you ready to get swept away in the wild, chaotic, and side-splitting fun? Join us on Moi Moi Island, where chaos is the name of the game, laughter is the ultimate reward, and every adventure is a comedy waiting to happen. Dive into the chaos and become the Hero you were destined to be!
row.short_description: Moi Moi Heroes offers a wacky adventure on Moi Moi Island! Reach King Moi Moi's crown and return it to score. Become the ultimate 'Moi Moi Hero' in this uproarious adventure!

row.name: Mini-Tank Arena
row.detailed_description: Have you ever wondered how your toys are in different spots, if they live a secret life of their own? When playing Mini Tank Arena you'll be able to first-hand experience the magic of toy tanks going head-to-head and reminisce the magic of being a young child playing with their toys. Play with multiple different tank types, and show off your competitive shooting skills in this new Battle Arena Shooter created for players everywhere.
row.short_description: Mini Tank Arena is a 4v4 multiplayer battle Arena shooter, play on different maps experience the battle styles of each unique tank, and see how each tank can synergize with other tanks to help elevate the playing field.

row.name: UKI-UKI-TENGOKU2
row.detailed_description: Retro 2D side-scrolling shooter with pixel art. row.name: SCP-087-B UE Remake
row.detailed_description: SCP-087-B UE Remake is a fan game based on the original SCP-087-B make by Joonas Rikkonen, a single-player horror experience from the point of view of a D-Class sent to explore what lurks below in the unexplored and undocumented depths of an ever-changing brick and concrete staircase. Equipped with only a lighter, the D-Class must navigate dozens of floors until they reach, or rather if they reach, the lowest level. Much of the audio, graphics and monster design is loosely or directly based on the original design of SCP-087-B, with several more creatures and threats added in beyond the scope of the original. Foundation Operatives grant all D-Class limited access to the associated documentation on this anomaly before entry, and recommends all subjects to brief themselves with the information before entry: Item #: SCP-087-B Object Class: Euclid Special Containment Procedures: SCP-087-B is located on the campus of [REDACTED]. The doorway leading to SCP-087-B has been disguised to resemble a storage closet consistent with the design of the building. The lock mechanism on the doorknob will not release unless ██ volts are applied in conjunction with counter-clockwise rotation of the key. Due to the results of the first exploration (see Document 087-B-I), the door handle and locking mechanism have been removed from the inside of the door. Any personnel who enter beyond the threshold of SCP-087-B are presumed dead, and the door must not be opened if motion is detected inside. Description: SCP-087-B is an unlit concrete staircase with brick walls. The dark interior of SCP-087-B limits subjects to a visual range of approximately 1.5 meters. A light source is required for any subjects exploring SCP-087-B, as there are no lighting fixtures or windows present. Lighting sources brighter than a lighter flame have shown to be ineffective, as SCP-087-B seems to absorb excess light. The entrance to SCP-087-B is inside a small room which was formerly used as a storage closet. When two or more subjects enter the room, it appears as a rectangular room with solid concrete walls and a single wooden doorway. Subjects have always described a sense of uneasiness when present within the room, despite having little to no awareness of the anomalous properties of the location. Subjects who have entered this storage closet alone report observing a brick hallway opposite the entry doorway after they have been sealed within the room. Radio communication with subjects that enter the hallway becomes increasingly difficult as they descend the staircase, and attempts to converse with subjects which have gone beyond the 6th floor has proven difficult. The full extent of SCP-087-B's anomalous properties are unknown, and further expeditions have been approved.
row.short_description: SCP-087-B UE Remake is a free single-player horror experience which seeks to recreate many aspects of the 2012 game SCP-087-B made by Joonas Rikkonen while keeping the charm and feel of the original.
row.notes: Death, minor depictions of blood, psychological horror and several hostile entities.

row.name: MAZE
row.detailed_description: The original design of the game 'Maze' was to simulate the real environment when encountering a maze in reality, breaking the necessary map guidance elements in previous games. If players have a strong sense of direction, the game will become dull, but if players have a poor sense of direction, playing this game is simply torture oneself. The current experience version provides steel themed scenes in the game, with 5 built-in maps. The first level, difficulty - very easy. This is the initial map of the game. After our production team tests, we can find the endpoint within 1 minute. I believe that no matter how crazy the road is, people will not get lost in it; The second level, difficulty easy, the overall difficulty of this maze has slightly increased, adding players to jump (space key) and squat (Ctrl key) operations, but it is not complex and can be completed in a few minutes; The third level, difficulty - ordinary, this maze seems complex, and the results of internal testing can also be found in about 5 minutes to find the endpoint; The fourth level, difficulty difficulty, this maze is different from other mazes and is a map that tests players' operations. In this map, there is no unique route to reach the finish line, but players need to calmly deal with it and seize the opportunity; The fifth level, difficulty - very difficult, this maze is the true meaning of the maze, the difficulty is very high, and the person who can walk out smoothly must be a genius. (Of course, in the game, two hidden points have been specially set up to reduce difficulty appropriately. Finding these two hidden points will help players reduce a lot of difficulty.)
row.short_description: Maze 'is a game that simulates you in a real maze environment. Without map navigation or guidance from any auxiliary tools, you will be completely lost in it. The only thing you can rely on is your own intuition and memory. Let's see how long it takes you to get out of the helpless maze.

row.name: Phoenix 2
row.detailed_description: Was your last game too easy? Phoenix 2 turns up the heat—it dares you to sharpen your reflexes, master its mechanics, and face down overwhelming odds. This is a game where skill matters , and only the best will survive.  Phoenix 2 is a fast-paced shoot 'em up where survival is about more than just dodging. Bullets and lasers flood the screen, but victory comes from mastering your ship’s abilities . Blast through enemy waves, unleash devastating attacks, and turn impossible odds into a spectacle of destruction. If you're overwhelmed, you're doing it wrong! Collect your own fleet from 100 unlockable ships , each armed with a unique main weapon and its own set of special abilities! Do you prefer evasion? Choose a ship with Teleport or Barrier . Need more firepower? Get the Mega Laser or Vorpal Lance —or both! There's a ship for every playstyle. And when you have mastered one, reach perfection by getting its ultimate Apex Forms . Battle through 30 story missions that push you to the edge. Explore the far reaches of space, face unyielding enemy waves, and take down screen-filling bosses as you fight back against the Invaders. Beyond the campaign, new challenges drop every single day —identical for every pilot worldwide. Choose your favourite ship, show your mastery of its abilities, and rise on the leaderboards . It’s you against everyone else. In these global rankings , every fraction of a second counts. Running on our handcrafted game engine , Phoenix 2 delivers ultra-fluid action with seamless cross-platform play. Run at the maximum FPS your system can deliver for ultra-fluid action and incredibly responsive controls. Play with mouse, keyboard, or gamepad , whichever suits you best. The galaxy won’t save itself. Are you ready to take flight?
row.short_description: A fast-paced shoot 'em up where skill matters. Master over 100 ships, unleash powerful special abilities, and blast through waves of Invaders. Play a new mission every day and climb the world-wide leaderboards.

This game is being developed by one developer. features: 4 classes with unique properties and abilities multiplayer set of diverse maps Inspired by XCOM series and Into The Breach.

row.name: Pearls of Atlantis: The Cove

Navigate bumpers, wheels, and moving platforms as you go! Use power-ups like the explosive hammer, the friendly charm grabbing jellyfish, and Triton’s frightful lightning to smash all the obstacles in your way! It takes strategy and precision to beat these unique and challenging bubble shooter puzzles. Match 3 pearls of the same color to collect the magic charms inside. Use the charms to restore a once-beautiful part of Atlantis, the underwater city, and protect the mermaids! As you venture into the depths of the sea, you’ll discover the Cove of Memories, a once-glorious part of the hidden city, Atlantis. Now, it lies in ruins… but you’re not alone in your quest to uncover its secrets! You’ll meet Kaia, a bubbly mermaid who will guide you on your journey, along with her sidekick Nauty, a comical companion who’s always up for some fun. Don’t forget to watch out for the villains who lurk in the shadows, waiting to sabotage your every move! Customize and decorate the Cove of Atlantis to make it your own, and discover its secrets as you progress through the game. With daily challenges and special events like the Zen Mode, Treasure Run and Bottomless Trench, every day is a new adventure in Pearls of Atlantis! So what are you waiting for? Dive into the deep blue sea and start your journey today with PEARLS OF ATLANTIS: a free bubble shooter game with an all new twist! Features 1,000+ Fun and Challenging Levels 10 New Levels Added Every Week Unique Physics-based Gameplay Customize the Cove of Memories, decorate your Galleries, and more A variety of game modes, including Daily Puzzle, Zen Mode, Treasure Run, Bottomless Trench, and Score Challenge Protect the Cove from evildoers when you play through the story!
row.short_description: Color match in a whole new way! Drop, pop, swap and match magic pearls to collect the charms inside and rebuild the hidden Cove of Memories!
row.reviews: “It’s like The Little Mermaid and Puzzle Bobble had a baby, and that impression holds up after spending several hours with Pearls of Atlantis: The Cove. [...] This is a robust, charming, and colorful mermaid match-3 with a surprising amount of content. Sure, it’s a cozy game, and it’s all the better for it.” 4 Stars – Hey Poor Player “I had so much fun with Pearls of Atlantis: The Cove that it's an easy game to recommend. First and foremost, the best part of its gameplay is how it's physics-based. [...] I absolutely love Pearls of Atlantis: The Cove with its delightful setting and highly enjoyable physics-based puzzle gameplay. Superb!” 4 Stars – Video Chums “An action puzzler that uses gravity to help it feel a bit different than its cousins in the Bust-A-Move franchise” 7.9/10 – Nindie Spotlight

That’s where we’ll drop all the latest updates. See you on the pitch ;)

But when her latest mission goes awry, she finds herself caught between two worlds on the verge of collapse. As fragments of her parents’ research appear, Nohla must face the past to fight for the future of the multiverse. This is a free-to-play demo to showcase what is to come! The Collective wants to crush anyone in their path–but it’s no problem for you as you sneak past their drones. What exactly happened to Nohla’s parents and why? Nohla may not want to discover the truth… Overcome the past to fight for the multiverse.
row.short_description: Fight for the freedom of the multiverse as you leap across dimensions in this third-person 3D platformer. Play as Nohla, a headstrong vigilante, and shift between worlds to stop the death cult threatening everywhere and everyone. Can face your painful past and save the future?

row.name: Echolight
row.detailed_description: Mehr als 60 Studierende des Studiengangs Medieninformatik und Interactive Entertainment an der Hochschule Mittweida haben in zwei Semestern ein eigenes Spiel entwickelt. Echolight ist ein actionbasiertes Roguelike Spiel, in dem du als Áine, eine Prinzessin aus einem altem Clan, versuchst die Macht der gefallenen Götter des Tages und der Nacht wieder herzustellen, dessen Kräfte sich auf die heimische Flora und Fauna ausgebreitet haben. Mächtige Waffen Damit du zum heldenhaften Retter der Welt aufsteigst, hast du von den Göttern selbst die Waffen erhalten, welche mit der Energie von Tag und Nacht angetrieben werden. Entscheide selbst über deinen Spielstil, indem du dir deinen perfekten Waffentyp aus einer Vielzahl von Möglichkeiten heraussuchst. Die Kombination dieser beiden Kräfte ist der einzige Weg, um in dieser rauen Welt den Sieg zu erringen. Progressives Machtgefühl Je weiter du dir deinen Weg bahnst, desto stärker wirst du. Mit dem sogenannten 'Plateaueffekt' erhältst du einzigartige neue Effekte, welche du mit deinen momentan ausgewählten Waffen verwenden kannst. Ebenso können deine Waffen mit einem sogenannten 'Releaseeffekt' ausgerüstet werden, welche mit der richtigen Kombination der Tag- und Nachtwaffen angewendet werden können. Je tiefer du deinen Weg bahnst, desto stärker werden diese Effekte, damit du der Retter der Welt werden kannst. Gefährliche Monster Inspiriert von der keltischen und nordischen Mythologie, stellen sich Kreaturen mit den Kräften des Tages und der Nacht dir in den Weg. Nur mit einer Mischung aus Mut und Geschicklichkeit kannst du dich gegen diese Gegner zur Wehr setzen. Ein Erlebnis mit Wiederspielwert Mit Hilfe von zufällig generierten Räumen, Layouts und Spawnpunkten gleicht keinem Lauf dem anderen. Passe dich jedes Mal aufs Neue dem Gebiet an, bezwinge Gegner mit unterschiedlichen Stärken und Schwächen, und experimentiere mit den verschieden Waffen und einzigartigen Effekten. Die Kraft der Götter jedoch wiederherzustellen, wird ein langer und steiniger Weg, welcher dir nicht bei dem ersten Versuch gelingen wird und mit zusätzlichen Herausforderungen kannst du deine Fähigkeiten ebenso noch stärker beweisen. Key Features Eine einzigartige Kampferfahrung, die von zwei Elementarwaffen gesteuert wird Eine wunderschöne Natur, erobert von furchterregenden Kreaturen, die erforscht werden wollen Schnelle Kämpfe mit einem heroischen Gefühl Die Meisterung der verschiedenen Waffen
row.short_description: Echolight ist ein actionbasiertes Roguelike-Spiel, in welchem du die Welt vor dem Chaos gefährlicher Monster, mit Hilfe der Waffen der Götter des Tages und der Nacht retten musst.

row.name: Age of Advent
row.detailed_description: WELCOME TO THE AGE OF ADVENT! Play four minigames based on the members of hololive -Advent-! Bijem'd The pickaxes are coming! Help the Moai escape before they get here! Clear the path to the bottom by clicking on groups of matching colors, and rack up combos by saving groups of Moai quickly! row.name: Cynabre
row.detailed_description: Cynabre is a tactical shooter game played in teams, pitting two factions with divergent technologies against each other. Defeat your enemies using different strategic classes in a universe mixing SteamPunk and science fiction. Cooperate and trap your opponents to capture the Cynabre. Discover a unique game mode! Capture the Cynabre in the depths of a mine and bring it back to your ship through a unique level design based on ambush and traps. Evolve in this unique map, wait and trap your opponents to regain possession of the crystal and steal it from them. Navigate winding mining galleries, capture buff zones, and gain advantage over the enemy with your unique abilities. Play as one of the game's three classes, different depending on your faction: Commander : Pillar of your team, you are the only one who can transport the Cynabre, communicate and provide support to your allies so that they protect you and escort you to your base. Controller : You are the tank of your team, lead the pace of combat, take hits and protect your teammates at all costs. The centerpiece of team combat, you are the key to the survival of your allies. Tracker : Take down your opponents and don't let them breathe, you are the damage of the team, equipped to take in pincers and do maximum damage. Bring down the Cynabre, create a breach in the fight and dominate the game with your ability to kill.

row.name: Space Miner - Idle Adventures
row.detailed_description: Join our Discord About the Game Space Miner - Idle Adventures Space Miner - Idle Adventures is a fun, entertaining and addictive game that lets you explore the galaxy, mine asteroids, and encounter all kinds of crazy events. Whether you want to play casually or actively, this game will keep you hooked! Features Two ways to actively mine with your ship: Use drills or lasers to mine asteroids of different types and sizes. Drills are cheaper and always get the full mining amount, but you have to chase down the asteroids. Lasers are more expensive and have diminishing returns over distance, but you're not chasing the asteroids. Choose your strategy wisely! Upgrade your ship: Sell the resources you gather for gold, and use the gold to buy upgrades that increase your mining speed and cargo capacity. Perform Research using gathered resources to unlock technological advancements to improve your equipment and more. Over 170 research items so far! Craft unique parts in the Click Factory for advanced research and other craftable feature unlocks like hidden storage and offline rewards. Feel like idling? Buy AutoMiners to gather ore for you in the background. They'll collect ore even while the rest of the game is paused. Buy Merchants (auto-sellers) to sell selected inventory for you automatically! Cha-ching! You can also buy Mining Outposts to mine specific resources. Prefer a more entertaining method of idle mining? Buy Mining Drones that will fly around and mine the asteroids for you. Such a spectacular performance to behold! There are also Player placeable Laser Mining Turrets , for all your Frickin Laser needs. Increase your Reputation (prestige) to earn gold even faster! Explore Space: Encounter various events and zones that may reward you, challenge you, or screw you over. Play Rock Paper Scissors with aliens, roll dice with pirates, shoot the breeze with fellow miners, and uncover the secrets of ancient artifacts and anomalies. Battle bosses to unlock new zones. Once unlocked, you can warp to the new zones for rare loot and events. Scan wrecks, dodge solar flares, navigate mazes and more! Earn achievements: There are over 60 in-game achievements to earn, ranging from easy to hard, and from silly to serious. Some of them may even affect the gameplay or reveal hidden secrets. Can you unlock them all? Complete Quests to earn rewards and earn reputation across the galaxy. Enjoy the humor: The game is full of jokes, puns, references, and Easter eggs that will make you laugh out loud. The game does not take itself too seriously, and neither should you. Just have fun and watch the numbers go UP! Keep your progress on track and synchronized across devices with Cloud Saves and Cross-Platform support. Windows, Linux and yep, Steam Deck! Playtime rewards. Watch for the gifts! More details For more details about the current state of the game, updates, and more, check out our Discord. As this is Early Access, there may be bugs and incomplete features. More features and content are being built and added all the time. The game is in Active development.

row.name: 魔方谏言
row.detailed_description: Brief Octameta is a distinctive 3D puzzle game that immerses players in an enduring exploration of the enigmas of human science. Story In a world where human civilization has collapsed, you will take on the role of an intelligent being（Robot）, reconstructing and comprehending the evolution of human technology by solving a symbolic two-layered Rubik's Cube composed of technological fragments. The main focus of the gameplay lies in deciphering the Rubik's Cube, while the secondary aspect involves solving puzzles in small-scale scenarios. Levels We have four civilization fragments to restore. Restoring the Rubik's Cube at each stage involves an in-depth exploration of scientific principles, such as polar coordinates (representing reproduction), Newtonian gravity (representing money), circuit theory (representing religion), and Fourier transform (representing power). Those principles not only embody the scientific progress of human history, but also reflect fundamental issues of human society. Epilogue Every significant advancement in the field of natural science made by humanity serves as a means of reinforcing the social structure. Despite originating from pure curiosity, it invariably veers off course due to the powerful inertia of the social system. This phenomenon recurs at every stage of human social evolution: from slavery to feudalism, and from feudalism to capitalist private ownership. Mathematics is utilized for taxation, while the information exchange facilitated by the internet progressively erects firewalls and censorship. Those all results into class solidification. Even if humanity ultimately transitions to extinction, the exploitation of the scientific impartial stance by a select few powerful individuals will turn everything established by science into a double-edged sword poised over all of humanity.
row.short_description: A 3D-styled puzzle-solving burning brain indie game, using the Pocket Cube to restore objects. A story about AI's journey to recreate the history of human science

These non-linear adventures are perfect for when you want to curl up on a rainy afternoon to explore gorgeous landscapes, take in hand-painted visuals and bask in its meditative soundtrack. The gameplay emphasizes ease of movement, with sleek platforming, and no fall damage. William and Sly In our introduction to this world, William's fantastic teleportation system has been deactivated, and it is up to Sly to fix it. Activate the stones, play around with mysterious fairyflies, and gather up mushrooms. The heart of the game is in exploration, venturing beyond the central task, and seeing what intriguing discoveries can be made in every corner of this sprawling landscape. William and Sly 2 The troublesome gnomes have stolen and scattered the pages of William's journal! Alongside this main quest, you will discover shrines that offer up side quests and new abilities. Building off the serene, cozy gameplay of the original game, William and Sly 2 offers light puzzles to solve and more narrative touches to build up this world. But worry not, there are still plenty of mushrooms to munch and delightful secrets to uncover. Bonus Game: The Everloom On high cliffs overlooking an open sky, a group of strangers is trapped in a shared dream. In this classic pixel art adventure from the golden era of Flash games, play as a boy caught in a tangled web of intrigue. Talk to characters to learn their stories and use the items they give you to find solutions to their problems.
row.short_description: The world of William and Sly is yours to explore, seeking out collectables and secrets, while soaking in the tranquil visuals and melancholic soundtrack. In this pair of classic Flash games, you play as a fox, running and leaping through an atmospheric ecosystem entirely at your own pace.
row.reviews: “William and Sly feels like the casual gameplay equivalent of one of those relaxation CDs, only instead of whale songs we've got a lovely landscape to explore with some very fun platforming.” 4.7/5 – JayisGames

row.name: Alchemy Frogs
row.detailed_description: Alchemy Frogs is a local co-op puzzle platformer game with a 3D, isometric camera, in which Frog & Toad traverse a poisoned magical swampy forest to look for a cure that will help them save their family from being turned to stone. Together, the players must use their personal porta-cauldrons to brew potions and then throw them at hazards spawned by the mysterious plague. Frog & Toad will mix their potions to unleash powerful magical effects, growing plants over dangerous salt pits or exploding obstacles with alchemical dynamite.

Frog & Toad will mix their potions to unleash powerful magical effects.

row.name: TRUFFLE
row.detailed_description: What is the Game? TRUFFLE is a minimalist puzzle maze game where touching the walls kills you instantly! The game will put your patience and dexterity to the test as you complete the large variety of levels. Collect the mushroom at the end of each level to win and don't touch any walls! Features 20 Core levels to complete 6 Bonus levels to unlock 80 Watching Eyes to collect About the Developer Hello! I am Ethan Robichaux and I solo developed this game over 4 months. At the time of TRUFFLE releasing I am a college student and I create games in my free time. This is my 4th full Steam game. row.name: World War: Rome - Free Strategy Game

Recast the glory of war and rise to power through your extraordinary wisdom. Choose from legendary generals such as Caesar, Scipio, Hannibal, Pyrrhus and create your own era. row.name: Ace Racers SP
row.detailed_description: Ace Racers SP This game is a prototype for thinkers and tinkerers. Pioneer the future with Ace Racers SP! About the Game Ace Racers SP is a prototype of a game designed to be an FPV drone racing simulator for space drones. The purpose of the project was to test a platform for players to create and share unlimited obstacles and maneuvering challenges for the practice of thrust physics vehicles, primarily a 6axis RCS spaceship. Also available in game is a 'lunar lander' style vehicle, and a 'forward only' style vehicle (which only moves forward), as well as a 6axis space vehicle purpose built for pushing freight around like a space barge. There is no deep space exploration, and if you understand the game you know there never will be. This is intended to be 'go-kart' for realistic space vehicles. Ace Racers SP Ace Racers SP Ace Racers SP Ace Racers SP Although formatted with many similarities to a racing game, and titled as a racing game, the primary function of the game is intended to be to create courses and obstacle arrangements for the purpose of expanding the available unique maneuvers to practice for the vehicle type. It is possible to export and import saved courses/obstacle arrangements, and the end-goal of the project is to collect an ever-increasing database of course material for players to sift through and expand their capabilities with the sticks. It IS possible to 'race' yourself, although the course order and timing system are intended not for the purpose of player competition, but rather for the purpose of making it easier to share very specific arrangements/courses. By being able to create a course which highlights the next checkpoint it is possible to make a course, save the course order, and for another player to then 'race' the course, without having to find a map or video instruction on the specific pattern of checkpoints. The course will simply tell you where to go next and when you are ready to fly without the racing system you can, or you can choose to continue to use the racing system in order to see your lap-times and compare them with your previous laps. This game was not designed with keyboard and mouse in mind, and is not fully compatible with mouse for steering, and instead was originally conceived as a way to make use of my own prototype home-made 6axis controller. It is BEST played with some form of 'space game rig' , for example a 6axis hotas, space mouse, or for some people a gamepad is adequate, if not a bit unintuitive for 6axis. The best 'lunar lander' flight performance I personally have ever seen posted on the internet, was in the classic game 'Lunar Flight' and was performed by a player claiming to have flown ONLY using keyboard (no mouse), and therefore the default control configuration for my game is also keyboard-only, as although I prefer my 4joystick gamepad , I am confident that keyboard-only is simply the superior choice over keyboard and mouse. This game uses Rewired so virtually any controller can be set up/configured by the player, although most/all should not be set up by default. The mouse does work well in the menus.
row.short_description: Master thrust-based close-quarters spacecraft maneuvering. Import, build, and export (to share with friends) arena courses for space drone racing. Customize your ships thrust and rates, and work on your manual thrust skills.

row.name: Remove: 범죄는 흔적을 남긴다
row.detailed_description: You lost some of memories after the accident. As you got home after treatment, you found suspicious traces. ‘What’s this? The pictures, and a bloodstain?’ Were you someone’s stalker? Or maybe… you committed a bolder crime? Let’s recall the memory before the accident and erase the traces of your crime. 'Remove: Crime Leaves Its Traces' is a mystery thriller game. Within 15 minutes, we need to collect the clues in the room and remove evidence of the crime. Use the evidence you have gathered to reconstruct the case and prove your innocence. However, you should never get caught.
row.short_description: Let’s recall the memory before the accident and erase the traces of your crime.

row.name: SPEEDUS -SHEDDING SPEED CARD-
row.detailed_description: ◆ Speed x Skill Card Battle! The rules are simple: play cards from your hand that connect to the numbers on the playing field. But to seize victory, you need to observe your opponent closely. Do you play quickly? Chain many cards at once? or even daringly wait and see? Consider both your and your opponent's cards at hand, the skills available, the direction of the playing field and unleash the perfect strategy! Play online against the world or with your dear friend! PS: don't break your friendship! ;) ◆ The key to winning are: Skills You can utilize up to two skills in a single deck. But your timing and how you use them makes all the difference. There are skills that give your opponent a hard time and skills that give you the upper advantage. Even skills unique to your chosen character. With skills that activates when special condition of the playing fields is met, depending on your command, comebacks are possible! ◆ Display unthinkable twist with: Abilities Differing to skills, your deck will have cards with special effects called 'ability'. Which card gets which ability is determined randomly at the start of the battle, so the strategy from your previous game might not always fit your next. Acknowledge the tides of the playing field and rely on flexibility and adaptation. ◆ To attain greater power get on: Deck Building To get stronger; to win more satisfying victories, obsess and take great detail of your deck. A deck specialized in dealing multiple cards at once. A deck that overpowers in late-game. Synergize with your chosen character's playstyle and pursue the thrill of battle using the deck of your own creation. ◇ Speedus continues to Evolve! ◇ The foundational gameplay is provided for free, However our development team doesn't consider this the final version. Future updates is in the works, and we will continue to evolve Speedus! ・Overall graphical improvements ・Additional DLC and more! To do this, all we ask is for you, the players, to enjoy the game. Please invite your friends and let's play Speedus online!!
row.short_description: 'SPEEDUS' is a competitive card battle game based on the classic card game 'Speed.' Quickly play cards from your hand that follow the numbers on the field! Use skills and abilities! The first player to play all cards from their deck and hand wins!

row.name: Idle Progress
row.detailed_description: Idle Progress - A free idle game where your task is to produce as many resources as possible, improve your weapons and armor for good attacks, create good fishing rods for a good catch and get legendary stuff by completing legendary quests. You can either just farm by upgrading your production or equip a weapon and armor to start fighting for better resources, better crafts and to earn the LEGENDARY ITEMS! - Over 4 epic legendary quests to complete - Build infrastructure with resources to increase population - Try your self at science to create interesting creatures - Increase your Game Skill by selling/crafting/melting stuff - Spend some time unboxing treasures to get cool rare items - Or you can simply relax while you are fishing
row.short_description: Idle Progress - A free idle game where your task is to produce as many resources as possible, improve your weapons and armor for good attacks, create good fishing rods for a good catch and get legendary items by completing legendary quests.

row.name: Oh Darling! I Hate To Tell You This...
row.detailed_description: Check our action adventure game! About the Game Little Darling makes a wish at the place where all the wishes come true. Then her journey begins. She has to fight against the monsters with the power of light. Enter the gates of the hell to reveal the truth. Find upgrades & different bullet types! Fight against bosses of hell. Survive the enemy waves. Find your mama.
row.short_description: Little Darling makes a wish at the place where all the wishes come true. Then her journey begins. She has to fight against the monsters with the power of light.
row.notes: The cutscenes contains depressed story of the protagonist girl. Character can die in hell and respawn with animation that contains pixel-art blood. Demons and other celestial creatures can be seen through the game.

row.name: Divergence
row.detailed_description: Divergence is an immersive and thrilling gaming experience that transports players to a mysterious island shrouded in secrets and teeming with perilous robotic guardians. In this action-packed adventure, you'll step into the shoes of a fearless explorer armed with a unique time-reversing backpack, setting the stage for an epic quest like no other. Petra wields the TimeSync, a backpack that empowers her to manipulate time itself. Rewind and replay your actions, strategize, and take on your adversaries with renewed precision. The TimeSync is your key to unraveling the island's mysteries. Navigate treacherous terrains, engage in heart-pounding battles, and unravel the island's secrets in stunning detail. Your ultimate goal in Divergence is to face off against the formidable guardian known as the Hoplite. Defeat this formidable adversary to save the island from impending doom and retrieve the coveted Heart of Kronos, an artifact of unimaginable power. Will you have what it takes to conquer the island's challenges and uncover its hidden truths? The fate of the island rests in your hands. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Explore a mysterious island with the help of a time manipulation device. Rewind and diverge from your current timeline to combat the ancient guardians and discover the secrets behind Titans.

row.name: Dimlight Dungeon
row.detailed_description: Dimlight Dungeon is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler where the player controls a reptilian brawler and travels within the ruins of a once-mighty, heroic fortress. There the player must battle through rooms full of knights in order to reach the end throne. 3 different combat moves Go through multiple rooms and encounter numerous enemies Multiple enemy types Beat-em up type combat Beautiful art style This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler where the player controls a reptilian brawler and travels within the ruins of a once mighty heroic fortress.

row.name: Tochos vs. Brokens
row.detailed_description: The Brokens are invading and only you can save the planet, use your Tochos and defeat the evil forces in this strategic tower defense game. Features A singleplayer adventure where you'll travel around the world in an attempt to stop the Broken outbreak. Astounding graphics and soundtrack.
row.short_description: The Brokens are invading and only you can save the planet, use your Tochos and defeat the evil forces in this strategic tower defense game.

row.name: Boo's There?
row.detailed_description: In the world of Boo's There, play as a monster hunter given a life-or-death mission by a monster hunting guild: Monsters are hiding amongst regular trick or treaters on Halloween night, catch as many monsters as you can, fail to catch them all before the hour ends and there will be dire consequences… The guild has supplied you with inspection tools that can make your job easier, but be warned, using them takes up valuable chunks of time! Interrogate visitors based on suspicious quirks of their appearance. Appease the kids by giving them candy, and make sure not to anger their parents! Pick through the hordes of sugar-high children and identify the monsters using their weaknesses. See right through ghosts with a flashlight and make vampires gag with unappetizing garlic candy before trapping them in your patented monster-proof cage. Keep your block safe and make your guild proud! Are you ready to find out Boo's There?
row.short_description: Boo’s There is a single-player time management game where players must question trick or treaters at your doorstep on Halloween night. Visitors vary from monsters to regular trick-or-treaters, so watch and question visitors for any clues as you do your best to protect your town from peril!

row.name: Tower of the Dragon
row.detailed_description: Garcharius, the young dragon, is dead. Tower of the Dragons is a story-driven, turn-based combat RPG. Join your companions and defeat monsters to uncover the secrets of the tower left behind by the dragon! Suspicious tower and hidden treasures A tower has emerged after the mysterious death of a mighty dragon. It is told that whoever conquers the tower will be rewarded with the invaluable treasure the dragon has left behind...... Is this a challenge or just a trap? What is the true purpose of this tower? Strategic battles with a variety of enemies Each battle has its own unique opponents. No repetitive battles. Strategize your moves to defeat opponents efficiently! Chibi Characters Cute characters drawn in chibi art style await you! (Enemies may not be cute) Beginner Support Have you ever wished to progress main scenario but stuck at a hard boss fight? Don't worry this time. If you lose the same battle more than once, you'll be compensated with the best recovery item in the game.
row.short_description: Tower of the Dragon is a story-driven, turn-based combat RPG. Treasures and secrets lie in the mysterious tower which appeared after the death of a young dragon.
row.notes: This game contains cartoon violence.

row.name: Shatterbound
row.detailed_description: A game where you are your own solution... and greatest obstacle. Key Features After every death, leave behind a ghost that repeats the exact movements you made previously Work with your past selves to solve puzzles that couldn't otherwise be solved alone Use your ghosts as platforms for total freedom of exploration Allow your ghosts to break obstacles for you and clear your path Carefully consider your actions, so as to not harm your future self through your ghost Solve puzzles with many possible solutions, rewarding creative use of your ghosts
row.short_description: Work with your past (and future) selves to solve puzzles. Shatter your obstacles, be your own platform, and more in this time-looping puzzler where YOU are your own solution!

row.name: The Maze Contract
row.detailed_description: Features: 1980s arcade game action mixed with tactical elements and upgrades. Vector-style graphics. 26 unique levels to explore. High-score tables. Destroy your enemies and take their weapons. Collect upgrade containers, boost your ship's shield, thrusters and armor, and upgrade your weapons. 8 unique weapons + hyperspace/teleport to take you out of sticky situations. Tactical elements: choose your routes carefully, pick the best weapon to use in each situation, try to pit the two enemy factions against each other.
row.short_description: The Maze Contract is a single player retro action game with vector-style graphics. It takes a lot of inspiration from the 1980's shoot-em-up arcade games, but with added tactical elements and lots of upgrades for your ship and weapons.

4：游戏技能采用了自由配置模式，玩家可以根据自己的需要配置自己的技能 5：游戏目前的冒险时间大概是20个小时，如果想要体验全部的天赋时间会多一点。 目前游戏已经实装的天赋列表 强化大师：装备强化次数大幅增加 诡刺：每次攻击有一定的几率造成敌人最大生命百分比的伤害，几率会随着剧情的推进而提升 大聪明：智力提升100%，魔法消耗减少50%，击败敌人概率使智力获得增长
